-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Monoidal.Symmetric
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Projective
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.Basic

/-!
# The canonical module tensor in a larger coefficient universe

The objects, maps, associator and braiding are the native tensor product
maps over the original ring. The unit is its canonical module universe
lift, with unitors given by the actual down map and original tensor unitors. These instances are scoped, so existing
module-category instances retain their ownership. The original equal
universe structure is identified explicitly.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v
namespace ModuleCat.UniverseTensor

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

/-- The original native tensor structure on the larger module carriers. -/
scoped instance tensorStructure : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) where
  tensorObj M N := ModuleCat.of R (TensorProduct R M N)
  whiskerLeft M _ _ f := ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.lTensor M)
  whiskerRight f M := ModuleCat.ofHom (f.hom.rTensor M)
  tensorHom f g := ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map f.hom g.hom)
  tensorUnit := ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} R)
  associator M N K := (TensorProduct.assoc R M N K).toModuleIso
  leftUnitor M := ((TensorProduct.congr
    (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{v} R ≃ₗ[R] R) (LinearEquiv.refl R M)) ≪≫ₗ
      TensorProduct.lid R M).toModuleIso
  rightUnitor M := ((TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl R M)
    (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{v} R ≃ₗ[R] R)) ≪≫ₗ TensorProduct.rid R M).toModuleIso

open scoped ModuleCat.UniverseTensor

/-- The canonical native tensor maps satisfy the monoidal axioms in the
original ring and the larger coefficient category. -/
scoped instance monoidalCategory : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) :=
  MonoidalCategory.ofTensorHom
    (id_tensorHom_id := fun M N => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      exact TensorProduct.ext rfl)
    (tensorHom_comp_tensorHom := fun f g h k => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      exact TensorProduct.ext rfl)
    (associator_naturality := fun f g h => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
      intro x y z
      rfl)
    (leftUnitor_naturality := fun f => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply TensorProduct.ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro r
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      exact (f.hom.map_smul r.down x).symm)
    (rightUnitor_naturality := fun f => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply TensorProduct.ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro r
      exact (f.hom.map_smul r.down x).symm)
    (pentagon := fun W X Y Z => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply TensorProduct.ext_fourfold
      intro w x y z
      rfl)
    (triangle := fun M N => by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
      intro m r n
      exact TensorProduct.tmul_smul r.down m n)

/-- The actual tensor morphism is the original native tensor linear map. -/
theorem hom_tensorHom {K L M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} R}
    (f : K ⟶ L) (g : M ⟶ N) :
    (f ⊗ₘ g).hom = TensorProduct.map f.hom g.hom := rfl

/-- The actual left whiskering is the original tensor linear map. -/
theorem hom_whiskerLeft (L : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
    {M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (L ◁ f).hom = f.hom.lTensor L := rfl

/-- The actual right whiskering is the original tensor linear map. -/
theorem hom_whiskerRight {L M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R}
    (f : L ⟶ M) (N : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) :
    (f ▷ N).hom = f.hom.rTensor N := rfl

/-- The canonical tensor remains additive on the original modules. -/
scoped instance monoidalPreadditive : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerLeft]
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerRight]
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerLeft]
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerRight]

/-- The canonical tensor is linear over the original ring. -/
scoped instance monoidalLinear : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerLeft]
  · intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    refine TensorProduct.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_)
    simp [hom_whiskerRight]

/-- The original native tensor commutation is the braiding in the larger
coefficient universe. -/
scoped instance symmetricCategory : SymmetricCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) where
  braiding M N := (TensorProduct.comm R M N).toModuleIso
  braiding_naturality_left := by
    intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    rfl
  braiding_naturality_right := by
    intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    rfl
  hexagon_forward := by
    intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
    intros
    rfl
  hexagon_reverse := by
    intro X Y Z
    apply (cancel_epi (α_ X Y Z).hom).mp
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
    intros
    rfl
  symmetry := by
    intros
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply TensorProduct.ext
    rfl

/-- The larger coefficient category keeps the original ring tensor
linear map on every pair of original modules. -/
theorem tensorHom_tmul {K L M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} R}
    (f : K ⟶ L) (g : M ⟶ N) (x : K) (y : M) :
    (f ⊗ₘ g) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = f x ⊗ₜ[R] g y := rfl

/-- The actual left unitor uses only the canonical down scalar. -/
theorem leftUnitor_tmul (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
    (r : ULift.{v} R) (m : M) : (λ_ M).hom (r ⊗ₜ[R] m) = r.down • m := rfl

/-- The actual right unitor uses only the canonical down scalar. -/
theorem rightUnitor_tmul (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
    (m : M) (r : ULift.{v} R) : (ρ_ M).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] r) = r.down • m := rfl

end ModuleCat.UniverseTensor

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Monoidal.Universe

/-!
# Inverse unitors for the canonical larger-universe module tensor

These are computation laws for the actual UniverseTensor unitors. The
inverse inserts the lifted unit scalar; the original ring and module
actions remain unchanged. The dictionaries are fixed canonical data,
not assumptions supplied by a caller.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace ModuleCat.UniverseTensor

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]

theorem leftUnitor_inv_apply (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (x : X) :
    letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
    (λ_ X).inv.hom x = (ULift.up (1 : R) : ULift.{v} R) ⊗ₜ[R] x := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  apply (λ_ X).toLinearEquiv.injective
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (λ_ X).inv_hom_id
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at hx
  change (λ_ X).hom.hom ((λ_ X).inv.hom x) = (λ_ X).hom.hom (ULift.up (1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] x)
  rw [leftUnitor_tmul, one_smul]
  exact hx

theorem rightUnitor_inv_apply (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (x : X) :
    letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
    letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
    (ρ_ X).inv.hom x = x ⊗ₜ[R] (ULift.up (1 : R) : ULift.{v} R) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  apply (ρ_ X).toLinearEquiv.injective
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (ρ_ X).inv_hom_id
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at hx
  change (ρ_ X).hom.hom ((ρ_ X).inv.hom x) = (ρ_ X).hom.hom (x ⊗ₜ[R] ULift.up (1 : R))
  rw [rightUnitor_tmul, one_smul]
  exact hx

end ModuleCat.UniverseTensor

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.ChangeOfRings
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Map

/-!
# Actual ring-equivalence tensor transport in an independent module world

The stock scalar restriction equivalence preserves the original two
carriers. Native semilinear `TensorProduct.congr` identifies their actual
balanced tensors over the two scalar rings. The ring worlds and the common
module world are independent; the output world is explicitly large enough
for both scalar rings. No monoidal unit or desired tensor certificate is
an input.

The native semilinear proof is the one used in the retained
`ModuleCat/RingEquivTensor.lean`; the latter's monoidal wrapper has a real
same-world signature. This declaration exposes the independent-world
balanced tensor itself rather than instantiating that wrapper by cumulativity.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v w

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse

variable {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)


/-- The actual restriction-of-scalars tensor comparison, built from the
two native semilinear identity carrier equivalences. -/
def tensorIso (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v w} S) :
    ModuleCat.of R (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj M) ⊗[R] ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max
      u v w} e.toRingHom).obj N)) ≅
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj (ModuleCat.of S (M ⊗[S] N)) := by
  let M₀ := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj M
  let N₀ := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj N
  let Z₀ := ModuleCat.of R (M₀ ⊗[R] N₀)
  let Z₁ := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj (ModuleCat.of S (M ⊗[S] N))
  letI : RingHomInvPair e.toRingHom e.symm.toRingHom := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  letI : RingHomInvPair e.symm.toRingHom e.toRingHom :=
    RingHomInvPair.symm e.toRingHom e.symm.toRingHom
  let f : LinearEquiv e.toRingHom (σ' := e.symm.toRingHom) M₀ M :=
    { toFun := id
      invFun := id
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  let g : LinearEquiv e.toRingHom (σ' := e.symm.toRingHom) N₀ N :=
    { toFun := id
      invFun := id
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  let q := TensorProduct.congr (σ₂₁ := e.symm.toRingHom) f g
  let l : Z₀ ≃ₗ[R] Z₁ :=
    { __ := q.toAddEquiv
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        change q (r • x) = e r • q x
        exact q.map_smulₛₗ r x }
  exact l.toModuleIso

theorem tensorIso_hom_tmul (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v w} S)
    (m : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj M)
    (n : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj N) :
    (tensorIso e M N).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = m ⊗ₜ[S] n := rfl

theorem tensorIso_inv_tmul (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v w} S) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tensorIso e M N).inv (m ⊗ₜ[S] n) =
      (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj M from m) ⊗ₜ[R]
        (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).obj N from n) := rfl

/-- The canonical comparison is natural in both original module maps. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem tensorIso_naturality {M N M' N' : ModuleCat.{max u v w} S}
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).map f).hom
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).map g).hom) ≫
      (tensorIso e M' N').hom =
    (tensorIso e M N).hom ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v w} e.toRingHom).map (ModuleCat.ofHom
      (TensorProduct.map f.hom g.hom)) := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m n
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    tensorIso_hom_tmul]
  rfl

end ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.RingEquivTensorUniverse
public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Monoidal.Universe
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Abelian
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Functor
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ShortComplex.PreservesHomology

/-!
# Scalar restriction from the actual lifted ring to the original ring

For `R : Type u`, the ring `ULift.{v} R` actually inhabits `Type (max u v)`.
Native same-world module tensor over that lifted ring is transported to
the original `R` tensor in `ModuleCat.{max u v} R`. The target dictionary
is the existing UniverseTensor dictionary at offset exactly `v`; its
unit is precisely `ULift.{v} R`. Thus the unit comparison is an earned
linear identity carrier equivalence, not a universe-cumulativity shortcut.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits MonoidalCategory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace ModuleCat.UniverseScalarRestriction

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]

/-- The actual coefficient ring in the actual common carrier world. -/
abbrev LiftedRing : Type (max u v) := ULift.{v} R

/-- The original scalar module category with the fixed offset-v unit dictionary. -/
def Modules := ModuleCat.{max u v} R


instance category : Category (Modules.{u,v} R) := inferInstanceAs (Category (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
instance coeSort : CoeSort (Modules.{u,v} R) (Type (max u v)) :=
  ⟨fun M => (show ModuleCat.{max u v} R from M).carrier⟩
instance addCommGroup (M : Modules.{u,v} R) : AddCommGroup M :=
  (show ModuleCat.{max u v} R from M).isAddCommGroup
instance module (M : Modules.{u,v} R) : Module R M :=
  (show ModuleCat.{max u v} R from M).isModule
instance concreteCategory : ConcreteCategory (Modules.{u,v} R) (fun M N => M →ₗ[R] N) :=
  inferInstanceAs (ConcreteCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (fun M N => M →ₗ[R] N))
instance preadditive : Preadditive (Modules.{u,v} R) := inferInstanceAs (Preadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
instance abelian : Abelian (Modules.{u,v} R) := inferInstanceAs (Abelian (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
instance linear : Linear R (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Linear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
instance tensorStructure : MonoidalCategoryStruct (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
instance monoidalCategory : MonoidalCategory (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
instance monoidalPreadditive : MonoidalPreadditive (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
instance monoidalLinear : MonoidalLinear R (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
instance symmetricCategory : SymmetricCategory (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.symmetricCategory.{u,v} (R := R)

/-- The actual up ring equivalence; the scalar ring is not replaced in the target. -/
def scalarEquiv : R ≃+* (LiftedRing.{u,v} R) := (ULift.ringEquiv : (LiftedRing.{u,v} R) ≃+* R).symm

/-- Native scalar restriction to the original ring, in the actual common world. -/
def toOriginal : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R) ⥤ (Modules.{u,v} R) := ModuleCat.restrictScalars
  (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R).toRingHom

instance toOriginal_additive : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).Additive where
  map_add := by intros; rfl

instance toOriginal_isEquivalence : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).IsEquivalence := by
  unfold toOriginal
  exact ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isEquivalence_of_ringEquiv (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R)

instance toOriginal_preservesHomology : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).PreservesHomology := by
  infer_instance


/-- The actual offset-v unit map uses the identity on the lifted carrier,
with scalar compatibility checked through the actual up multiplication. -/
def unitIso : 𝟙_ (Modules.{u,v} R) ≅
    (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R))) := by
  let X : Modules.{u,v} R := 𝟙_ (Modules.{u,v} R)
  let Y : Modules.{u,v} R :=
    (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)))
  let e : X ≃ₗ[R] Y :=
    { toFun := id
      invFun := id
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x => by cases x; rfl }
  exact e.toModuleIso

@[simp]
theorem unitIso_hom_value (x : ULift.{v} R) : (unitIso.{u,v} R).hom x = x := rfl

@[simp]
theorem unitIso_inv_value (x : ULift.{v} R) : (unitIso.{u,v} R).inv x = x := rfl

/-- The native balanced tensor comparison uses both original factor values,
with the actual low and high scalar rings. -/
def tensorIso (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)) : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M ⊗
  (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj N ≅ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj (M ⊗ N) :=
  ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse.tensorIso.{u,max u v,0} (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R) M N

@[simp]
theorem tensorIso_hom_tmul (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R))
    (m : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M) (n : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj N) :
    (tensorIso.{u,v} R M N).hom (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = m ⊗ₜ[(LiftedRing.{u,v} R)] n :=
  ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse.tensorIso_hom_tmul (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R) M N m n

@[simp]
theorem tensorIso_inv_tmul (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tensorIso.{u,v} R M N).inv (m ⊗ₜ[(LiftedRing.{u,v} R)] n) =
      (show (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M from m) ⊗ₜ[R]
        (show (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj N from n) :=
  ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse.tensorIso_inv_tmul (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R) M N m n

@[reassoc]
theorem tensorIso_naturality {M N M' N' : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map f ⊗ₘ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map g) ≫ (tensorIso.{u,v} R M' N').hom =
      (tensorIso.{u,v} R M N).hom ≫ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map (f ⊗ₘ g) :=
  ModuleCat.RingEquivUniverse.tensorIso_naturality (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R) f g

/-- The actual module scalar restriction is strong monoidal. Its tensor,
unit and associator laws are checked on original pure tensors. -/
def monoidal : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).Monoidal :=
  (show (toOriginal.{u,v} R).CoreMonoidal from
    { εIso := unitIso.{u,v} R
      μIso := tensorIso.{u,v} R
      μIso_hom_natural_left := fun f M => by
        have ht := congrArg (fun z => (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map f ⊗ₘ z)
          ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map_id M)
        have hw := ht.trans (tensorHom_id ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map f)
          ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M))
        exact (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (tensorIso.{u,v} R _ M).hom) hw).symm.trans
          (tensorIso_naturality.{u,v} R f (𝟙 M))
      μIso_hom_natural_right := fun M f => by
        have ht := congrArg (fun z => z ⊗ₘ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map f)
          ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map_id M)
        have hw := ht.trans (id_tensorHom ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M)
          ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map f))
        exact (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (tensorIso.{u,v} R M _).hom) hw).symm.trans
          (tensorIso_naturality.{u,v} R (𝟙 M) f)
      associativity := fun M N P => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
        intro m n p
        rfl
      left_unitality := fun M => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply TensorProduct.ext'
        intro r m
        cases r
        rfl
      right_unitality := fun M => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply TensorProduct.ext'
        intro m r
        cases r
        rfl }).toMonoidal

/-- The same actual tensor comparison preserves the native symmetric
module interchange; no new sign convention is introduced. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem tensorIso_braiding (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)) :
    (tensorIso.{u,v} R M N).hom ≫ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map (β_ M N).hom =
      (β_ ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj N)).hom ≫ (tensorIso.{u,v} R N M).hom := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m n
  rfl

end ModuleCat.UniverseScalarRestriction

module

public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.UniverseScalarRestriction
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Monoidal.Closed
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Basic
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Closed.Braided

/-!
# Actual tensor exactness in the original larger coefficient world

Scalar restriction along the actual up/down ring equivalence is an exact
equivalence. The original tensor-left functor is compared to inverse scalar
restriction, native lifted-ring tensor-left, and scalar restriction back.
That actual comparison gives its adjunction and hence native colimit
preservation. No right-exactness or Künneth certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits MonoidalCategory

namespace ModuleCat.UniverseScalarRestriction

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]


/-- The native ring-equivalence module equivalence in the actual common world. -/
def moduleEquivalence : (ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)) ≌ (Modules.{u,v} R) :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv (scalarEquiv.{u,v} R)

/-- The actual inverse restriction of scalars, with coefficient action through down. -/
def toLifted : (Modules.{u,v} R) ⥤ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (LiftedRing.{u,v} R)) := (moduleEquivalence.{u,v} R).inverse


/-- The actual counit isomorphism of the original module representation. -/
def originalModuleIso (M : (Modules.{u,v} R)) : (toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ≅ M :=
  (moduleEquivalence.{u,v} R).counitIso.app M

@[reassoc]
theorem originalModuleIso_inv_naturality {M N : (Modules.{u,v} R)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N).inv =
      (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ≫ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map ((toLifted.{u,v} R).map f) :=
  (moduleEquivalence.{u,v} R).counitIso.inv.naturality f

/-- The actual tensor-left functor is a conjugate of native tensor over
the actual lifted ring. Its comparison uses earned scalar/tensor isomorphisms. -/
def tensorLeftComparison (M : (Modules.{u,v} R)) :
    tensorLeft M ≅ (toLifted.{u,v} R) ⋙ tensorLeft ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ⋙ (toOriginal.{u,v} R) :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun N =>
    ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).symm ⊗ᵢ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N).symm) ≪≫
      tensorIso.{u,v} R ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj N)) (by
        intro N N' f
        have ht : (𝟙 M ⊗ₘ f) ≫
            ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ⊗ₘ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N').inv) =
            ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ⊗ₘ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N).inv) ≫
              (𝟙 ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).obj ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M)) ⊗ₘ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map
                ((toLifted.{u,v} R).map f)) := by
          rw [tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
          simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, originalModuleIso_inv_naturality]
        change ((𝟙 M ⊗ₘ f) ≫
            ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ⊗ₘ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N').inv)) ≫
            (tensorIso.{u,v} R ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj N')).hom =
          ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ⊗ₘ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N).inv) ≫
            (tensorIso.{u,v} R ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj N)).hom ≫
              (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map (𝟙 ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ⊗ₘ (toLifted.{u,v} R).map f)
        have hn := tensorIso_naturality.{u,v} R
          (𝟙 ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M)) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).map f)
        have hi := congrArg (fun z => z ⊗ₘ (toOriginal.{u,v} R).map ((toLifted.{u,v} R).map f))
          ((toOriginal.{u,v} R).map_id ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M))
        have hn' := (congrArg (fun z => z ≫
          (tensorIso.{u,v} R ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj N')).hom)
            hi).symm.trans hn
        exact (congrArg (fun z => z ≫
          (tensorIso.{u,v} R ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj N')).hom)
            ht).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
              (congrArg (fun z =>
                ((originalModuleIso.{u,v} R M).inv ⊗ₘ (originalModuleIso.{u,v} R N).inv) ≫ z)
                  hn')))


/-- The actual original-ring tensor-left adjunction is transported from
the native lifted-ring tensor-left adjunction through an actual functor isomorphism. -/
def closed (M : (Modules.{u,v} R)) : Closed M := by
  let J := (toLifted.{u,v} R) ⋙ tensorLeft ((toLifted.{u,v} R).obj M) ⋙ (toOriginal.{u,v} R)
  letI : (toLifted.{u,v} R).IsEquivalence := (moduleEquivalence.{u,v} R).symm.isEquivalence_functor
  letI : J.IsLeftAdjoint := inferInstance
  exact
    { rightAdj := J.rightAdjoint
      adj := (Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint J).ofNatIsoLeft (tensorLeftComparison.{u,v} R M).symm }

instance monoidalClosed : MonoidalClosed (Modules.{u,v} R) where
  closed M := closed.{u,v} R M

end ModuleCat.UniverseScalarRestriction

module

public import MathlibExt.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialObject.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.DomCoprod
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Finite

/-!
# Native shuffle cosets and ordered shuffles

The native cosets modulo permutations within each of two blocks are in
bijection with the existing ordered shuffle type. The map records the
actual set of left-block positions. Its inverse is the existing ordered
shuffle representative, conjugated by `finSumFinEquiv`. Empty blocks are
included. This is a counting-free identification, with no factorial division.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle

open Function

variable (p q : ℕ)

local notation "B" => Fin p ⊕ Fin q
local notation "e" => (finSumFinEquiv : B ≃ Fin (p + q))

/-- The actual left positions of an arbitrary block permutation. -/
def blockLeftPositions (σ : Equiv.Perm B) : Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p :=
  Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmb p _
    ⟨fun i => e (σ (Sum.inl i)),
      (finSumFinEquiv : B ≃ Fin (p + q)).injective.comp (σ.injective.comp Sum.inl_injective)⟩

@[simp]
theorem mem_blockLeftPositions (σ : Equiv.Perm B) (k : Fin (p + q)) :
    k ∈ blockLeftPositions p q σ ↔ ∃ i : Fin p, e (σ (Sum.inl i)) = k := by
  rw [blockLeftPositions, Set.powersetCard.mem_ofFinEmb_iff_mem_range]
  rfl

theorem blockLeftPositions_rel (σ τ : Equiv.Perm B)
    (h : QuotientGroup.leftRel (Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom (Fin p) (Fin q)).range σ τ) :
    blockLeftPositions p q σ = blockLeftPositions p q τ := by
  rw [QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨sl, sr⟩, h⟩ := h
  replace h := inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp h.symm
  rw [h]
  apply SetLike.ext
  intro k
  simp only [mem_blockLeftPositions, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply,
    Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨sl.symm i, by simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨sl i, hi⟩

/-- The actual left-position map on native shuffle cosets. -/
def cosetLeftPositions (c : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q)) :
    Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p :=
  Quotient.liftOn' c (blockLeftPositions p q) (blockLeftPositions_rel p q)

@[simp]
theorem cosetLeftPositions_mk (σ : Equiv.Perm B) :
    cosetLeftPositions p q (Quotient.mk'' σ) = blockLeftPositions p q σ := rfl

/-- The existing ordered shuffle represented on the native block-sum index. -/
def cosetRepresentative (s : Shuffle p q) : Equiv.Perm B :=
  (Equiv.permCongr e).symm s.perm

theorem cosetRepresentative_congr (s : Shuffle p q) :
    (finSumFinEquiv : B ≃ Fin (p + q)).permCongr (cosetRepresentative p q s) = s.perm :=
  (Equiv.permCongr e).apply_symm_apply s.perm

@[simp]
theorem cosetRepresentative_front (s : Shuffle p q) (i : Fin p) :
    e (cosetRepresentative p q s (Sum.inl i)) = s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + q)) => σ (e (Sum.inl i)))
    (cosetRepresentative_congr p q s)
  simpa only [Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd] using h

@[simp]
theorem cosetRepresentative_back (s : Shuffle p q) (i : Fin q) :
    e (cosetRepresentative p q s (Sum.inr i)) = s.perm (Fin.natAdd p i) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + q)) => σ (e (Sum.inr i)))
    (cosetRepresentative_congr p q s)
  simpa only [Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd] using h

theorem cosetRepresentative_sign (s : Shuffle p q) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign (cosetRepresentative p q s) = Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm := by
  rw [← cosetRepresentative_congr p q s]
  exact (Equiv.Perm.sign_permCongr e (cosetRepresentative p q s)).symm

theorem blockLeftPositions_representative (s : Shuffle p q) :
    blockLeftPositions p q (cosetRepresentative p q s) = s.leftPositions := by
  apply SetLike.ext
  intro k
  simp only [mem_blockLeftPositions, cosetRepresentative_front, mem_leftPositions_iff]

/-- Equal left positions imply equal native shuffle cosets. -/
theorem cosetLeftPositions_injective : Function.Injective (cosetLeftPositions p q) := by
  intro c d hcd
  induction c using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ σ =>
    induction d using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | _ τ =>
      simp only [cosetLeftPositions_mk] at hcd
      rw [Quotient.eq'', QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply]
      apply Equiv.Perm.mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hi : e (τ (Sum.inl i)) ∈ blockLeftPositions p q σ := by
        rw [hcd, mem_blockLeftPositions]
        exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (mem_blockLeftPositions p q σ _).mp hi
      have hj' : σ (Sum.inl j) = τ (Sum.inl i) := (finSumFinEquiv : B ≃ Fin (p + q)).injective hj
      refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
      apply σ.injective
      simp only [Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hj'.trans (σ.apply_symm_apply (τ (Sum.inl i))).symm

/-- The existing ordered representative reaches every finite left-position set. -/
theorem cosetLeftPositions_surjective : Function.Surjective (cosetLeftPositions p q) := by
  intro a
  refine ⟨Quotient.mk'' (cosetRepresentative p q (ofLeftPositions a)), ?_⟩
  rw [cosetLeftPositions_mk, blockLeftPositions_representative, leftPositions_ofLeftPositions]

/-- The canonical ordered-position equivalence of the actual shuffle coset. -/
def cosetPositionsEquiv : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q) ≃
    Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (cosetLeftPositions p q)
    ⟨cosetLeftPositions_injective p q, cosetLeftPositions_surjective p q⟩

/-- The native coset index agrees with the existing actual ordered-shuffle index. -/
def cosetEquiv : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q) ≃ Shuffle p q :=
  (cosetPositionsEquiv p q).trans equivLeftPositions.symm

@[simp]
theorem cosetEquiv_symm_apply (s : Shuffle p q) :
    (cosetEquiv p q).symm s = Quotient.mk'' (cosetRepresentative p q s) := by
  apply cosetLeftPositions_injective p q
  change (cosetPositionsEquiv p q) ((cosetPositionsEquiv p q).symm s.leftPositions) =
    cosetLeftPositions p q (Quotient.mk'' (cosetRepresentative p q s))
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, cosetLeftPositions_mk, blockLeftPositions_representative]

end AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle

module

public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupExtension.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Ker
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Subgroup.Center
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.IsPerfect

/-! # Central group extensions

Centrality and universality predicates, with uniqueness of lifts from perfect groups.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w u' v'

namespace GroupExtension

variable {N : Type u} {E : Type v} {G : Type w} [Group N] [Group E] [Group G]

/-- A group extension is central if the kernel of the projection lies in the center. -/
def IsCentral (S : GroupExtension N E G) : Prop :=
  S.rightHom.ker ≤ Subgroup.center E

/-- Universality among central extensions with explicitly chosen kernel and total universes. -/
def IsUniversalFor (S : GroupExtension N E G) : Prop :=
  S.IsCentral ∧ ∀ {N' : Type u'} {E' : Type v'} [Group N'] [Group E'] (S' : GroupExtension N' E' G),
    S'.IsCentral → ∃! f : E →* E', S'.rightHom.comp f = S.rightHom

/-- A central extension is universal if it is central and every central extension of the same group
in the fixed universes `u` and `v` receives a unique homomorphism commuting with the projections. -/
def IsUniversal (S : GroupExtension N E G) : Prop :=
  IsUniversalFor.{u, v, w, u, v} S

/-- The original universality predicate is the fixed-universe specialization. -/
theorem isUniversalFor_self_iff (S : GroupExtension N E G) :
    IsUniversalFor.{u, v, w, u, v} S ↔ S.IsUniversal := Iff.rfl

end GroupExtension

namespace MonoidHom

variable {P : Type u} {E : Type v} {G : Type w} [Group P] [Group E] [Group G]

open Subgroup
open scoped commutatorElement

/-- If `q` has central kernel and `q ∘ f = q ∘ g`, then `f = g` for perfect `P`. -/
theorem eq_of_comp_eq_of_ker_le_center {q : E →* G} (hq : q.ker ≤ Subgroup.center E)
    {f g : P →* E} (h : q.comp f = q.comp g) [hP : Group.IsPerfect P] : f = g := by
  have h_comm_le : commutator P ≤ f.eqLocus g := by
    rw [commutator_def, Subgroup.commutator_le]
    intro x _ y _
    change f ⁅x, y⁆ = g ⁅x, y⁆
    rw [map_commutatorElement, map_commutatorElement]
    let cx := f x * (g x)⁻¹
    let cy := f y * (g y)⁻¹
    have hq_eq : ∀ t : P, q (f t) = q (g t) := by
      intro t
      have ht := DFunLike.congr_fun h t
      simpa [MonoidHom.comp_apply] using ht
    have hcx_ker : cx ∈ q.ker := by
      rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
      change q (f x * (g x)⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, hq_eq x, mul_inv_cancel]
    have hcy_ker : cy ∈ q.ker := by
      rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
      change q (f y * (g y)⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, hq_eq y, mul_inv_cancel]
    have hcx_center : cx ∈ Subgroup.center E := hq hcx_ker
    have hcy_center : cy ∈ Subgroup.center E := hq hcy_ker
    have hcx_comm : ∀ a : E, Commute cx a := by
      intro a
      rw [commute_iff_eq]
      exact (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp hcx_center a).symm
    have hcy_comm : ∀ a : E, Commute cy a := by
      intro a
      rw [commute_iff_eq]
      exact (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp hcy_center a).symm
    -- re-express f x, f y
    have hfx : f x = cx * g x := by
      simp [cx]
    have hfy : f y = cy * g y := by
      simp [cy]
    rw [hfx, hfy]
    have h_comm_cx : ∀ b : E, ⁅cx, b⁆ = 1 := fun b => (hcx_comm b).commutator_eq
    have h_comm_cy : ∀ b : E, ⁅b, cy⁆ = 1 := fun b => ((hcy_comm b).symm).commutator_eq
    -- also need ⁅g x, cy⁆ = 1 via centrality of cy
    have h_gx_cy : ⁅g x, cy⁆ = 1 := h_comm_cy (g x)
    -- central conjugation collapses
    have h_conj_cx : ∀ b : E, cx * b * cx⁻¹ = b := fun b => (hcx_comm b).mul_inv_cancel
    have h_conj_cy : ∀ b : E, cy * b * cy⁻¹ = b := fun b => (hcy_comm b).mul_inv_cancel
    calc ⁅cx * g x, cy * g y⁆
        = cx * ⁅g x, cy * g y⁆ * cx⁻¹ * ⁅cx, cy * g y⁆ := by
            rw [commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul]
        _ = cx * ⁅g x, cy * g y⁆ * cx⁻¹ * 1 := by rw [h_comm_cx (cy * g y)]
        _ = cx * ⁅g x, cy * g y⁆ * cx⁻¹ := by rw [mul_one]
        _ = ⁅g x, cy * g y⁆ := by rw [h_conj_cx]
        _ = ⁅g x, cy⁆ * cy * ⁅g x, g y⁆ * cy⁻¹ := by
            rw [commutatorElement_mul_right_eq_mul_conj]
        _ = 1 * cy * ⁅g x, g y⁆ * cy⁻¹ := by rw [h_gx_cy]
        _ = cy * ⁅g x, g y⁆ * cy⁻¹ := by rw [one_mul]
        _ = ⁅g x, g y⁆ := by rw [h_conj_cy]
  have h_eqOn : Set.EqOn f g (⊤ : Subgroup P) := by
    intro x _
    have hx : x ∈ commutator P := Group.IsPerfect.mem_commutator
    have hx' : x ∈ f.eqLocus g := h_comm_le hx
    have hx_eq : f x = g x := by
      change f x = g x at hx'
      exact hx'
    exact hx_eq
  exact MonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_top h_eqOn

end MonoidHom

end

Author: @toskua, Avocado

module

public import MathlibExt.GroupTheory.CentralExtension
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupExtension.Defs
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Subgroup.Center
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Ker

/-! # Normalized central 2-cocycle extensions

Central extension constructed from a normalized multiplicative 2-cocycle
with trivial action.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w t u3 v3

namespace NormalizedCocycleExtension

variable {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]

/-- A normalized central (multiplicative) 2-cocycle `c : G → G → A`
with trivial action.

Fields:
- `cocycle g h` is the value `c g h`;
- `one_left : c 1 g = 1`;
- `one_right : c g 1 = 1`;
- `cocycle_assoc : c g h * c (g*h) k = c g (h*k) * c h k`. -/
structure NormalizedCocycle (G : Type u) (A : Type v)
    [Group G] [CommGroup A] where
  cocycle : G → G → A
  one_left : ∀ g : G, cocycle 1 g = 1
  one_right : ∀ g : G, cocycle g 1 = 1
  cocycle_assoc :
    ∀ g h k : G, cocycle g h * cocycle (g * h) k =
      cocycle g (h * k) * cocycle h k

instance : CoeFun (NormalizedCocycle G A) (fun _ => G → G → A) where
  coe c := c.cocycle

@[simp]
theorem cocycle_one_left (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g : G) :
    c.cocycle 1 g = 1 :=
  c.one_left g

@[simp]
theorem cocycle_one_right (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g : G) :
    c.cocycle g 1 = 1 :=
  c.one_right g

@[simp]
theorem coe_one_left (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g : G) :
    (c : G → G → A) 1 g = 1 :=
  c.one_left g

@[simp]
theorem coe_one_right (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g : G) :
    (c : G → G → A) g 1 = 1 :=
  c.one_right g

theorem cocycle_assoc' (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g h k : G) :
    c.cocycle g h * c.cocycle (g * h) k =
      c.cocycle g (h * k) * c.cocycle h k :=
  c.cocycle_assoc g h k

theorem cocycle_assoc_coe (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g h k : G) :
    (c : G → G → A) g h * (c : G → G → A) (g * h) k =
      (c : G → G → A) g (h * k) * (c : G → G → A) h k :=
  c.cocycle_assoc g h k

@[simp]
theorem cocycle_one_one (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) :
    c.cocycle 1 1 = (1 : A) :=
  c.one_left 1

theorem cocycle_inv_eq {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
    (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (g : G) :
    c.cocycle g g⁻¹ = c.cocycle g⁻¹ g := by
  simpa [mul_inv_cancel, inv_mul_cancel, c.one_left, c.one_right]
    using c.cocycle_assoc g g⁻¹ g

section Extension

structure Extension {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
    (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) where
  base : G
  coeff : A
  deriving DecidableEq

@[ext]
theorem Extension.ext {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
    {c : NormalizedCocycle G A} {x y : Extension c}
    (hbase : x.base = y.base) (hcoeff : x.coeff = y.coeff) : x = y := by
  cases x; cases y; simp_all

variable {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
  (c : NormalizedCocycle G A)

instance : Mul (Extension c) where
  mul x y := ⟨x.base * y.base, x.coeff * y.coeff * c.cocycle x.base y.base⟩

instance : One (Extension c) where
  one := ⟨1, 1⟩

instance : Inv (Extension c) where
  inv x := ⟨x.base⁻¹, x.coeff⁻¹ * (c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base)⁻¹⟩

@[simp]
theorem one_base : (1 : Extension c).base = (1 : G) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem one_coeff : (1 : Extension c).coeff = (1 : A) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem mul_base (x y : Extension c) :
    (x * y).base = x.base * y.base := rfl

@[simp]
theorem mul_coeff (x y : Extension c) :
    (x * y).coeff = x.coeff * y.coeff * c.cocycle x.base y.base := rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_base (x : Extension c) :
    (x⁻¹ : Extension c).base = x.base⁻¹ := rfl

theorem inv_coeff (x : Extension c) :
    (x⁻¹ : Extension c).coeff =
      x.coeff⁻¹ * (c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base)⁻¹ := rfl

theorem inv_coeff' (x : Extension c) :
    (x⁻¹ : Extension c).coeff =
      x.coeff⁻¹ * (c.cocycle x.base x.base⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
  rw [inv_coeff, cocycle_inv_eq c x.base]

instance : Group (Extension c) where
  mul_assoc x y z := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp [mul_assoc]
    · simp only [mul_coeff, mul_base]
      have h := c.cocycle_assoc x.base y.base z.base
      calc x.coeff * y.coeff * c.cocycle x.base y.base * z.coeff *
            c.cocycle (x.base * y.base) z.base
          = x.coeff * y.coeff * z.coeff *
              (c.cocycle x.base y.base * c.cocycle (x.base * y.base) z.base) := by
            ac_rfl
        _ = x.coeff * y.coeff * z.coeff *
              (c.cocycle x.base (y.base * z.base) * c.cocycle y.base z.base) := by
            rw [h]
        _ = x.coeff * (y.coeff * z.coeff * c.cocycle y.base z.base) *
              c.cocycle x.base (y.base * z.base) := by
            ac_rfl
  one_mul x := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_coeff, one_base, one_coeff, c.one_left]
      simp [mul_one]
  mul_one x := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_coeff, one_base, one_coeff, c.one_right]
      simp [mul_one]
  inv_mul_cancel x := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_coeff, inv_coeff, inv_base]
      calc x.coeff⁻¹ * (c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base)⁻¹ * x.coeff *
            c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base
          = x.coeff⁻¹ * x.coeff *
              ((c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base)⁻¹ * c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base) := by
            ac_rfl
        _ = 1 * ((c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base)⁻¹ * c.cocycle x.base⁻¹ x.base) := by
            rw [inv_mul_cancel]
        _ = 1 := by
            rw [one_mul, inv_mul_cancel]

def projHom : Extension c →* G where
  toFun x := x.base
  map_one' := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl

@[simp]
theorem projHom_apply (x : Extension c) : projHom c x = x.base := rfl

@[simp]
theorem projHom_one : projHom c (1 : Extension c) = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem projHom_mul (x y : Extension c) :
    projHom c (x * y) = projHom c x * projHom c y := rfl

def inlHom : A →* Extension c where
  toFun a := ⟨1, a⟩
  map_one' := rfl
  map_mul' a b := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_coeff]
      have h : c.cocycle 1 1 = (1 : A) := c.one_left 1
      simp [h, mul_one]

@[simp]
theorem inlHom_base (a : A) : (inlHom c a).base = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem inlHom_coeff (a : A) : (inlHom c a).coeff = a := rfl

def extension : GroupExtension A (Extension c) G where
  inl := inlHom c
  rightHom := projHom c
  inl_injective := by
    intro a b h
    have hcoeff : (inlHom c a).coeff = (inlHom c b).coeff :=
      congrArg Extension.coeff h
    simpa using hcoeff
  range_inl_eq_ker_rightHom := by
    ext x
    simp only [MonoidHom.mem_range, MonoidHom.mem_ker, projHom]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rfl
    · intro hx
      change x.base = 1 at hx
      exact ⟨x.coeff, by
        apply Extension.ext
        · simpa using hx.symm
        · rfl⟩
  rightHom_surjective := by
    intro g
    exact ⟨⟨g, 1⟩, rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem extension_inl (a : A) : (extension c).inl a = inlHom c a := rfl

@[simp]
theorem extension_rightHom (x : Extension c) :
    (extension c).rightHom x = projHom c x := rfl

theorem isCentral : (extension c).IsCentral := by
  intro x hx
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, extension_rightHom] at hx
  change x.base = 1 at hx
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro y
  apply Extension.ext
  · simp [hx, mul_one, one_mul]
  · simp only [mul_coeff, hx]
    have h1 : c.cocycle y.base 1 = (1 : A) := c.one_right y.base
    have h2 : c.cocycle 1 y.base = (1 : A) := c.one_left y.base
    calc y.coeff * x.coeff * c.cocycle y.base 1
        = y.coeff * x.coeff := by rw [h1, mul_one]
      _ = x.coeff * y.coeff := by rw [mul_comm]
      _ = x.coeff * y.coeff * c.cocycle 1 y.base := by rw [h2, mul_one]

end Extension

end NormalizedCocycleExtension

section Functoriality

namespace NormalizedCocycleExtension

/-- Compatible map between normalized cocycles.

Data:
- `f : G →* G'` (base hom);
- `g : A →* A'` (coefficient hom);
- `q : G → A'` with `q 1 = 1`;
- `compat : g (c x y) * q (x*y) = q x * q y * d (f x) (f y)`.

Induced map is `(x,a) ↦ (f x, g a * q x)`. -/
structure CompatibleMap {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    (c : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁) (d : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂) where
  f : G₁ →* G₂
  g : A₁ →* A₂
  q : G₁ → A₂
  q_one : q 1 = 1
  compat :
    ∀ x y : G₁, g (c.cocycle x y) * q (x * y) =
      q x * q y * d.cocycle (f x) (f y)

variable {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
variable {G' : Type w} {A' : Type t} [Group G'] [CommGroup A']
variable {c : NormalizedCocycle G A} {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'}

def CompatibleMap.baseHom {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) : G →* G' :=
  h.f

def CompatibleMap.coeffHom {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) : A →* A' :=
  h.g

def CompatibleMap.correction {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) : G → A' :=
  h.q

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.q_one' {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) :
    h.q 1 = 1 :=
  h.q_one

theorem CompatibleMap.compat' {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) (x y : G) :
    h.g (c.cocycle x y) * h.q (x * y) =
      h.q x * h.q y * d.cocycle (h.f x) (h.f y) :=
  h.compat x y

theorem CompatibleMap.compat_coe {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) (x y : G) :
    h.g ((c : G → G → A) x y) * h.q (x * y) =
      h.q x * h.q y * (d : G' → G' → A') (h.f x) (h.f y) :=
  h.compat x y

def CompatibleMap.toHom {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) :
    Extension c →* Extension d where
  toFun x := ⟨h.f x.base, h.g x.coeff * h.q x.base⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp [h.f.map_one]
    · simp [h.g.map_one, h.q_one]
  map_mul' x y := by
    apply Extension.ext
    · simp [map_mul]
    · calc h.g (x.coeff * y.coeff * c.cocycle x.base y.base) * h.q (x.base * y.base)
          = h.g x.coeff * h.g y.coeff * h.g (c.cocycle x.base y.base) *
              h.q (x.base * y.base) := by
            simp [map_mul]
        _ = h.g x.coeff * h.g y.coeff *
              (h.g (c.cocycle x.base y.base) * h.q (x.base * y.base)) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = h.g x.coeff * h.g y.coeff *
              (h.q x.base * h.q y.base * d.cocycle (h.f x.base) (h.f y.base)) := by
            rw [h.compat x.base y.base]
        _ = (h.g x.coeff * h.q x.base) * (h.g y.coeff * h.q y.base) *
              d.cocycle (h.f x.base) (h.f y.base) := by
            simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_base {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d)
    (x : Extension c) : (h.toHom x).base = h.f x.base := rfl

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_coeff {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d)
    (x : Extension c) :
    (h.toHom x).coeff = h.g x.coeff * h.q x.base := rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_inl {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) (a : A) :
    h.toHom (inlHom c a) = inlHom d (h.g a) := by
  apply Extension.ext
  · simp [h.f.map_one]
  · simp [h.q_one]

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_inl_coeff {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) (a : A) :
    (h.toHom (inlHom c a)).coeff = h.g a := by
  simp [CompatibleMap.toHom_inl]

theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_proj {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d)
    (x : Extension c) :
    projHom d (h.toHom x) = h.f (projHom c x) := rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.comp_proj {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) :
    (projHom d).comp h.toHom = h.f.comp (projHom c) := by
  ext x; rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.inl_comp {c : NormalizedCocycle G A}
    {d : NormalizedCocycle G' A'} (h : CompatibleMap c d) :
    h.toHom.comp (inlHom c) = (inlHom d).comp h.g := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a
  exact CompatibleMap.toHom_inl h a

def CompatibleMap.id {G : Type u} {A : Type v} [Group G] [CommGroup A]
    (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) : CompatibleMap c c where
  f := MonoidHom.id G
  g := MonoidHom.id A
  q := fun _ => 1
  q_one := rfl
  compat x y := by
    simp only [MonoidHom.id_apply, mul_one, one_mul]

theorem CompatibleMap.id_f (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) :
    (CompatibleMap.id c).f = MonoidHom.id G := by
  rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.id_g (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) :
    (CompatibleMap.id c).g = MonoidHom.id A := by
  rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.id_q (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) (x : G) :
    (CompatibleMap.id c).q x = 1 := by
  rfl

def CompatibleMap.comp {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃) :
    CompatibleMap c₁ c₃ where
  f := h₂.f.comp h₁.f
  g := h₂.g.comp h₁.g
  q x := h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x)
  q_one := by
    simp [h₁.q_one, h₂.q_one, map_one, h₁.f.map_one]
  compat x y := by
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply]
    have h1c := h₁.compat x y
    have h2c := h₂.compat (h₁.f x) (h₁.f y)
    calc h₂.g (h₁.g (c₁.cocycle x y)) *
          (h₂.g (h₁.q (x * y)) * h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)))
        = h₂.g (h₁.g (c₁.cocycle x y) * h₁.q (x * y)) *
            h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)) := by
          calc h₂.g (h₁.g (c₁.cocycle x y)) * (h₂.g (h₁.q (x * y)) * h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)))
              = h₂.g (h₁.g (c₁.cocycle x y)) * h₂.g (h₁.q (x * y)) * h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)) := by
                rw [mul_assoc]
            _ = h₂.g (h₁.g (c₁.cocycle x y) * h₁.q (x * y)) * h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)) := by
                rw [← (h₂.g : A₂ →* A₃).map_mul]
      _ = h₂.g (h₁.q x * h₁.q y * c₂.cocycle (h₁.f x) (h₁.f y)) *
            h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)) := by
          rw [h1c]
      _ = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) * h₂.g (c₂.cocycle (h₁.f x) (h₁.f y)) *
            h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y)) := by
          simp [map_mul]
      _ = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) *
            (h₂.g (c₂.cocycle (h₁.f x) (h₁.f y)) * h₂.q (h₁.f (x * y))) := by
          ac_rfl
      _ = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) *
            (h₂.g (c₂.cocycle (h₁.f x) (h₁.f y)) *
              h₂.q (h₁.f x * h₁.f y)) := by
          rw [map_mul (h₁.f)]
      _ = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) *
            (h₂.q (h₁.f x) * h₂.q (h₁.f y) *
              c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y))) := by
          rw [h2c]
      _ = (h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x)) *
            (h₂.g (h₁.q y) * h₂.q (h₁.f y)) *
            c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y)) := by
          calc h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) *
                (h₂.q (h₁.f x) * h₂.q (h₁.f y) *
                  c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y)))
              = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x) *
                (h₂.g (h₁.q y) * h₂.q (h₁.f y) *
                  c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y))) := by
                rw [show h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.g (h₁.q y) *
                    (h₂.q (h₁.f x) * h₂.q (h₁.f y) *
                      c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y))) =
                    h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x) *
                    (h₂.g (h₁.q y) * h₂.q (h₁.f y) *
                      c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y))) from by
                  ac_rfl]
            _ = (h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x)) *
                (h₂.g (h₁.q y) * h₂.q (h₁.f y)) *
                c₃.cocycle (h₂.f (h₁.f x)) (h₂.f (h₁.f y)) := by
                simp only [mul_assoc]

theorem CompatibleMap.comp_f {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃) :
    (h₁.comp h₂).f = h₂.f.comp h₁.f :=
  rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.comp_g {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃) :
    (h₁.comp h₂).g = h₂.g.comp h₁.g :=
  rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.comp_q {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃) (x : G₁) :
    (h₁.comp h₂).q x = h₂.g (h₁.q x) * h₂.q (h₁.f x) :=
  rfl

theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_id (c : NormalizedCocycle G A) :
    (CompatibleMap.id c).toHom = MonoidHom.id (Extension c) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Extension.ext
  · rfl
  · change (MonoidHom.id A) x.coeff * (1 : A) = x.coeff
    simp

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_id_apply (c : NormalizedCocycle G A)
    (x : Extension c) : (CompatibleMap.id c).toHom x = x := by
  have h := CompatibleMap.toHom_id c
  have hx : (CompatibleMap.id c).toHom x = MonoidHom.id (Extension c) x := by
    rw [h]
  simpa using hx

theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_comp {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃) :
    (h₁.comp h₂).toHom = (h₂.toHom).comp (h₁.toHom) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Extension.ext
  · simp [CompatibleMap.comp, MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  · simp only [CompatibleMap.toHom_coeff, CompatibleMap.comp_q,
        CompatibleMap.comp_g, MonoidHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
    ac_rfl

@[simp]
theorem CompatibleMap.toHom_comp_apply {G₁ : Type u} {A₁ : Type v} [Group G₁] [CommGroup A₁]
    {G₂ : Type w} {A₂ : Type t} [Group G₂] [CommGroup A₂]
    {G₃ : Type u3} {A₃ : Type v3} [Group G₃] [CommGroup A₃]
    {c₁ : NormalizedCocycle G₁ A₁} {c₂ : NormalizedCocycle G₂ A₂}
    {c₃ : NormalizedCocycle G₃ A₃}
    (h₁ : CompatibleMap c₁ c₂) (h₂ : CompatibleMap c₂ c₃)
    (x : Extension c₁) :
    (h₁.comp h₂).toHom x = h₂.toHom (h₁.toHom x) := by
  have h := CompatibleMap.toHom_comp h₁ h₂
  have hx : (h₁.comp h₂).toHom x = (h₂.toHom.comp h₁.toHom) x := by
    rw [h]
  exact hx

end NormalizedCocycleExtension

end Functoriality

public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Pi
