module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.CoalgebraTensorDegree

/-!
# Native triple tensor realization for the exterior coalgebra

Both parenthesizations are the actual native graded tensor objects under the
canonical UniverseTensor dictionaries. The right realization is a split
injection. The native associator agrees with the original tensor associator
under realization, and tensoring the actual coproduct agrees with the two
ordinary iterated coproducts. These equations supply native coassociativity.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

local notation "E" => ExteriorAlgebra R M
local notation "P" => E ⊗[R] E
local notation "𝓔" => gradedExterior R M
local notation "𝓣" => gradedTensorSquare R M
local notation "π" => exteriorPower.projection R M

/-- The right-associated actual native triple tensor degree. -/
def tripleRightDegree (n : ℕ) : (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObj 𝓔 𝓣 n

/-- The left-associated actual native triple tensor degree. -/
def tripleLeftDegree (n : ℕ) : (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObj 𝓣 𝓔 n

/-- The outer canonical inclusion for the right-parenthesized triple tensor. -/
def tripleRightOuterι (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    ModuleCat.of R ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] tensorDegree R M q) ⟶ tripleRightDegree R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ιTensorObj 𝓔 𝓣 p q n h

/-- The outer canonical inclusion for the left-parenthesized triple tensor. -/
def tripleLeftOuterι (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    ModuleCat.of R (tensorDegree R M p ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)) ⟶ tripleLeftDegree R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ιTensorObj 𝓣 𝓔 p q n h

/-- Realize the right-associated degree in the original three-factor tensor module. -/
def tripleRightRealize (n : ℕ) : tripleRightDegree R M n ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (E ⊗[R] P) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObjDesc (fun p q _ =>
    ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype (tensorDegreeRealize R M q).hom))

/-- Realize the left-associated degree, followed by the original associator. -/
def tripleLeftRealize (n : ℕ) : tripleLeftDegree R M n ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (E ⊗[R] P) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObjDesc (fun p q _ => ModuleCat.ofHom
    ((TensorProduct.assoc R E E E).toLinearMap.comp
      (TensorProduct.map (tensorDegreeRealize R M p).hom (⋀[R]^q M).subtype)))

@[reassoc]
theorem tripleRightOuterι_realize (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    tripleRightOuterι R M p q n h ≫ tripleRightRealize R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype (tensorDegreeRealize R M q).hom) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorObjDesc (X₁ := 𝓔) (X₂ := 𝓣) _ p q h

@[reassoc]
theorem tripleLeftOuterι_realize (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    tripleLeftOuterι R M p q n h ≫ tripleLeftRealize R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((TensorProduct.assoc R E E E).toLinearMap.comp
        (TensorProduct.map (tensorDegreeRealize R M p).hom (⋀[R]^q M).subtype)) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorObjDesc (X₁ := 𝓣) (X₂ := 𝓔) _ p q h

/-- The actual right-parenthesized lift of the third exterior degree. -/
def tripleRightLift (n : ℕ) : ModuleCat.of R (E ⊗[R] P) ⟶ tripleRightDegree R M n :=
  ∑ p : Fin (n + 1),
    ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (π p.val) (tensorDegreeLift R M (n - p.val)).hom) ≫
      tripleRightOuterι R M p.val (n - p.val) n
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.isLt))

/-- The actual triple realization is also a split injection; no tensor flatness is used. -/
theorem tripleRightRealize_lift (n : ℕ) :
    tripleRightRealize R M n ≫ tripleRightLift R M n = 𝟙 (tripleRightDegree R M n) := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  apply GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObj_ext
  intro i j hij
  change tripleRightOuterι R M i j n hij ≫ _ = tripleRightOuterι R M i j n hij ≫ 𝟙 _
  rw [tripleRightOuterι_realize_assoc]
  unfold tripleRightLift
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
  have hi : i < n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le.intro hij)
  let p : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hni : n - p.val = j := by change n - i = j; rw [← hij, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · have hmaps : (TensorProduct.map (π i) (tensorDegreeLift R M j).hom).comp
        (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^i M).subtype (tensorDegreeRealize R M j).hom) = LinearMap.id := by
      apply TensorProduct.ext'
      intro a t
      have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (tensorDegreeRealize_lift R M j)
      simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_id,
        LinearMap.id_apply] at ht
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
        exteriorPower.projection_subtype_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      rw [ht]
    subst j
    have hc : ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^i M).subtype
        (tensorDegreeRealize R M (n - p.val)).hom) ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (π i) (tensorDegreeLift R M (n - p.val)).hom) =
        𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R ((⋀[R]^i M) ⊗[R] tensorDegree R M (n - p.val))) := by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      exact hmaps
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z => z ≫ tripleRightOuterι R M i (n - p.val) n hij) hc).trans
        (Category.id_comp _))
  · intro q hq hqp
    have hiq : i ≠ q.val := fun hiq => hqp (Fin.ext hiq.symm)
    have hmaps : (TensorProduct.map (π q.val) (tensorDegreeLift R M (n - q.val)).hom).comp
        (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^i M).subtype (tensorDegreeRealize R M j).hom) = 0 := by
      apply TensorProduct.ext'
      intro a t
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
        exteriorPower.projection_eq_zero_of_mem R M q.val i hiq a a.property,
        TensorProduct.zero_tmul, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← ModuleCat.ofHom_comp, hmaps, ModuleCat.ofHom_zero,
      zero_comp]
  · intro hp
    exact False.elim (hp (Finset.mem_univ p))

theorem tripleRightRealize_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (tripleRightRealize R M n).hom := by
  apply Function.LeftInverse.injective
  intro x
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (tripleRightRealize_lift R M n)

/-- The canonical pure-degree inclusion into the right-parenthesized triple tensor. -/
def tripleRightι (p q r n : ℕ) (h : p + q + r = n) :
    ModuleCat.of R ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] ((⋀[R]^q M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^r M))) ⟶
      tripleRightDegree R M n :=
  ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (tensorDegreeι R M q r (q + r) rfl).hom) ≫
    tripleRightOuterι R M p (q + r) n (by rw [← Nat.add_assoc, h])

/-- The stored additive group on the actual left-parenthesized tensor carrier. -/
local instance leftTensorAddGroup (p q : ℕ) :
    AddCommGroup (TensorProduct R (↥(⋀[R]^p M)) (↥(⋀[R]^q M))) :=
  TensorProduct.addCommGroup

/-- The canonical pure-degree inclusion into the left-parenthesized triple tensor. -/
def tripleLeftι (p q r n : ℕ) (h : p + q + r = n) :
    ModuleCat.of R (TensorProduct R
      (TensorProduct R (↥(⋀[R]^p M)) (↥(⋀[R]^q M))) (↥(⋀[R]^r M))) ⟶
      tripleLeftDegree R M n :=
  ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (tensorDegreeι R M p q (p + q) rfl).hom
    (LinearMap.id : (⋀[R]^r M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^r M))) ≫
    tripleLeftOuterι R M (p + q) r n h

@[reassoc]
theorem tripleRightι_realize (p q r n : ℕ) (h : p + q + r = n) :
    tripleRightι R M p q r n h ≫ tripleRightRealize R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype
        (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^q M).subtype (⋀[R]^r M).subtype)) := by
  rw [tripleRightι, Category.assoc, tripleRightOuterι_realize]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a t
  have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (tensorDegreeι_realize R M q r (q + r) rfl)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom] at ht
  change (a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] (tensorDegreeRealize R M (q + r)).hom
      ((tensorDegreeι R M q r (q + r) rfl).hom t) =
    (a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^q M).subtype (⋀[R]^r M).subtype t
  rw [ht]

@[reassoc]
theorem tripleLeftι_realize (p q r n : ℕ) (h : p + q + r = n) :
    tripleLeftι R M p q r n h ≫ tripleLeftRealize R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((TensorProduct.assoc R E E E).toLinearMap.comp
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype (⋀[R]^q M).subtype)
          (⋀[R]^r M).subtype)) := by
  rw [tripleLeftι, Category.assoc, tripleLeftOuterι_realize]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro t c
  have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (tensorDegreeι_realize R M p q (p + q) rfl)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom] at ht
  change TensorProduct.assoc R E E E
      ((tensorDegreeRealize R M (p + q)).hom
        ((tensorDegreeι R M p q (p + q) rfl).hom t) ⊗ₜ[R] (c : E)) =
    TensorProduct.assoc R E E E
      (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype (⋀[R]^q M).subtype t ⊗ₜ[R] (c : E))
  rw [ht]

/-- The native graded associator, retaining the original canonical dictionaries. -/
def tripleAssociator (n : ℕ) : tripleLeftDegree R M n ⟶ tripleRightDegree R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact (GradedObject.Monoidal.associator 𝓔 𝓔 𝓔).hom n

@[reassoc]
theorem tripleLeftι_associator (p q r n : ℕ) (h : p + q + r = n) :
    tripleLeftι R M p q r n h ≫ tripleAssociator R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((TensorProduct.assoc R (⋀[R]^p M) (⋀[R]^q M) (⋀[R]^r M)).toLinearMap) ≫
        tripleRightι R M p q r n h := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ιTensorObj₃'_associator_hom 𝓔 𝓔 𝓔 p q r n h

/-- The actual native associator becomes the original tensor associator under realization. -/
theorem tripleAssociator_realize (n : ℕ) :
    tripleAssociator R M n ≫ tripleRightRealize R M n = tripleLeftRealize R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  apply GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorObj₃'_ext
  intro p q r h
  change tripleLeftι R M p q r n h ≫ _ = tripleLeftι R M p q r n h ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, tripleLeftι_associator, Category.assoc,
    tripleRightι_realize, tripleLeftι_realize]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro t c
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
      simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        TensorProduct.assoc_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply]
      change TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^p M).subtype
          (TensorProduct.map (⋀[R]^q M).subtype (⋀[R]^r M).subtype)
          (TensorProduct.assoc R (⋀[R]^p M) (⋀[R]^q M) (⋀[R]^r M)
            ((a ⊗ₜ[R] b) ⊗ₜ[R] c)) =
        TensorProduct.assoc R E E E (((a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] (b : E)) ⊗ₜ[R] (c : E))
      rw [TensorProduct.assoc_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
        TensorProduct.assoc_tmul]
      rfl
  | add t s ht hs => simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, ht, hs]

/-- Tensor the actual coproduct on the right, as a native graded morphism. -/
def gradedRightComul (n : ℕ) : tensorDegree R M n ⟶ tripleRightDegree R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorHom (𝟙 𝓔) (gradedCoproduct R M) n

/-- Tensor the actual coproduct on the left, as a native graded morphism. -/
def gradedLeftComul (n : ℕ) : tensorDegree R M n ⟶ tripleLeftDegree R M n := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.tensorHom (gradedCoproduct R M) (𝟙 𝓔) n

@[reassoc]
theorem tensorDegreeι_rightComul (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    tensorDegreeι R M p q n h ≫ gradedRightComul R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (gradedCoproduct R M q).hom) ≫
        tripleRightOuterι R M p q n h := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorHom (𝟙 𝓔) (gradedCoproduct R M) p q n h

@[reassoc]
theorem tensorDegreeι_leftComul (p q n : ℕ) (h : p + q = n) :
    tensorDegreeι R M p q n h ≫ gradedLeftComul R M n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (gradedCoproduct R M p).hom LinearMap.id) ≫
        tripleLeftOuterι R M p q n h := by
  letI : MonoidalCategoryStruct (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.tensorStructure.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalCategory.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalPreadditive (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalPreadditive.{u,v} (R := R)
  letI : MonoidalLinear R (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) := ModuleCat.UniverseTensor.monoidalLinear.{u,v} (R := R)
  exact GradedObject.Monoidal.ι_tensorHom (gradedCoproduct R M) (𝟙 𝓔) p q n h

theorem gradedRightComul_realize (n : ℕ) :
    gradedRightComul R M n ≫ tripleRightRealize R M n =
      tensorDegreeRealize R M n ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom ((coproduct R M).lTensor E) := by
  apply tensorDegree_hom_ext R M n
  intro p q h
  rw [← Category.assoc, tensorDegreeι_rightComul, Category.assoc, tripleRightOuterι_realize,
    ← Category.assoc, tensorDegreeι_realize]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a b
  have hb := congrArg (fun f => f.hom b) (gradedCoproduct_realize R M q)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom] at hb
  change (a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] (tensorDegreeRealize R M q).hom ((gradedCoproduct R M q).hom b) =
    (a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] coproduct R M (b : E)
  exact congrArg (fun z : P => (a : E) ⊗ₜ[R] z) hb

theorem gradedLeftComul_realize (n : ℕ) :
    gradedLeftComul R M n ≫ tripleLeftRealize R M n = tensorDegreeRealize R M n ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((TensorProduct.assoc R E E E).toLinearMap.comp
        ((coproduct R M).rTensor E)) := by
  apply tensorDegree_hom_ext R M n
  intro p q h
  have hleft := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun z => z ≫ tripleLeftRealize R M n) (tensorDegreeι_leftComul R M p q n h)).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => ModuleCat.ofHom
          (TensorProduct.map (gradedCoproduct R M p).hom
            (LinearMap.id : (⋀[R]^q M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^q M))) ≫ z)
          (tripleLeftOuterι_realize R M p q n h))))
  have hright := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun z => z ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom
      ((TensorProduct.assoc R E E E).toLinearMap.comp ((coproduct R M).rTensor E)))
        (tensorDegreeι_realize R M p q n h))
  refine hleft.trans (Eq.trans ?_ hright.symm)
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro a b
  let a₀ : ⋀[R]^p M := a
  have ha := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (show gradedExterior R M p from a₀))
    (gradedCoproduct_realize R M p)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom] at ha
  change TensorProduct.assoc R E E E
      ((tensorDegreeRealize R M p).hom ((gradedCoproduct R M p).hom a₀) ⊗ₜ[R] (b : E)) =
    TensorProduct.assoc R E E E (coproduct R M (a₀ : E) ⊗ₜ[R] (b : E))
  exact congrArg (fun z : P => TensorProduct.assoc R E E E (z ⊗ₜ[R] (b : E))) ha


/-- The actual graded coproduct satisfies native coassociativity in every degree. -/
theorem gradedCoproduct_coassoc (n : ℕ) :
    gradedCoproduct R M n ≫ gradedRightComul R M n =
      gradedCoproduct R M n ≫ gradedLeftComul R M n ≫ tripleAssociator R M n := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  let a₀ : ⋀[R]^n M := a
  apply tripleRightRealize_injective R M n
  let t : tensorDegree R M n := (gradedCoproduct R M n).hom a
  let u : tripleLeftDegree R M n := (gradedLeftComul R M n).hom t
  let v : tripleRightDegree R M n := (gradedRightComul R M n).hom t
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.hom a) (gradedCoproduct_realize R M n)
  change (tensorDegreeRealize R M n).hom t = coproduct R M (a₀ : E) at hc
  have hr := congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (gradedRightComul_realize R M n)
  change (tripleRightRealize R M n).hom v =
    (coproduct R M).lTensor E ((tensorDegreeRealize R M n).hom t) at hr
  have hl := congrArg (fun f => f.hom t) (gradedLeftComul_realize R M n)
  change (tripleLeftRealize R M n).hom u =
    TensorProduct.assoc R E E E ((coproduct R M).rTensor E
      ((tensorDegreeRealize R M n).hom t)) at hl
  have ha := congrArg (fun f => f.hom u) (tripleAssociator_realize R M n)
  change (tripleRightRealize R M n).hom ((tripleAssociator R M n).hom u) =
    (tripleLeftRealize R M n).hom u at ha
  change (tripleRightRealize R M n).hom v =
    (tripleRightRealize R M n).hom ((tripleAssociator R M n).hom u)
  exact (hr.trans (congrArg ((coproduct R M).lTensor E) hc)).trans
    ((coproduct_coassoc_apply R M (a₀ : E)).symm.trans
      ((hl.trans (congrArg (fun z => TensorProduct.assoc R E E E
        ((coproduct R M).rTensor E z)) hc)).symm.trans ha.symm))

end ExteriorAlgebra

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.CliffordAlgebra.Fold
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Grading
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Lie.OfAssociative
import Mathlib.Tactic.NoncommRing

/-!
# Exterior derivations induced by linear endomorphisms

A linear endomorphism of a module extends uniquely to an ordinary derivation
of its exterior algebra. The construction uses `CliffordAlgebra.foldr'` with
zero quadratic form, so it applies over every commutative ring and does not
require a basis. It is linear in the endomorphism, preserves exterior degree,
and preserves commutators.

The ambient exterior algebra is generally noncommutative. The derivations
are represented by linear endomorphisms with their proved Leibniz equation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u v w

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

private def derivationStep (g : Module.End R M) :
    M →ₗ[R] (ExteriorAlgebra R M × ExteriorAlgebra R M) →ₗ[R]
      ExteriorAlgebra R M :=
  (((Algebra.lmul R (ExteriorAlgebra R M)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((ι R).comp g)).compl₂
    (LinearMap.fst R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ExteriorAlgebra R M))) +
  (((Algebra.lmul R (ExteriorAlgebra R M)).toLinearMap.comp
      (ι R)).compl₂
    (LinearMap.snd R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ExteriorAlgebra R M)))

private lemma derivationStep_apply (g : Module.End R M) (x : M)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M × ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivationStep R M g x a = ι R (g x) * a.1 + ι R x * a.2 :=
  rfl

private theorem derivationStep_relation (g : Module.End R M)
    (x : M) (a b : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivationStep R M g x
        (ι R x * a, derivationStep R M g x (a, b)) =
      (0 : QuadraticForm R M) x • b := by
  have hanti : ι R (g x) * ι R x + ι R x * ι R (g x) = 0 :=
    ι_add_mul_swap (g x) x
  have hz : (0 : QuadraticForm R M) x • b = (0 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) := by
    simp
  rw [hz]
  change ι R (g x) * (ι R x * a) +
    ι R x * (ι R (g x) * a + ι R x * b) = 0
  calc
    _ = (ι R (g x) * ι R x + ι R x * ι R (g x)) * a +
        (ι R x * ι R x) * b := by noncomm_ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hanti, ι_sq_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]

private def derivationAux (g : Module.End R M) :
    Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) :=
  CliffordAlgebra.foldr' (0 : QuadraticForm R M)
    (derivationStep R M g) (derivationStep_relation R M g) 0

private theorem derivationAux_algebraMap (g : Module.End R M) (r : R) :
    derivationAux R M g (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) = 0 := by
  simp [derivationAux, CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_algebraMap]

private theorem derivationAux_ι_mul (g : Module.End R M) (x : M)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivationAux R M g (ι R x * a) =
      ι R (g x) * a + ι R x * derivationAux R M g a := by
  simpa only [derivationAux, derivationStep_apply] using
    (CliffordAlgebra.foldr'_ι_mul (0 : QuadraticForm R M)
      (derivationStep R M g) (derivationStep_relation R M g)
      (0 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) x a)

private theorem derivationAux_add (g h : Module.End R M) :
    derivationAux R M (g + h) = derivationAux R M g + derivationAux R M h := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, derivationAux_algebraMap, add_zero]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, ha, hb]
  | ι_mul a x ha =>
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, derivationAux_ι_mul, map_add,
        ha, add_mul, mul_add]; abel

private theorem derivationAux_smul (r : R) (g : Module.End R M) :
    derivationAux R M (r • g) = r • derivationAux R M g := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap t =>
      simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, derivationAux_algebraMap, smul_zero]
  | add a b ha hb =>
      simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add, ha, hb]
  | ι_mul a x ha =>
      simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, derivationAux_ι_mul, map_smul,
        ha, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, smul_add]

/-- Extend a linear endomorphism to the derivation that acts on each
exterior generator by that endomorphism. -/
def derivation : Module.End R M →ₗ[R] Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) where
  toFun := private derivationAux R M
  map_add' := by exact derivationAux_add R M
  map_smul' := by exact derivationAux_smul R M

/-- The induced derivation vanishes on scalars. -/
@[simp]
theorem derivation_algebraMap (g : Module.End R M) (r : R) :
    derivation R M g (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) = 0 :=
  derivationAux_algebraMap R M g r

/-- The induced derivation vanishes on the multiplicative identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem derivation_one (g : Module.End R M) :
    derivation R M g 1 = 0 := by
  simpa only [map_one] using derivation_algebraMap R M g 1

/-- The generator recursion for the induced exterior derivation. -/
@[simp]
theorem derivation_ι_mul (g : Module.End R M) (x : M)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivation R M g (ι R x * a) =
      ι R (g x) * a + ι R x * derivation R M g a :=
  derivationAux_ι_mul R M g x a

/-- The induced derivation agrees with the supplied endomorphism on
exterior generators. -/
@[simp]
theorem derivation_ι (g : Module.End R M) (x : M) :
    derivation R M g (ι R x) = ι R (g x) := by
  simpa only [mul_one, derivation_one, mul_zero, add_zero] using
    derivation_ι_mul R M g x 1

/-- The ordinary Leibniz equation in the exterior algebra. -/
theorem derivation_mul (g : Module.End R M) (a b : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    derivation R M g (a * b) =
      derivation R M g a * b + a * derivation R M g b := by
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      simp only [← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, derivation_algebraMap,
        zero_mul, zero_add]
  | add a a' ha ha' =>
      simp only [add_mul, map_add, ha, ha']; abel
  | ι_mul a x ha =>
      rw [mul_assoc, derivation_ι_mul, ha, derivation_ι_mul]
      noncomm_ring

/-- A derivation of the exterior algebra is determined by its action on
scalars and its generator recursion. -/
theorem derivation_unique (g : Module.End R M)
    (D : Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R M))
    (hR : ∀ r : R, D (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) = 0)
    (hι : ∀ (x : M) (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M),
      D (ι R x * a) = ι R (g x) * a + ι R x * D a) :
    D = derivation R M g := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => rw [hR, derivation_algebraMap]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | ι_mul a x ha => rw [hι, derivation_ι_mul, ha]

/-- The induced derivation preserves each homogeneous exterior degree. -/
theorem derivation_mem_exteriorPower (g : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^n M) :
    derivation R M g a ∈ ⋀[R]^n M := by
  dsimp only [ExteriorAlgebra.exteriorPower] at ha ⊢
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [derivation_algebraMap]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add a b n ha hb iha ihb =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ iha ihb
  | mem_mul m hm n a ha ih =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [derivation_ι_mul, pow_succ']
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ (g x)) ha)
        (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x) ih)

/-- Extending endomorphisms to exterior derivations preserves their
commutator. -/
theorem derivation_commutator (g h : Module.End R M) :
    derivation R M (g.comp h - h.comp g) =
      (derivation R M g).comp (derivation R M h) -
        (derivation R M h).comp (derivation R M g) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change derivation R M (g.comp h - h.comp g) a =
    derivation R M g (derivation R M h a) -
      derivation R M h (derivation R M g a)
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp only [derivation_algebraMap, map_zero, sub_self]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]; noncomm_ring
  | ι_mul a x ha =>
      rw [derivation_ι_mul, ha]
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub,
        derivation_ι_mul, map_add]; noncomm_ring

/-- Exterior derivations are natural for linear maps intertwining the
endomorphisms on the two modules. -/
theorem derivation_naturality
    {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : Module.End R M) (h : Module.End R N)
    (hfg : f.comp g = h.comp f) :
    (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap.comp (derivation R M g) =
      (derivation R N h).comp (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap := by
  have hinter (x : M) : f (g x) = h (f x) := LinearMap.congr_fun hfg x
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change ExteriorAlgebra.map f (derivation R M g a) =
    derivation R N h (ExteriorAlgebra.map f a)
  induction a using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
      rw [derivation_algebraMap, map_zero, AlgHom.commutes, derivation_algebraMap]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | ι_mul a x ha =>
      simp only [derivation_ι_mul, map_mul, map_add,
        ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, hinter, ha]

section Lie

attribute [local instance 100] LieRing.ofAssociativeRing

/-- The extension to exterior derivations, bundled as a Lie homomorphism
between the native commutator Lie algebras of endomorphisms. -/
def derivationLieHom :
    Module.End R M →ₗ⁅R⁆ Module.End R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) where
  __ := derivation R M
  map_lie' {g h} := by
    change derivation R M (g * h - h * g) =
      derivation R M g * derivation R M h -
        derivation R M h * derivation R M g
    simpa only [Module.End.mul_eq_comp] using derivation_commutator R M g h

/-- Forgetting the commutator compatibility recovers the same linear
extension to exterior derivations. -/
@[simp]
theorem derivationLieHom_toLinearMap :
    (derivationLieHom R M).toLinearMap = derivation R M :=
  rfl

end Lie

end ExteriorAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Derivation
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.Uncurry.Fin

/-!
# Exterior derivations on pure words

The exterior derivation induced by an endomorphism acts on a pure word by
applying that endomorphism to each factor in turn and adding the results.
Moving the modified factor to the front gives the equivalent signed formula.
Both equations hold over every commutative ring and arbitrary module.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- An exterior derivation acts on a pure word by replacing each factor
with its image under the endomorphism, then summing those words. -/
theorem derivation_ιMulti (g : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    derivation R M g (ιMulti R n v) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ιMulti R n (Function.update v i (g (v i))) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [ιMulti_zero_apply, derivation_one, Fin.sum_univ_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, derivation_ι_mul, ih, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
        Finset.mul_sum]
      apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      · have ht : Matrix.vecTail (Function.update v 0 (g (v 0))) =
            Matrix.vecTail v :=
          Fin.tail_update_zero v (g (v 0))
        rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, Function.update_self, ht]
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        have h0 : (Function.update v i.succ (g (v i.succ))) 0 = v 0 :=
          Function.update_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm (g (v i.succ)) v
        have ht : Matrix.vecTail (Function.update v i.succ (g (v i.succ))) =
            Function.update (Matrix.vecTail v) i (g (Matrix.vecTail v i)) :=
          Fin.tail_update_succ v i (g (v i.succ))
        rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, h0, ht]

/-- The same pure-word formula with each modified factor placed at the
front, including the sign of its permutation past the preceding factors. -/
theorem derivation_ιMulti_eq_sum_vecCons
    (g : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    derivation R M g (ιMulti R (n + 1) v) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ i.val) •
        ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons (g (v i)) (i.removeNth v)) := by
  classical
  rw [derivation_ιMulti]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h := (ιMulti R (n + 1)).map_insertNth i (g (v i)) (i.removeNth v)
  rw [Fin.insertNth_removeNth] at h
  simpa only [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, Int.cast_pow,
    Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one] using h

end ExteriorAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Coalgebra

/-!
# The actual reduced primitive equation for the exterior coalgebra

The counit condition follows from the primitive coproduct equation by
counitality and additive cancellation. No division by two and no
characteristic hypothesis is needed. This is the actual primitive equation
for the constructed exterior coproduct and its actual multiplicative unit.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

local notation "E" => ExteriorAlgebra R M

/-- The actual reduced primitive map on the exterior algebra. -/
def primitiveEquation : E →ₗ[R] E ⊗[R] E :=
  coproduct R M - ((TensorProduct.mk R E E).flip (1 : E) + TensorProduct.mk R E E (1 : E))

@[simp]
theorem primitiveEquation_apply (a : E) :
    primitiveEquation R M a = coproduct R M a - (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : E) + (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[R] a) := rfl

/-- The actual reduced equation is equivalent to native primitivity over every commutative ring. -/
theorem primitiveEquation_eq_zero_iff (a : E) :
    primitiveEquation R M a = 0 ↔ Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : E) (1 : E) a := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [primitiveEquation_apply] at h
    have hΔ : Coalgebra.comul a = (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[R] a + a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : E) := by
      change coproduct R M a = _
      simpa only [add_comm] using sub_eq_zero.mp h
    apply Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem.of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul
    · change augmentation R M (1 : E) = 1
      exact map_one (augmentation R M)
    · change augmentation R M (1 : E) = 1
      exact map_one (augmentation R M)
    · exact hΔ
  · intro h
    rw [primitiveEquation_apply]
    change Coalgebra.comul a - (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : E) + (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[R] a) = 0
    rw [h.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, add_comm, sub_self]

end ExteriorAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.PrimitiveEquation
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.UnshuffleCoproduct
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.DeletionBasis
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.CoalgebraGraded

/-!
# Homogeneous exterior primitives on free modules in every characteristic

The actual singleton coproduct component is the stock exterior deletion
map after its native one-variable coordinate equivalence. A homogeneous
primitive of degree at least two has zero deletion. The existing deletion
injectivity theorem for free modules therefore rules out higher primitives
without dividing by the degree or any factorial. This includes positive
characteristic and characteristic dividing the exterior degree.

The free-module hypothesis is retained. A separate characteristic-two
nonfree-module client has a nonzero primitive in degree two.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

local notation "E" => ExteriorAlgebra R M

/-- The actual degree-two reduced coproduct has the alternating middle term. -/
theorem primitiveEquation_ι_mul_ι (x y : M) :
    primitiveEquation R M (ι R x * ι R y) =
      ι R x ⊗ₜ[R] ι R y - ι R y ⊗ₜ[R] ι R x := by
  rw [primitiveEquation_apply, coproduct_ι_mul, coproduct_ι]
  simp only [map_add, signedInsertion_tmul, map_one, mul_one,
    CliffordAlgebra.involute_ι, TensorProduct.neg_tmul]
  abel

private theorem domCoprod_postcomp {A B A' B' : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B]
    [AddCommGroup A'] [Module R A'] [AddCommGroup B'] [Module R B']
    {p q : ℕ} (a : M [⋀^Fin p]→ₗ[R] A) (b : M [⋀^Fin q]→ₗ[R] B)
    (f : A →ₗ[R] A') (g : B →ₗ[R] B') :
    (TensorProduct.map f g).compAlternatingMap (a.domCoprod b) =
      (f.compAlternatingMap a).domCoprod (g.compAlternatingMap b) := by
  ext w
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply,
    _root_.sum_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  induction c using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ σ =>
      change (TensorProduct.map f g)
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • (a (fun i => w (σ (Sum.inl i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          b (fun j => w (σ (Sum.inr j))))) =
        (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) •
          (f (a (fun i => w (σ (Sum.inl i)))) ⊗ₜ[R]
            g (b (fun j => w (σ (Sum.inr j)))))
      rw [map_zsmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul]

private theorem ιMulti_transport (p q : ℕ) (h : p = q) (w : Fin q → M) :
    ιMulti R p (w ∘ finCongr h) = ιMulti R q w := by
  subst q
  rfl

-- These private adapters reindex the already constructed unshuffle. The stock deletion
-- operator is used only through its public generator formula, not by unfolding its
-- unexposed implementation or reconstructing the operator.
private def singletonBlock (n : ℕ) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
  finSumFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (Nat.one_add n))

private def singletonRepresentative (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n) :=
  (Equiv.permCongr (singletonBlock n)).symm r.cycleRange.symm

private theorem singletonRepresentative_head (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    singletonBlock n (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inl 0)) = r := by
  calc
    singletonBlock n (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inl 0)) =
        ((singletonBlock n).permCongr (singletonRepresentative n r))
          (singletonBlock n (Sum.inl 0)) := by
            rw [Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ = r.cycleRange.symm 0 := by
      unfold singletonRepresentative
      rw [(Equiv.permCongr (singletonBlock n)).apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
    _ = r := Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero r

private theorem singletonRepresentative_tail (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    singletonBlock n (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inr j)) = r.succAbove j := by
  calc
    singletonBlock n (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inr j)) =
        ((singletonBlock n).permCongr (singletonRepresentative n r))
          (singletonBlock n (Sum.inr j)) := by
            rw [Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ = r.cycleRange.symm j.succ := by
      unfold singletonRepresentative
      rw [(Equiv.permCongr (singletonBlock n)).apply_symm_apply]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [singletonBlock]
    _ = r.succAbove j := Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ r j

private theorem singletonRepresentative_sign (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign (singletonRepresentative n r) = (-1) ^ r.val := by
  rw [← Equiv.Perm.sign_permCongr (singletonBlock n) (singletonRepresentative n r),
    singletonRepresentative, (Equiv.permCongr (singletonBlock n)).apply_symm_apply]
  change Equiv.Perm.sign r.cycleRange⁻¹ = (-1) ^ r.val
  rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_inv, Fin.sign_cycleRange]

private def singletonPositionEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin 1) (Fin n) ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
  ((AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetPositionsEquiv 1 n).trans
    Set.powersetCard.ofSingleton.symm).trans (finCongr (Nat.one_add n))

private theorem singletonPositionEquiv_symm (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (singletonPositionEquiv n).symm r = Quotient.mk'' (singletonRepresentative n r) := by
  classical
  apply (AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetPositionsEquiv 1 n).injective
  change (AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetPositionsEquiv 1 n)
      ((AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetPositionsEquiv 1 n).symm
        (Set.powersetCard.ofSingleton ((finCongr (Nat.one_add n)).symm r))) =
    AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetLeftPositions 1 n
      (Quotient.mk'' (singletonRepresentative n r))
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
    AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.cosetLeftPositions_mk]
  apply SetLike.ext
  intro k
  rw [AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber.Shuffle.mem_blockLeftPositions]
  change k ∈ ({(finCongr (Nat.one_add n)).symm r} : Finset (Fin (1 + n))) ↔ _
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hh : finSumFinEquiv (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inl 0)) =
      (finCongr (Nat.one_add n)).symm r := by
    apply (finCongr (Nat.one_add n)).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact singletonRepresentative_head n r
  constructor
  · intro hk
    exact ⟨0, hh.trans hk.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact hi.symm.trans hh

private theorem singletonSummand (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (w : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand
        ((AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id)
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n) (Quotient.mk'' (singletonRepresentative n r)))
          (w ∘ singletonBlock n)) =
      (-1 : R) ^ r.val • ((exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (w ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] w r) := by
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', _root_.smul_apply, singletonRepresentative_sign]
  rw [@Units.smul_def _ _ (_) (_), ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one,
    Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
  change (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
      (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
        ((((AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id).toMultilinearMap.domCoprod
          (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n).toMultilinearMap).domDomCongr
            (singletonRepresentative n r) (w ∘ singletonBlock n)) = _
  rw [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply, TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
  have ht : (fun j : Fin n => (w ∘ singletonBlock n)
      (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inr j))) = w ∘ r.succAbove := by
    funext j
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, singletonRepresentative_tail]
  have hh : ((AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id)
      (fun i => (w ∘ singletonBlock n) (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inl i))) = w r := by
    rw [AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton_apply_apply]
    change w (singletonBlock n (singletonRepresentative n r (Sum.inl 0))) = w r
    rw [singletonRepresentative_head]
  rw [ht]
  exact congrArg (fun x => (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
    ((exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (w ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) hh

private theorem singletonDomCoprod (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      ((((AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id).domCoprod
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n)) (w ∘ singletonBlock n)) =
      ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        ((exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (w ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] w r) := by
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, _root_.sum_apply, map_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
        ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand
          ((AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id)
          (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n) ((singletonPositionEquiv n).symm r))
            (w ∘ singletonBlock n)) := ((singletonPositionEquiv n).symm.sum_comp _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [singletonPositionEquiv_symm]
      exact singletonSummand R M n r w

/-- The stock deletion map is the actual singleton coproduct component, not an independent certificate. -/
theorem deletion_eq_coproductProjection (n : ℕ) :
    exteriorPower.deletion R M n =
      (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M)).toLinearMap.comp
        ((TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id).comp
          ((TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.projection R M 1) (exteriorPower.projection R M n)).comp
            ((coproduct R M).comp (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M).subtype))) := by
  let one : M [⋀^Fin 1]→ₗ[R] M :=
    (AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id
  have hOne : (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap.compAlternatingMap
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 1) = one := by
    ext w
    change exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 1 w) = w 0
    exact exteriorPower.oneEquiv_ιMulti (R := R) (M := M) w
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M) (N := (⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro w
  have hp := LinearMap.congr_fun (exteriorPower.projectedCoproduct_eq_unshuffle R M 1 n)
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (1 + n) (w ∘ finCongr (Nat.one_add n)))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
    exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe] at hp
  rw [ιMulti_transport R M (1 + n) (n + 1) (Nat.one_add n) w] at hp
  rw [exteriorPower.unshuffle, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti] at hp
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply, exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe]
  rw [exteriorPower.deletion_apply_ιMulti, ← singletonDomCoprod R M n w]
  change (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      ((one.domCoprod (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n))
        (w ∘ ((finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (1 + n)).trans (finCongr (Nat.one_add n))))) =
    (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      (TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.projection R M 1) (exteriorPower.projection R M n)
          (coproduct R M (ιMulti R (n + 1) w))))
  rw [hp]
  have hpost := domCoprod_postcomp R M (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 1)
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n) (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
  rw [hOne] at hpost
  have hId : (LinearMap.id : (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n M)).compAlternatingMap
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n) = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n := by ext v; rfl
  rw [hId] at hpost
  exact congrArg (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hpost
      (w ∘ ((finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (1 + n)).trans (finCongr (Nat.one_add n))))).symm

/-- Every homogeneous primitive in degree at least two has zero actual deletion. -/
theorem deletion_eq_zero_of_primitive (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (a : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M)
    (ha : Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : E) (1 : E) (a : E)) :
    exteriorPower.deletion R M n a = 0 := by
  rw [deletion_eq_coproductProjection]
  change (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      (TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (TensorProduct.map (exteriorPower.projection R M 1) (exteriorPower.projection R M n)
          (Coalgebra.comul (a : E)))) = 0
  rw [ha.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, map_add, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  have h0 : (1 : E) = ιMulti R 0 Fin.elim0 := (ιMulti_zero_apply (R := R) (M := M) Fin.elim0).symm
  rw [h0, exteriorPower.projection_ιMulti_ne R M 1 0 (by decide),
    exteriorPower.projection_ιMulti_ne R M n 0 hn.symm,
    TensorProduct.zero_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, zero_add, map_zero, map_zero]

/-- A homogeneous degree-zero primitive is zero, without any freeness assumption. -/
theorem primitive_degree_zero (a : ⋀[R]^0 M)
    (ha : Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : E) (1 : E) (a : E)) : a = 0 := by
  apply (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M).injective
  have h := ha.counit_eq_zero
  change augmentation R M (a : E) = 0 at h
  rw [augmentation_degree_zero] at h
  simpa only [map_zero] using h

/-- On free modules, exterior primitives in any homogeneous degree other than one vanish,
including positive characteristic and degrees divisible by that characteristic. -/
theorem primitive_homogeneous_eq_zero [Module.Free R M] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 1)
    (a : ⋀[R]^n M)
    (ha : Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : E) (1 : E) (a : E)) : a = 0 := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact primitive_degree_zero R M a ha
  | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact False.elim (hn rfl)
      | succ n =>
          apply exteriorPower.deletion_injective R M (n + 1)
          rw [deletion_eq_zero_of_primitive R M (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) a ha, map_zero]

end ExteriorAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.CoalgebraMap
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.PrimitiveFree
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective

/-!
# Homogeneous exterior primitives on projective modules

The native projective split theorem provides an actual split embedding into
a free module in a common universe containing the original ring and carrier.
The actual exterior coalgebra map takes a primitive into the free exterior
coalgebra. The existing characteristic-free free-module theorem kills every
homogeneous degree other than one, and native exterior-map split injectivity
reflects zero back to the original projective module.

The free cover is a module; the argument does not require a Lie structure on
it. No finite-generation, characteristic-zero, degree-invertibility or
desired primitive-preservation certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Every homogeneous exterior primitive outside degree one vanishes on a projective module,
over any commutative ring and in every characteristic. -/
theorem primitive_homogeneous_eq_zero_of_projective [Module.Projective R M]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 1) (a : ⋀[R]^n M)
    (ha : Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) 1
      (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)) : a = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨N, hNadd, hNmodule, hNfree, i, s, hsi⟩ := Module.Projective.iff_split.mp
    (inferInstance : Module.Projective R M)
  letI : AddCommMonoid N := hNadd
  letI : Module R N := hNmodule
  letI : Module.Free R N := hNfree
  letI : AddCommGroup N := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R
  have hi : Coalgebra.IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R N) 1
      (exteriorPower.map n i a : ExteriorAlgebra R N) := by
    rw [exteriorPower.coe_map]
    exact map_isPrimitive R M i a ha
  have hz : exteriorPower.map n i a = 0 :=
    primitive_homogeneous_eq_zero R N n hn _ hi
  apply exteriorPower.map_injective (n := n) (f := i) s hsi
  simpa only [map_zero] using hz

end ExteriorAlgebra

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Operations
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Kernel
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations

/-!
# Exterior relations generated in degree one

For a surjective linear map, the kernel of its actual exterior-algebra
map is the two-sided ideal generated by its original degree-one linear
kernel. The original modules, coefficients and exterior products are
retained. This is the right-exact exterior-algebra prerequisite used in
Illusie §0.2.4.9 for actual unit-symbol relations.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

open Module

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} {N : Type w}
  [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N]

/-- The actual two-sided ideal generated by the original linear kernel in degree one. -/
def linearKernelIdeal (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : TwoSidedIdeal (ExteriorAlgebra R M) :=
  TwoSidedIdeal.span ((ι R) '' (f.ker : Set M))

/-- Original degree-one kernel relations vanish under the actual exterior-algebra map. -/
theorem linearKernelIdeal_le_ker (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    linearKernelIdeal f ≤ TwoSidedIdeal.ker (map f).toRingHom := by
  apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  apply (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker (map f).toRingHom).mpr
  change map f (ι R m) = 0
  rw [map_apply_ι]
  change f m = 0 at hm
  rw [hm, map_zero]

/-- Surjectivity earns the exact original exterior kernel generated by degree-one relations. -/
theorem ker_map_eq_linearKernelIdeal (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    TwoSidedIdeal.ker (map f).toRingHom = linearKernelIdeal f := by
  let I := linearKernelIdeal f
  let Q := ExteriorAlgebra R M ⧸ I.asIdeal
  let q : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] Q := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.asIdeal
  let g₀ : M →ₗ[R] Q := q.toLinearMap.comp (ι R)
  have hk : f.ker ≤ g₀.ker := by
    intro m hm
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I.asIdeal (ι R m) = 0
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    apply TwoSidedIdeal.mem_asIdeal.mpr
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  let e := f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hf
  let g : N →ₗ[R] Q := (f.ker.liftQ g₀ hk).comp e.symm.toLinearMap
  have hg (m : M) : g (f m) = q (ι R m) := by
    have he : e.symm (f m) = Submodule.Quotient.mk m := by
      have he₀ : e (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = f m := LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk f hf m
      have h := congrArg e.symm he₀
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h.symm
    change (f.ker.liftQ g₀ hk) (e.symm (f m)) = _
    rw [he, Submodule.liftQ_apply]
    rfl
  have hs (n : N) : g n * g n = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hf n
    rw [hg]
    rw [← map_mul, ι_sq_zero, map_zero]
  let G : ExteriorAlgebra R N →ₐ[R] Q := lift R ⟨g, hs⟩
  have hcomp : G.comp (map f) = q := by
    apply hom_ext
    ext m
    change G ((map f) (ι R m)) = q (ι R m)
    rw [map_apply_ι]
    change (lift R ⟨g, hs⟩) (ι R (f m)) = _
    rw [lift_ι_apply, hg]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx₀ : map f x = 0 := (TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker (map f).toRingHom).mp hx
    have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk I.asIdeal x = 0 := by
      have h := AlgHom.congr_fun hcomp x
      change G (map f x) = q x at h
      exact h.symm.trans (by rw [hx₀, map_zero])
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mem_asIdeal.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hq)
  · exact linearKernelIdeal_le_ker f

end ExteriorAlgebra

-- Author: @toskua, Avocado
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.RestrictScalars
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Deletion
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Equiv
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.BaseChange
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Grading
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.TensorProduct
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Tower

/-!
# Base change for exterior powers

This file constructs the canonical map from the scalar extension of an
exterior power to the exterior power of the scalar extension. It is natural
for every module, commutes with deletion, and is always an equivalence. The
equivalence is the restriction of Mathlib's exterior-algebra base-change
isomorphism to the native homogeneous decomposition.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true

noncomputable section

open Function
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v w z

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- A linear equivalence induces an equivalence on each exterior power. -/
def mapEquiv (n : ℕ) {N : Type z} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : (⋀[R]^n M) ≃ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n N) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap
    (map n e.toLinearMap)
    (map n e.symm.toLinearMap)
    (by ext x; simp [← map_comp])
    (by ext x; simp [← map_comp])

@[simp]
theorem mapEquiv_apply_ιMulti (n : ℕ) {N : Type z}
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (a : Fin n → M) :
    mapEquiv R M n e (ιMulti R n a) = ιMulti R n (e ∘ a) := by
  exact map_apply_ιMulti e.toLinearMap a

@[simp]
theorem mapEquiv_refl (n : ℕ) :
    mapEquiv R M n (LinearEquiv.refl R M) = LinearEquiv.refl R (⋀[R]^n M) := by
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  exact map_id

theorem mapEquiv_trans (n : ℕ)
    {N : Type z} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (f : N ≃ₗ[R] P) :
    mapEquiv R M n (e.trans f) =
      (mapEquiv R M n e).trans (mapEquiv R N n f) := by
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  exact map_comp e.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap

private def baseChangeAlternating (n : ℕ) :
    M [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  ((ιMulti S n (M := S ⊗[R] M)).restrictScalars (R := R)).compLinearMap
    (TensorProduct.mk R S M 1)

/-- The canonical map from the scalar extension of an exterior power to the
exterior power of the scalar extension. -/
@[no_expose]
def baseChangeMap (n : ℕ) :
    S ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[S] (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift
    ((LinearMap.lsmul S ((⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)))).flip
      (alternatingMapLinearEquiv (baseChangeAlternating R S M n)))

@[simp]
theorem baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : Fin n → M) :
    baseChangeMap R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a) =
      s • ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i) := by
  rw [baseChangeMap, TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift_tmul]
  change s • alternatingMapLinearEquiv (baseChangeAlternating R S M n)
      (ιMulti R n a) = _
  rw [alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
  rfl

/-- Degree-zero normalization of the canonical exterior base-change map. -/
theorem baseChangeMap_zero :
    (zeroEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)).toLinearMap.comp
        (baseChangeMap R S M 0) =
      (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid R S S).toLinearMap.comp
        ((zeroEquiv R M).toLinearMap.baseChange S) := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := 0) (M := M) (N := S)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change zeroEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)
      (baseChangeMap R S M 0 (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R 0 a)) =
    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid R S S
      (((zeroEquiv R M).toLinearMap.baseChange S)
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R 0 a))
  rw [baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti, map_smul,
    zeroEquiv_ιMulti, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  simp

/-- Degree-one normalization of the canonical exterior base-change map. -/
theorem baseChangeMap_one :
    (oneEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)).toLinearMap.comp
        (baseChangeMap R S M 1) =
      (oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap.baseChange S := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := 1) (M := M) (N := S ⊗[R] M)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change oneEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)
      (baseChangeMap R S M 1 (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R 1 a)) =
    ((oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap.baseChange S)
      (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R 1 a)
  rw [baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti, map_smul, oneEquiv_ιMulti]
  change s • ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a 0) =
    s ⊗ₜ[R] oneEquiv R M (ιMulti R 1 a)
  rw [oneEquiv_ιMulti]
  change (s * 1) ⊗ₜ[R] a 0 = s ⊗ₜ[R] a 0
  rw [mul_one]

private theorem nativeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : Fin n → M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n a) =
      s • ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i) := by
  have hword : ∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → M),
      ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k v) =
        ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti S k (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] v i) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro v
        rw [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_zero_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_zero_apply]
        change ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S (1 : S ⊗[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M) = 1
        exact map_one _
    | succ k ih =>
        intro v
        rw [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply]
        rw [show (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R]
            (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (v 0) * ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k (Matrix.vecTail v)) =
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (v 0)) *
            ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k (Matrix.vecTail v)) by
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]]
        rw [map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv_apply, ih]
        rfl
  rw [show s ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n a =
      s • ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n a) by
    simp only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]]
  rw [map_smul, hword]

/-- The canonical exterior-power map is the homogeneous restriction of the
native exterior-algebra base-change isomorphism. -/
theorem baseChangeMap_inclusion (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)).subtype.comp (baseChangeMap R S M n) =
      (ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).toLinearMap.comp
        ((⋀[R]^n M).subtype.baseChange S) := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n) (M := M) (N := ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change (baseChangeMap R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a) :
      ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M)) =
    ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S
      (s ⊗ₜ[R] ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n a)
  rw [baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti]
  change s • ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i) = _
  exact (nativeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul_ιMulti R S M n s a).symm

private theorem nativeBaseChangeEquiv_symm_ι_mem (v : S ⊗[R] M) :
    (ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).symm (ExteriorAlgebra.ι S v) ∈
      (⋀[R]^1 M).baseChange S := by
  induction v using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s m =>
      rw [ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv_symm_apply]
      exact Submodule.tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem s (by
        change ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m ∈ (LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R)) ^ 1
        rw [pow_one]
        exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ m)
  | add v z hv hz =>
      rw [map_add, map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hv hz

private theorem nativeBaseChangeEquiv_symm_mem (n : ℕ)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M)) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) :
    (ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).symm a ∈ (⋀[R]^n M).baseChange S := by
  change a ∈ (LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι S)) ^ n at ha
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap s =>
      rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ s
        (SetLike.one_mem_graded (fun k : ℕ => (⋀[R]^k M).baseChange S))
  | add _ _ _ _ _ ha hb =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
  | mem_mul _ hm _ _ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [map_mul]
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
        SetLike.mul_mem_graded (A := fun k : ℕ => (⋀[R]^k M).baseChange S)
          (nativeBaseChangeEquiv_symm_ι_mem R S M v) ih

private theorem nativeBaseChangeEquiv_map_degree (n : ℕ) :
    ((⋀[R]^n M).baseChange S).map
        (ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).toLinearMap =
      ⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rw [Submodule.baseChange] at ha
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ha
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (baseChangeMap_inclusion R S M n) t
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact (baseChangeMap R S M n t).property
  · intro a ha
    exact ⟨(ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).symm a,
      nativeBaseChangeEquiv_symm_mem R S M n a ha,
      (ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).apply_symm_apply a⟩

private def nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    S ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^n M) ≃ₗ[S] (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  (LinearEquiv.ofBijective ((⋀[R]^n M).toBaseChange S)
      (DirectSum.toBaseChange_bijective (S := S) (fun k : ℕ => ⋀[R]^k M) n)).trans
    ((ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S).toLinearEquiv.ofSubmodules
      ((⋀[R]^n M).baseChange S) (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M))
      (nativeBaseChangeEquiv_map_degree R S M n))

private theorem nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv_toLinearMap (n : ℕ) :
    (nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv R S M n).toLinearMap = baseChangeMap R S M n := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] a) :
      ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M)) =
    (baseChangeMap R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] a) : ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M))
  have h : (nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] a) :
      ExteriorAlgebra S (S ⊗[R] M)) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S (s ⊗ₜ[R] (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)) := by
    rw [nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      LinearEquiv.ofSubmodules_apply]
    change ExteriorAlgebra.baseChangeEquiv R M S
        (((⋀[R]^n M).toBaseChange S (s ⊗ₜ[R] a) : S ⊗[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M)) = _
    rw [Submodule.coe_toBaseChange_tmul]
  rw [h]
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
    Submodule.subtype_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply] using
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (baseChangeMap_inclusion R S M n) (s ⊗ₜ[R] a)).symm

private theorem baseChangeMap_bijective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (baseChangeMap R S M n) := by
  rw [← nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv_toLinearMap R S M n]
  exact (nativeDegreeBaseChangeEquiv R S M n).bijective

/-- Exterior powers commute with arbitrary extension of scalars. The
forward map is canonical and no basis or flatness hypothesis is needed. -/
@[no_expose]
def baseChangeEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    S ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^n M) ≃ₗ[S] (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (baseChangeMap R S M n)
    (baseChangeMap_bijective R S M n)

/-- The equivalence has the original canonical map as its forward linear map. -/
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEquiv_toLinearMap (n : ℕ) :
    (baseChangeEquiv R S M n).toLinearMap = baseChangeMap R S M n := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEquiv_apply_tmul_ιMulti
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : Fin n → M) :
    baseChangeEquiv R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a) =
      s • ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i) :=
  baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti R S M n s a

/-- The inverse equivalence recovers the actual scalar-extended exterior word. -/
@[simp↓]
theorem baseChangeEquiv_symm_apply_smul_ιMulti
    (n : ℕ) (s : S) (a : Fin n → M) :
    (baseChangeEquiv R S M n).symm
        (s • ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i)) =
      s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a := by
  rw [← baseChangeEquiv_apply_tmul_ιMulti R S M n s a]
  exact (baseChangeEquiv R S M n).symm_apply_apply _

/-- The inverse on an unscaled exterior word is the actual tensor of that word. -/
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEquiv_symm_apply_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → M) :
    (baseChangeEquiv R S M n).symm
        (ιMulti S n (fun i => (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] a i)) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a := by
  simpa only [one_smul] using
    baseChangeEquiv_symm_apply_smul_ιMulti R S M n (1 : S) a

/-- In degree zero the exterior base-change equivalence is the canonical
scalar-extension identification. -/
theorem baseChangeEquiv_zero :
    (baseChangeEquiv R S M 0).trans (zeroEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)) =
      ((zeroEquiv R M).baseChange R S _ _).trans
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid R S S) := by
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  exact baseChangeMap_zero R S M

/-- In degree one the exterior base-change equivalence is the base change of
the canonical degree-one equivalence. -/
theorem baseChangeEquiv_one :
    (baseChangeEquiv R S M 1).trans (oneEquiv S (S ⊗[R] M)) =
      (oneEquiv R M).baseChange R S _ _ := by
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  exact baseChangeMap_one R S M

/-- Naturality of the canonical exterior base-change map. -/
theorem baseChangeMap_naturality
    {N : Type z} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) :
    baseChangeMap R S N n ∘ₗ (map n f).baseChange S =
      map n (f.baseChange S) ∘ₗ baseChangeMap R S M n := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n) (M := M) (N := ⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] N))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change baseChangeMap R S N n
      (s ⊗ₜ[R] map n f (ιMulti R n a)) =
    map n (f.baseChange S)
      (baseChangeMap R S M n (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R n a))
  rw [map_apply_ιMulti, baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti,
    baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti, map_smul, map_apply_ιMulti]
  congr 2

/-- Exterior-power deletion commutes with scalar extension. -/
theorem baseChangeMap_deletion (n : ℕ) :
    (exteriorPower.deletion S (S ⊗[R] M) n).comp
        (baseChangeMap R S M (n + 1)) =
      (TensorProduct.map (baseChangeMap R S M n)
          (LinearMap.id (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] M))).comp
        ((TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange
            R S (⋀[R]^n M) M).toLinearMap.comp
          ((exteriorPower.deletion R M n).baseChange S)) := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M)
      (N := (⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M)) ⊗[S] (S ⊗[R] M))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change exteriorPower.deletion S (S ⊗[R] M) n
      (baseChangeMap R S M (n + 1)
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) a)) =
    TensorProduct.map (baseChangeMap R S M n)
        (LinearMap.id (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] M))
      (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange
        R S (⋀[R]^n M) M
          (((exteriorPower.deletion R M n).baseChange S)
            (s ⊗ₜ[R] exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) a)))
  rw [baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti, map_smul,
    exteriorPower.deletion_apply_ιMulti]
  simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
    exteriorPower.deletion_apply_ιMulti, map_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hbalance :
      s ⊗ₜ[R] (((-1 : R) ^ i.val) •
        ((exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] a i)) =
      (algebraMap R S ((-1 : R) ^ i.val) * s) ⊗ₜ[R]
        ((exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] a i) := by
    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul S ((-1 : R) ^ i.val)]
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hbalance, TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange_tmul,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply,
    baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti]
  simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_smul, mul_comm]
  congr 2

end exteriorPower
