module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.CliffordAlgebra.Contraction
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.LinearMap
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Deletion

/-!
# Contraction on exterior powers

Mathlib's `CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft`, specialized to the zero quadratic
form, is contraction on the exterior algebra. This file proves its pure-word
formula and homogeneous degree behavior, restricts it to consecutive exterior
powers, and records square-zero, anticommutation, naturality, and compatibility
with the existing exterior-power deletion map.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Function

universe u v w

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Contraction by a linear functional on a decomposable exterior word. -/
theorem contractLeft_ιMulti (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft x (ιMulti R (n + 1) a) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ i.val •
        (x (a i) • ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul,
        Fin.sum_univ_one]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [ιMulti_succ_apply, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul, ih]
      conv_rhs => rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have hhead : a ∘ (0 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove = Matrix.vecTail a := by
        funext j
        rw [Function.comp_apply, Fin.zero_succAbove]
        rfl
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Fin.val_succ]
      rw [hhead, sub_eq_add_neg]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hdelete : a ∘ i.succ.succAbove =
          Matrix.vecCons (a 0) (Matrix.vecTail a ∘ i.succAbove) := by
        funext j
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
        · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_succAbove_zero, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_succAbove_succ, Matrix.cons_val_succ]
          rfl
      rw [hdelete, ιMulti_succ_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply,
        pow_succ, mul_neg, mul_one, neg_smul, mul_smul_comm]
      congr 3

/-- Contraction lowers a positive homogeneous exterior degree by one. -/
theorem contractLeft_mem_exteriorPower (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) :
    CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft x a ∈ ⋀[R]^n M := by
  rw [← ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_span_fixedDegree R (n + 1)] at ha
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun a _ ↦ CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft x a ∈ ⋀[R]^n M) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [contractLeft_ιMulti R M x n v]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_range R n (Set.mem_range_self _)))
  · simpa only [map_zero] using (Submodule.zero_mem (⋀[R]^n M))
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    simpa only [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem (⋀[R]^n M) ha hb
  · intro r a _ ha
    simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem (⋀[R]^n M) r ha

end ExteriorAlgebra

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Contraction by a linear functional, restricted from exterior degree
`n + 1` to exterior degree `n`. -/
def contractLeft (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  (CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft x).restrict
    (ExteriorAlgebra.contractLeft_mem_exteriorPower R M x n)

/-- The underlying exterior-algebra value of degree-restricted contraction. -/
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_apply_coe (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ)
    (a : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) :
    (contractLeft R M x n a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft x a :=
  rfl

/-- Degree-restricted contraction is linear in the contracting functional. -/
def contractLeftLinear (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Dual R M →ₗ[R]
      ((⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n M)) where
  toFun x := contractLeft R M x n
  map_add' x y := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    change CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) (x + y)
        (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) x
          (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) +
        CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) y
          (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  map_smul' r x := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    change CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) (r • x)
        (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      r • CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) x
        (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]

/-- Evaluating the bundled degree-restricted contraction recovers
`contractLeft`. -/
theorem contractLeftLinear_apply (n : ℕ) (x : Module.Dual R M) :
    contractLeftLinear R M n x = contractLeft R M x n :=
  rfl

/-- Contraction by the zero functional is zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_zero (n : ℕ) :
    contractLeft R M (0 : Module.Dual R M) n = 0 :=
  map_zero (contractLeftLinear R M n)

/-- Contraction by a sum is the sum of contractions. -/
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_add (x y : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    contractLeft R M (x + y) n =
      contractLeft R M x n + contractLeft R M y n :=
  map_add (contractLeftLinear R M n) x y

/-- Contraction is compatible with scalar multiplication of the functional. -/
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_smul (r : R) (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    contractLeft R M (r • x) n = r • contractLeft R M x n :=
  map_smul (contractLeftLinear R M n) r x

/-- Signed pure-word formula for degree-restricted contraction. -/
theorem contractLeft_apply_ιMulti (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    contractLeft R M x n (ιMulti R (n + 1) a) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ i.val •
        (x (a i) • ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [contractLeft_apply_coe, ιMulti_apply_coe, SetLike.val_smul_of_tower,
    Submodule.coe_sum] using ExteriorAlgebra.contractLeft_ιMulti R M x n a

/-- Evaluating the removed factor of `exteriorPower.deletion` by `x` is
degree-restricted contraction. -/
theorem contractLeft_eq_deletion (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    contractLeft R M x n =
      (TensorProduct.rid R (⋀[R]^n M)).toLinearMap.comp
        ((TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id (R := R) (M := (⋀[R]^n M))) x).comp
          (deletion R M n)) := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M) (N := ⋀[R]^n M)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [contractLeft_apply_ιMulti, deletion_apply_ιMulti]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.rid_tmul]

/-- Successive contractions by the same functional compose to zero. -/
theorem contractLeft_comp_contractLeft (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (contractLeft R M x n).comp (contractLeft R M x (n + 1)) = 0 := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) x
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)

/-- Contractions by two functionals anticommute. -/
theorem contractLeft_anticomm (x y : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (contractLeft R M x n).comp (contractLeft R M y (n + 1)) =
      -((contractLeft R M y n).comp (contractLeft R M x (n + 1))) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_comm (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) x y
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)

/-- Degree-restricted contraction is natural under a linear map compatible
with the two functionals. -/
theorem contractLeft_naturality
    {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (x : Module.Dual R M) (y : Module.Dual R N) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hxy : y.comp f = x) (n : ℕ) :
    (contractLeft R N y n).comp (map (n + 1) f) =
      (map n f).comp (contractLeft R M x n) := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M) (N := ⋀[R]^n N)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    map_apply_ιMulti, contractLeft_apply_ιMulti, map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hcoeff : y (f (a i)) = x (a i) := LinearMap.congr_fun hxy (a i)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hcoeff]
  rfl

/-- In degrees one and zero, contraction is the original functional under
the canonical exterior-power equivalences. -/
theorem zeroEquiv_comp_contractLeft (x : Module.Dual R M) :
    (zeroEquiv R M).toLinearMap.comp (contractLeft R M x 0) =
      x.comp (oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := 1) (M := M) (N := R)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  simp [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    contractLeft_apply_ιMulti]

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.BaseChange
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.BaseChange
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Contraction

/-!
# Base change for exterior contraction

Contraction by a functional commutes with scalar extension. The scalar
extended functional is Mathlib's canonical `Module.Dual.baseChange`.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v w

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Exterior contraction commutes with extension of scalars. -/
theorem contractLeft_baseChange (x : Module.Dual R M) (n : ℕ) :
    (contractLeft S (S ⊗[R] M) (x.baseChange S) n).comp
        (baseChangeMap R S M (n + 1)) =
      (baseChangeMap R S M n).comp
        ((contractLeft R M x n).baseChange S) := by
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_injective
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M)
      (N := ⋀[S]^n (S ⊗[R] M))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change contractLeft S (S ⊗[R] M) (x.baseChange S) n
      (baseChangeMap R S M (n + 1)
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R (n + 1) a)) =
    baseChangeMap R S M n
      (((contractLeft R M x n).baseChange S)
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] ιMulti R (n + 1) a))
  rw [baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti, map_smul,
    contractLeft_apply_ιMulti]
  simp only [Module.Dual.baseChange_apply_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
    contractLeft_apply_ιMulti, map_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hbalance :
      s ⊗ₜ[R] (((-1 : R) ^ i.val) •
        (x (a i) • ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove))) =
      (algebraMap R S (((-1 : R) ^ i.val) * x (a i)) * s) ⊗ₜ[R]
        ιMulti R n (a ∘ i.succAbove) := by
    rw [smul_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul S
      (((-1 : R) ^ i.val) * x (a i))]
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hbalance, baseChangeMap_apply_tmul_ιMulti]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, smul_smul, Function.comp_apply,
    map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  congr 1
  ring

end exteriorPower

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Contraction

/-!
# Contraction and left exterior multiplication

Left exterior multiplication raises homogeneous degree by one. Restricted
contraction and left multiplication satisfy Cartan's contraction identity,
as a direct homogeneous consequence of Mathlib's
`CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul`.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Left exterior multiplication by a vector between consecutive exterior
powers. -/
def wedgeLeft (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) :=
  alternatingMapLinearEquiv ((ιMulti R (n + 1)).curryLeft m)

/-- Left multiplication prepends the fixed vector to a pure exterior word. -/
@[simp]
theorem wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti (m : M) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → M) :
    wedgeLeft R M m n (ιMulti R n a) =
      ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons m a) := by
  simp [wedgeLeft]

/-- The ambient exterior-algebra value of `wedgeLeft` is multiplication by
the exterior generator. -/
theorem wedgeLeft_apply_coe (m : M) (n : ℕ) (a : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    (wedgeLeft R M m n a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m * (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) := by
  let lhs : (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M :=
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M).subtype.comp (wedgeLeft R M m n)
  let rhs : (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M :=
    ((Algebra.lmul R (ExteriorAlgebra R M)) (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m)).comp
      (⋀[R]^n M).subtype
  have h : lhs = rhs := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
      (R := R) (n := n) (M := M) (N := ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    apply AlternatingMap.ext
    intro v
    change (wedgeLeft R M m n (ιMulti R n v) : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m * (ιMulti R n v : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    rw [wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti, ιMulti_apply_coe, ιMulti_apply_coe,
      ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    congr 1
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h a

/-- Left exterior multiplication is natural under a linear map. -/
theorem map_comp_wedgeLeft
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    (map (n + 1) f).comp (wedgeLeft R M m n) =
      (wedgeLeft R N (f m) n).comp (map n f) := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n) (M := M) (N := ⋀[R]^(n + 1) N)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti]
  congr 1
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
  · rfl
  · rfl

/-- Cartan's identity for contraction and left exterior multiplication in
positive source degree. -/
theorem contractLeft_comp_wedgeLeft_add_wedgeLeft_comp_contractLeft
    (x : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    (contractLeft R M x (n + 1)).comp (wedgeLeft R M m (n + 1)) +
        (wedgeLeft R M m n).comp (contractLeft R M x n) =
      x m • LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (contractLeft R M x (n + 1) (wedgeLeft R M m (n + 1) a) :
        ExteriorAlgebra R M) +
      (wedgeLeft R M m n (contractLeft R M x n a) : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
        x m • (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
  rw [contractLeft_apply_coe, wedgeLeft_apply_coe, wedgeLeft_apply_coe,
    contractLeft_apply_coe, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul]
  exact sub_add_cancel _ _

/-- Degree-zero endpoint of Cartan's contraction identity. -/
theorem contractLeft_comp_wedgeLeft_zero
    (x : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    (contractLeft R M x 0).comp (wedgeLeft R M m 0) =
      x m • LinearMap.id := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := 0) (M := M) (N := ⋀[R]^0 M)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  simp [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti, contractLeft_apply_ιMulti]
  congr 1

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.ContractionWedge

/-!
# Actual exterior coordinates of a principal differential relation

When the fixed vector is absent from an exterior basis word, left wedge
by that vector has zero coefficient at that word. This follows from the
stock determinant pairing, including arbitrary coefficient rings.
-/

public section
noncomputable section

namespace exteriorPower

open Set Set.powersetCard

universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {I : Type w} [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R M)

/-- An absent fixed vector gives zero coefficient in every original pure exterior word. -/
theorem exteriorBasis_coord_wedge_word_of_not_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (hi : i ∉ (s : Set I)) (v : Fin n → M) :
    (b.exteriorPower (n + 1)).repr
      (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M (b i) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v)) s = 0 := by
  rw [exteriorPower.wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti, exteriorPower.basis_repr_apply,
    exteriorPower.ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti]
  apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero 0
  intro j
  change b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s j) (b i) = 0
  rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  apply Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne
  intro he
  apply hi
  rw [← he]
  exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s _).mp ⟨j, rfl⟩

/-- Every actual left wedge by an absent fixed vector has zero original exterior coefficient. -/
theorem exteriorBasis_coord_wedge_of_not_mem (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (hi : i ∉ (s : Set I)) (x : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    (b.exteriorPower (n + 1)).repr (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M (b i) n x) s = 0 := by
  let f : (⋀[R]^n M) →ₗ[R] R :=
    ((Finsupp.lapply s).comp (b.exteriorPower (n + 1)).repr.toLinearMap).comp
      (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M (b i) n)
  have hf : f = 0 := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    apply AlternatingMap.ext
    intro v
    change (b.exteriorPower (n + 1)).repr
      (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M (b i) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v)) s = 0
    exact exteriorBasis_coord_wedge_word_of_not_mem b i n s hi v
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf x

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.DomCoprod
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Fin

/-!
# Deletion from an exterior power

This file defines the positive-degree component of the exterior
comultiplication that deletes one factor and records it in a right tensor
factor. On a decomposable wedge it is given by

```text
v₀ ∧ ... ∧ vₙ ↦ ∑ r, (-1)ʳ
  (v₀ ∧ ... ∧ v̂ᵣ ∧ ... ∧ vₙ) ⊗ vᵣ.
```

The construction uses `AlternatingMap.domCoprod`, so it is independent of a
basis and natural in the module. Degree zero is deliberately not part of the
API: `deletion R M n` has source degree `n + 1`.
-/

@[expose] public section


noncomputable section

open Function
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- The identity map regarded as a one-variable alternating map. -/
private def oneAlternating : M [⋀^Fin 1]→ₗ[R] M :=
  (AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton R M M (0 : Fin 1)) LinearMap.id

/-- Put the singleton block first and identify the block sum with `Fin (n + 1)`. -/
private def deletionBlockEquiv (n : ℕ) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
  finSumFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (Nat.one_add n))

/-- The position occupied by the singleton block in a `(1,n)` shuffle. -/
private def deletionShufflePosition (n : ℕ)
    (q : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin 1) (Fin n)) : Fin (n + 1) :=
  Quotient.liftOn' q
    (fun σ => deletionBlockEquiv n (σ (Sum.inl 0)))
    (fun σ₁ σ₂ h => by
      rw [QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨sl, sr⟩, h⟩ := h
      replace h := inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp h.symm
      rw [h]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_apply,
        Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, comp_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl,
        EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, Sum.inl.injEq]
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _)

/-- The order-preserving representative of the shuffle whose singleton
occupies position `r`. -/
private noncomputable def deletionShuffleRep (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n) :=
  (Equiv.permCongr (deletionBlockEquiv n)).symm r.cycleRange.symm

private lemma deletionShuffleRep_singleton (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inl 0) = (deletionBlockEquiv n).symm r := by
  apply (deletionBlockEquiv n).injective
  rw [(deletionBlockEquiv n).apply_symm_apply]
  calc
    (deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inl 0)) =
        ((deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr (deletionShuffleRep n r))
          (deletionBlockEquiv n (Sum.inl 0)) := by
            rw [Equiv.permCongr_apply, (deletionBlockEquiv n).symm_apply_apply]
    _ = r.cycleRange.symm 0 := by
      rw [show (deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr (deletionShuffleRep n r) =
          r.cycleRange.symm by
        exact (Equiv.permCongr (deletionBlockEquiv n)).apply_symm_apply _]
      rfl
    _ = r := Fin.cycleRange_symm_zero r

private lemma deletionShuffleRep_tail (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inr j) =
      (deletionBlockEquiv n).symm (r.succAbove j) := by
  apply (deletionBlockEquiv n).injective
  rw [(deletionBlockEquiv n).apply_symm_apply]
  calc
    (deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inr j)) =
        ((deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr (deletionShuffleRep n r))
          (deletionBlockEquiv n (Sum.inr j)) := by
            rw [Equiv.permCongr_apply, (deletionBlockEquiv n).symm_apply_apply]
    _ = r.cycleRange.symm j.succ := by
      rw [show (deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr (deletionShuffleRep n r) =
          r.cycleRange.symm by
        exact (Equiv.permCongr (deletionBlockEquiv n)).apply_symm_apply _]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [deletionBlockEquiv]
    _ = r.succAbove j := Fin.cycleRange_symm_succ r j

private lemma deletionShuffleRep_sign (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign (deletionShuffleRep n r) = (-1) ^ r.val := by
  calc
    Equiv.Perm.sign (deletionShuffleRep n r) =
        Equiv.Perm.sign ((deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr
          (deletionShuffleRep n r)) :=
      (Equiv.Perm.sign_permCongr (deletionBlockEquiv n)
        (deletionShuffleRep n r)).symm
    _ = Equiv.Perm.sign r.cycleRange.symm := by
      rw [show (deletionBlockEquiv n).permCongr (deletionShuffleRep n r) =
          r.cycleRange.symm by
        exact (Equiv.permCongr (deletionBlockEquiv n)).apply_symm_apply _]
    _ = Equiv.Perm.sign r.cycleRange := Equiv.Perm.sign_inv _
    _ = (-1) ^ r.val := Fin.sign_cycleRange r

private lemma deletionShufflePosition_rep (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    deletionShufflePosition n (Quotient.mk'' (deletionShuffleRep n r)) = r := by
  simp [deletionShufflePosition, deletionShuffleRep_singleton]

private theorem deletionShufflePosition_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (deletionShufflePosition n) := by
  intro q₁ q₂ hq
  induction q₁ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ σ₁ =>
      induction q₂ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
      | _ σ₂ =>
          simp only [deletionShufflePosition, Quotient.liftOn'_mk''] at hq
          have hσ : σ₁ (Sum.inl 0) = σ₂ (Sum.inl 0) :=
            (deletionBlockEquiv n).injective hq
          rw [Quotient.eq'', QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply]
          apply Equiv.Perm.mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl
          rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
          obtain rfl : a = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
          refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
          simp only [Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Function.comp_apply]
          rw [← hσ]
          simp

private theorem deletionShufflePosition_surjective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (deletionShufflePosition n) := by
  intro r
  exact ⟨Quotient.mk'' (deletionShuffleRep n r), deletionShufflePosition_rep n r⟩

/-- The `(1,n)` shuffle cosets are indexed by the position of the singleton
block. -/
private noncomputable def deletionShuffleEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin 1) (Fin n) ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (deletionShufflePosition n)
    ⟨deletionShufflePosition_injective n, deletionShufflePosition_surjective n⟩

private lemma deletionShuffleEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (deletionShuffleEquiv n).symm r =
      Quotient.mk'' (deletionShuffleRep n r) := by
  apply deletionShufflePosition_injective n
  change (deletionShuffleEquiv n) ((deletionShuffleEquiv n).symm r) =
    deletionShufflePosition n (Quotient.mk'' (deletionShuffleRep n r))
  rw [(deletionShuffleEquiv n).apply_symm_apply]
  exact (deletionShufflePosition_rep n r).symm

private lemma deletion_summand_rep (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M)
    (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
        ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (oneAlternating R M) (ιMulti R n)
          (Quotient.mk'' (deletionShuffleRep n r)))
            (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n)) =
      (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        ((ιMulti R n (v ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] v r) := by
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'']
  rw [_root_.smul_apply, deletionShuffleRep_sign]
  rw [@Units.smul_def _ _ (_) (_), ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R,
    LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one,
    Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
  change (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
      (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
        (((oneAlternating R M).toMultilinearMap.domCoprod
          (ιMulti R n).toMultilinearMap).domDomCongr
            (deletionShuffleRep n r) (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n)) = _
  rw [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply,
    TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
  have hargs :
      (fun j : Fin n =>
        (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inr j))) =
        v ∘ r.succAbove := by
    funext j
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, deletionShuffleRep_tail]
    simp
  have hright :
      (oneAlternating R M)
          (fun i : Fin 1 =>
            (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inl i))) =
        v r := by
    rw [oneAlternating, AlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton_apply_apply]
    change (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inl 0)) = v r
    rw [Function.comp_apply, deletionShuffleRep_singleton]
    simp
  rw [hargs]
  change (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
      ((ιMulti R n (v ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R]
        (oneAlternating R M)
          (fun i : Fin 1 =>
            (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n) (deletionShuffleRep n r (Sum.inl i)))) = _
  rw [hright]

/-- The `(1,n)` exterior coproduct followed by tensor-factor exchange. -/
private def deletionAlternating (n : ℕ) :
    M [⋀^Fin (n + 1)]→ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M) :=
  (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M)).toLinearMap.compAlternatingMap
    (((oneAlternating R M).domCoprod (ιMulti R n)).domDomCongr
      (deletionBlockEquiv n))

/-- Delete one factor from a positive exterior power and record it in a
right tensor factor. -/
@[no_expose]
def deletion (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) →ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M) :=
  alternatingMapLinearEquiv (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M)
    (N := (⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M) (deletionAlternating R M n)

private theorem deletion_apply_ιMulti_raw (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    deletion R M n (ιMulti R (n + 1) v) = deletionAlternating R M n v := by
  apply alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti

/-- Signed deletion formula on a decomposable wedge. -/
theorem deletion_apply_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    deletion R M n (ιMulti R (n + 1) v) =
      ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        ((ιMulti R n (v ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] v r) := by
  rw [deletion_apply_ιMulti_raw]
  change (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
      (((oneAlternating R M).domCoprod (ιMulti R n))
        (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n)) = _
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, _root_.sum_apply, map_sum]
  calc
    (∑ q : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin 1) (Fin n),
        (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
          ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand
            (oneAlternating R M) (ιMulti R n) q)
              (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n))) =
        ∑ r : Fin (n + 1),
          (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
            ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand
              (oneAlternating R M) (ιMulti R n)
                ((deletionShuffleEquiv n).symm r))
                  (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n)) := by
      exact ((deletionShuffleEquiv n).symm.sum_comp
        (fun q => (TensorProduct.comm R M (⋀[R]^n M))
          ((AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand
            (oneAlternating R M) (ιMulti R n) q)
              (v ∘ deletionBlockEquiv n)))).symm
    _ = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
          ((ιMulti R n (v ∘ r.succAbove)) ⊗ₜ[R] v r) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [deletionShuffleEquiv_symm_apply]
      exact deletion_summand_rep R M n v r

/-- Naturality of deletion under a linear map. -/
theorem deletion_naturality {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (n : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (TensorProduct.map (map n f) f).comp (deletion R M n) =
      (deletion R N n).comp (map (n + 1) f) := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    (R := R) (n := n + 1) (M := M)
    (N := (⋀[R]^n N) ⊗[R] N)
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
    Function.comp_apply, deletion_apply_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti,
    map_sum, map_smul, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  congr 2

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua, Avocado
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Deletion
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basis

/-!
# Injectivity of exterior-power deletion

The deletion map is injective whenever the module has a basis. The proof
recovers each exterior-basis vector from one distinguished coordinate of the
tensor-product basis. It works over every commutative ring and requires no
finite-generation or invertibility hypothesis.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true

noncomputable section

open Function
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

section Basis

variable {I : Type*} [LinearOrder I]

/-- The ordered basis subset left after deleting position `r`. -/
private noncomputable def deletionEraseIndex (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Set.powersetCard I n :=
  Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv
    ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb r).trans
      (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s))

private lemma deletionEraseIndex_insert (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    insert (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s r)
        (deletionEraseIndex n s r).val = s.val := by
  ext x
  rw [Finset.mem_insert]
  rw [Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff, Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff]
  rw [show deletionEraseIndex n s r =
      Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv
        ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb r).trans
          (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)) by rfl,
    Set.powersetCard.mem_ofFinEmbEquiv_iff_mem_range]
  change x = Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s r ∨
      x ∈ Set.range ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb r).trans
        (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)) ↔ x ∈ s
  rw [← Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨j, hj⟩)
    · exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨r.succAbove j, ?_⟩
      simpa [deletionEraseIndex] using hj
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases r.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove k with (rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hk.symm
    · exact Or.inr ⟨j, by simpa [deletionEraseIndex] using hk⟩

/-- Signed deletion formula on the exterior basis induced by `b`. -/
private theorem deletion_apply_basis (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) :
    deletion R M n (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s) =
      ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        ((b.exteriorPower n (deletionEraseIndex n s r)) ⊗ₜ[R]
          b (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s r)) := by
  rw [exteriorPower.basis_apply]
  change deletion R M n
      (ιMulti R (n + 1) (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)) = _
  rw [exteriorPower.deletion_apply_ιMulti]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  have homit :
      ιMulti R n
          ((b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s) ∘ r.succAbove) =
        b.exteriorPower n (deletionEraseIndex n s r) := by
    rw [exteriorPower.basis_apply]
    apply congrArg (ιMulti R n)
    funext j
    simp [deletionEraseIndex]
  rw [homit]
  rfl

private noncomputable def deletionInitIndex (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) : Set.powersetCard I n :=
  deletionEraseIndex n s (Fin.last n)

private noncomputable def deletionLastIndex (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) : I :=
  Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s (Fin.last n)

private lemma deletion_tensorBasis_coord (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s t : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Module.Basis.coord ((b.exteriorPower n).tensorProduct b)
        (deletionInitIndex n s, deletionLastIndex n s)
        ((b.exteriorPower n (deletionEraseIndex n t r)) ⊗ₜ[R]
          b (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r)) =
      if deletionEraseIndex n t r = deletionInitIndex n s ∧
          Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r = deletionLastIndex n s
        then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply,
    Module.Basis.tensorProduct_repr_tmul_apply]
  simp only [Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hleft : deletionEraseIndex n t r = deletionInitIndex n s <;>
    by_cases hright : Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r =
      deletionLastIndex n s <;> simp [hleft, hright]

private lemma deletion_pair_eq_imp (n : ℕ)
    (s t : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (r : Fin (n + 1))
    (hleft : deletionEraseIndex n t r = deletionInitIndex n s)
    (hright : Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r =
      deletionLastIndex n s) : t = s := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    t.val = insert (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r)
        (deletionEraseIndex n t r).val :=
      (deletionEraseIndex_insert n t r).symm
    _ = insert (deletionLastIndex n s) (deletionInitIndex n s).val := by
      rw [hleft, hright]
    _ = s.val := by
      exact deletionEraseIndex_insert n s (Fin.last n)

private def deletionDual (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) :
    Module.Dual R ((⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M) :=
  (-1 : R) ^ n •
    Module.Basis.coord ((b.exteriorPower n).tensorProduct b)
      (deletionInitIndex n s, deletionLastIndex n s)

private lemma deletionDual_apply_same (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) :
    deletionDual R M n b s
        (deletion R M n (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s)) = 1 := by
  rw [deletionDual, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    deletion_apply_basis, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last n)]
  · rw [deletion_tensorBasis_coord]
    simp only [Fin.val_last, deletionInitIndex, deletionLastIndex,
      and_self, ↓reduceIte, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [mul_one, ← mul_pow]
    simp
  · intro r _ hr
    rw [deletion_tensorBasis_coord]
    have hright : Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s r ≠
        deletionLastIndex n s := by
      exact (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s).injective.ne hr
    simp [hright]
  · simp

private lemma deletionDual_apply_ne (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (s t : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1)) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    deletionDual R M n b s
        (deletion R M n (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) t)) = 0 := by
  rw [deletionDual, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    deletion_apply_basis, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  suffices
      (∑ r : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        Module.Basis.coord ((b.exteriorPower n).tensorProduct b)
          (deletionInitIndex n s, deletionLastIndex n s)
          ((b.exteriorPower n (deletionEraseIndex n t r)) ⊗ₜ[R]
            b (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r))) = 0 by
    rw [this, smul_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r _
  rw [deletion_tensorBasis_coord]
  have hpair : ¬(deletionEraseIndex n t r = deletionInitIndex n s ∧
      Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r = deletionLastIndex n s) := by
    rintro ⟨hleft, hright⟩
    exact hst (deletion_pair_eq_imp n s t r hleft hright).symm
  simp [hpair]

private theorem deletion_basis_linearIndependent (n : ℕ)
    (b : Module.Basis I R M) :
    LinearIndependent R (fun s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1) =>
      deletion R M n (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s)) := by
  apply LinearIndependent.of_pairwise_dual_eq_zero_one
    (v := fun s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1) =>
      deletion R M n (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s))
    (f := fun s => deletionDual R M n b s)
  · intro s t hst
    exact deletionDual_apply_ne R M n b s t hst
  · intro s
    exact deletionDual_apply_same R M n b s

private theorem injective_of_exteriorBasis_images_linearIndependent (n : ℕ)
    (b : Module.Basis I R M)
    (f : (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) →ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M))
    (hli : LinearIndependent R (fun s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1) =>
      f (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s))) : Function.Injective f := by
  have hli' : LinearIndependent R
      (f ∘ fun s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1) =>
        b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s) := by
    rw [show (f ∘ fun s : Set.powersetCard I (n + 1) =>
        b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s) =
      (fun s => f (b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s)) by rfl]
    exact hli
  exact @LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent
    R (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    ((⋀[R]^n M) ⊗[R] M) inferInstance inferInstance
    f (Set.powersetCard I (n + 1))
    (fun s => b.exteriorPower (n + 1) s)
    (b.exteriorPower (n + 1)).span_eq hli'

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true in
/-- Deletion is injective when an ordered basis is supplied. -/
theorem deletion_injective_of_basis (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis I R M) :
    Function.Injective (deletion R M n) := by
  exact injective_of_exteriorBasis_images_linearIndependent R M n b
    (deletion R M n) (deletion_basis_linearIndependent R M n b)

end Basis

/-- Deletion is injective on every free module over a commutative ring. -/
theorem deletion_injective [Module.Free R M] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (deletion R M n) := by
  classical
  let _ : LinearOrder (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M) :=
    linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  exact deletion_injective_of_basis R M n (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M)

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.BaseChange
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.BaseChange
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations

/-!
# Determinantal ideals of linear maps

The coefficient ideal of a linear map is generated by all evaluations of
its values against linear forms.  Applying this construction to an exterior
power of a map gives a basis-independent determinantal ideal.  For finite
free modules, a final comparison theorem identifies it with the ideal
generated by the corresponding matrix minors.

The basis-free definition makes invariance under changes of basis formal and
also gives a clean scalar-extension theorem.  No module presentation or
numerical rank is chosen in this file.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Function
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v w z q

namespace LinearMap

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

/-- The ideal generated by all coefficients `phi (f x)` of a linear map
`f : M -> N`, without choosing bases for either module. -/
def coefficientIdeal (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Ideal R :=
  Ideal.span (Set.range (fun p : M × Module.Dual R N => p.2 (f p.1)))

/-- Every evaluation of a value of `f` against a linear form belongs to the
coefficient ideal of `f`. -/
theorem coefficient_mem (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M) (φ : Module.Dual R N) :
    φ (f x) ∈ f.coefficientIdeal :=
  Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (x, φ))

@[simp]
theorem coefficientIdeal_zero : coefficientIdeal (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) = ⊥ := by
  rw [coefficientIdeal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, φ⟩, rfl⟩
    simp
  · exact bot_le

/-- Postcomposition can only decrease the coefficient ideal. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_comp_le_left
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (g.comp f).coefficientIdeal ≤ f.coefficientIdeal := by
  rw [coefficientIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨x, φ⟩, rfl⟩
  exact coefficient_mem f x (φ.comp g)

/-- Precomposition can only decrease the coefficient ideal. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_comp_le_right
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (g.comp f).coefficientIdeal ≤ g.coefficientIdeal := by
  rw [coefficientIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨x, φ⟩, rfl⟩
  exact coefficient_mem g (f x) φ

/-- Postcomposition by a linear equivalence preserves the coefficient ideal. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_left
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (e : N ≃ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (e.toLinearMap.comp f).coefficientIdeal = f.coefficientIdeal := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact coefficientIdeal_comp_le_left e.toLinearMap f
  · have hf : e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (e.toLinearMap.comp f) = f := by
      ext x
      simp
    calc
      f.coefficientIdeal =
          (e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (e.toLinearMap.comp f)).coefficientIdeal :=
        congrArg coefficientIdeal hf.symm
      _ ≤ (e.toLinearMap.comp f).coefficientIdeal :=
        coefficientIdeal_comp_le_left e.symm.toLinearMap (e.toLinearMap.comp f)

/-- Precomposition by a linear equivalence preserves the coefficient ideal. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_right
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    (g.comp e.toLinearMap).coefficientIdeal = g.coefficientIdeal := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact coefficientIdeal_comp_le_right g e.toLinearMap
  · have hg : (g.comp e.toLinearMap).comp e.symm.toLinearMap = g := by
      ext x
      simp
    calc
      g.coefficientIdeal =
          ((g.comp e.toLinearMap).comp e.symm.toLinearMap).coefficientIdeal :=
        congrArg coefficientIdeal hg.symm
      _ ≤ (g.comp e.toLinearMap).coefficientIdeal :=
        coefficientIdeal_comp_le_right (g.comp e.toLinearMap) e.symm.toLinearMap

/-- The size-`r` determinantal ideal of a linear map, defined as the
coefficient ideal of its `r`th exterior power. -/
def determinantalIdeal (r : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Ideal R :=
  coefficientIdeal (exteriorPower.map r f)

/-- The size-zero determinantal ideal is the unit ideal.  This is the
basis-free form of the convention that the unique `0 × 0` determinant is
one. -/
@[simp]
theorem determinantalIdeal_zero (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    f.determinantalIdeal 0 = ⊤ := by
  apply (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr
  let x : ⋀[R]^0 M := (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M).symm 1
  let φ : Module.Dual R (⋀[R]^0 N) :=
    (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R N).toLinearMap
  have hnat := LinearMap.congr_fun (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv_naturality f) x
  have hx : φ (exteriorPower.map 0 f x) = 1 := by
    calc
      φ (exteriorPower.map 0 f x) = exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M x := by
        change exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R N (exteriorPower.map 0 f x) = _
        exact hnat
      _ = 1 := (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M).apply_symm_apply 1
  rw [← hx]
  exact coefficient_mem (exteriorPower.map 0 f) x φ

private theorem exteriorPower_map_zero_succ (r : ℕ) :
    exteriorPower.map (r + 1) (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) = 0 := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro a
  change exteriorPower.map (r + 1) (0 : M →ₗ[R] N)
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (r + 1) a) = 0
  rw [exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
  apply AlternatingMap.map_coord_zero _ (0 : Fin (r + 1))
  simp

/-- Every positive-size determinantal ideal of the zero map is zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem determinantalIdeal_zero_map_succ (r : ℕ) :
    determinantalIdeal (r + 1) (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) = ⊥ := by
  rw [determinantalIdeal, exteriorPower_map_zero_succ, coefficientIdeal_zero]

/-- Postcomposition by a linear equivalence preserves every determinantal
ideal. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_comp_equiv_left
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (r : ℕ) (e : N ≃ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (e.toLinearMap.comp f).determinantalIdeal r = f.determinantalIdeal r := by
  rw [determinantalIdeal, determinantalIdeal, exteriorPower.map_comp]
  exact coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_left
    (exteriorPower.mapEquiv R N r e) (exteriorPower.map r f)

/-- Precomposition by a linear equivalence preserves every determinantal
ideal. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_comp_equiv_right
    {P : Type q} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (r : ℕ) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    (g.comp e.toLinearMap).determinantalIdeal r = g.determinantalIdeal r := by
  rw [determinantalIdeal, determinantalIdeal, exteriorPower.map_comp]
  exact coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_right
    (exteriorPower.map r g) (exteriorPower.mapEquiv R M r e)

/-- Coefficient ideals commute with arbitrary scalar extension when the
target is finite free. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_baseChange
    {S : Type z} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) f.coefficientIdeal =
      (f.baseChange S).coefficientIdeal := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [coefficientIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨⟨x, φ⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    change algebraMap R S (φ (f x)) ∈ (f.baseChange S).coefficientIdeal
    have hmem := coefficient_mem (f.baseChange S) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) (φ.baseChange S)
    simpa [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Module.Dual.baseChange_apply_tmul,
      Algebra.smul_def] using hmem
  · rw [coefficientIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨t, ψ⟩, rfl⟩
    let jM : M →ₗ[R] S ⊗[R] M := TensorProduct.mk R S M 1
    let jN : N →ₗ[R] S ⊗[R] N := TensorProduct.mk R S N 1
    let ibcM : IsBaseChange S jM := TensorProduct.isBaseChange R M S
    let ibcN : IsBaseChange S jN := TensorProduct.isBaseChange R N S
    let jD : Module.Dual R N →ₗ[R] Module.Dual S (S ⊗[R] N) := ibcN.toDual
    have ibcD : IsBaseChange S jD := ibcN.dual
    induction ψ using ibcD.inductionOn generalizing t with
    | tmul φ =>
      induction t using ibcM.inductionOn with
      | tmul x =>
        change jD φ (f.baseChange S (jM x)) ∈ _
        have hfn : f.baseChange S (jM x) = jN (f x) := by
          simp [jM, jN]
        rw [hfn, show jD φ (jN (f x)) = algebraMap R S (φ (f x)) by
          exact ibcN.toDual_comp_apply φ (f x)]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) (coefficient_mem f x φ)
      | smul s t ht =>
        change jD φ (f.baseChange S (s • t)) ∈ _
        rw [map_smul, map_smul]
        exact (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) f.coefficientIdeal).smul_mem s ht
      | add t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂ =>
        change jD φ (f.baseChange S (t₁ + t₂)) ∈ _
        rw [map_add, map_add]
        exact (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) f.coefficientIdeal).add_mem ht₁ ht₂
    | smul s ψ hψ =>
      change (s • ψ) (f.baseChange S t) ∈ _
      rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
      exact (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) f.coefficientIdeal).smul_mem s (hψ t)
    | add ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ =>
      change (ψ₁ + ψ₂) (f.baseChange S t) ∈ _
      rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
      exact (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) f.coefficientIdeal).add_mem (hψ₁ t) (hψ₂ t)

/-- Determinantal ideals of maps with arbitrary source and finite free target commute
with arbitrary scalar extension. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_baseChange
    {S : Type z} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N]
    (r : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (f.determinantalIdeal r) =
      (f.baseChange S).determinantalIdeal r := by
  rw [determinantalIdeal, coefficientIdeal_baseChange]
  let eM := exteriorPower.baseChangeEquiv R S M r
  let eN := exteriorPower.baseChangeEquiv R S N r
  have hnat : eN.toLinearMap.comp ((exteriorPower.map r f).baseChange S) =
      (exteriorPower.map r (f.baseChange S)).comp eM.toLinearMap := by
    simpa only [eM, eN, exteriorPower.baseChangeEquiv_toLinearMap] using
      exteriorPower.baseChangeMap_naturality R S M f r
  calc
    ((exteriorPower.map r f).baseChange S).coefficientIdeal =
        (eN.toLinearMap.comp
          ((exteriorPower.map r f).baseChange S)).coefficientIdeal :=
      (coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_left eN _).symm
    _ = ((exteriorPower.map r (f.baseChange S)).comp
        eM.toLinearMap).coefficientIdeal :=
      congrArg coefficientIdeal hnat
    _ = (exteriorPower.map r (f.baseChange S)).coefficientIdeal :=
      coefficientIdeal_comp_equiv_right _ eM

section Field

variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
variable {P : Type v} [AddCommGroup P] [Module K P]
variable {Q : Type w} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module K Q]

/-- Over a field, the coefficient ideal of a nonzero map into a free module
is the unit ideal. -/
theorem coefficientIdeal_eq_top_of_ne_zero
    [Module.Free K Q] (f : P →ₗ[K] Q) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f.coefficientIdeal = ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.mp hf
  simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hx
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis K Q
  have hrepr : b.repr (f x) ≠ 0 := b.repr.map_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hrepr
  have hmem : b.coord i (f x) ∈ f.coefficientIdeal :=
    coefficient_mem f x (b.coord i)
  exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hmem (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by
    simpa [Module.Basis.coord_apply] using hi))

/-- For an injective map over a field, the determinantal ideal in the source
finrank is the unit ideal. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_finrank_eq_top_of_injective
    [Module.Free K P] [Module.Finite K P] [Module.Free K Q]
    (f : P →ₗ[K] Q) (hf : Injective f) :
    f.determinantalIdeal (Module.finrank K P) = ⊤ := by
  apply coefficientIdeal_eq_top_of_ne_zero
  have hntr : Nontrivial (⋀[K]^(Module.finrank K P) P) := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_pos_iff_of_free K, exteriorPower.finrank_eq]
    simp
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : ⋀[K]^(Module.finrank K P) P)
  intro hzero
  have hmapinj := exteriorPower.map_injective_field
    (n := Module.finrank K P) hf
  have h := hmapinj (show exteriorPower.map (Module.finrank K P) f x =
    exteriorPower.map (Module.finrank K P) f 0 by rw [hzero]; simp)
  exact hx h

end Field

/-- If a map into a finite free module becomes zero after quotient base change,
every positive-size determinantal ideal is contained in the quotient ideal. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_le_ideal_of_baseChange_eq_zero
    (I : Ideal R)
    [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hzero : f.baseChange (R ⧸ I) = 0) :
    f.determinantalIdeal r ≤ I := by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hr).elim
  | succ r =>
      have hmap :
          Ideal.map (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I)) (f.determinantalIdeal (r + 1)) = ⊥ := by
        rw [determinantalIdeal_baseChange, hzero, determinantalIdeal_zero_map_succ]
      rw [Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
        Ideal.mk_ker] at hmap
      exact hmap

end LinearMap

namespace Matrix

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {m : Type v} {n : Type w}
variable [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n]

/-- The ideal generated by the `r × r` minors of a matrix.  The first
index type selects rows and the second selects columns. -/
def minorIdeal (r : ℕ) (A : Matrix m n R) : Ideal R :=
  Ideal.span (Set.range fun st :
      Set.powersetCard m r × Set.powersetCard n r =>
    (A.submatrix
      (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm st.1)
      (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm st.2)).det)

end Matrix

namespace LinearMap

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

private theorem coefficientIdeal_eq_span_toMatrix
    {ι : Type z} {κ : Type q} [Fintype ι] [Finite κ] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M) (bN : Module.Basis κ R N)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    f.coefficientIdeal = Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : κ × ι =>
      LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f p.1 p.2) := by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [coefficientIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, φ⟩, rfl⟩
    change φ (f x) ∈ _
    rw [← bM.sum_repr x]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    apply (Ideal.span _).mul_mem_left
    rw [← bN.sum_repr (f (bM i))]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j _
    apply (Ideal.span _).mul_mem_right
    rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f j i ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : κ × ι =>
        LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f p.1 p.2)
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (j, i))
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨j, i⟩, rfl⟩
    change LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f j i ∈ _
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, ← Module.Basis.coord_apply]
    exact coefficient_mem f (bM i) (bN.coord j)

private theorem exteriorPower_toMatrix_apply
    {ι : Type z} {κ : Type q} [Fintype ι] [Finite κ]
    [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M) (bN : Module.Basis κ R N)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (r : ℕ)
    (s : Set.powersetCard κ r) (t : Set.powersetCard ι r) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bM.exteriorPower r) (bN.exteriorPower r)
        (exteriorPower.map r f) s t =
      ((LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f).submatrix
        (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s)
        (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t)).det := by
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, exteriorPower.basis_apply,
    exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti_family, exteriorPower.basis_repr_apply]
  unfold exteriorPower.ιMulti_family
  rw [exteriorPower.ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti, ← Matrix.det_transpose]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]

/-- In chosen finite bases, the basis-free size-`r` determinantal ideal is
the ideal generated by the `r × r` minors of the matrix.  Matrix rows are
target-basis indices and columns are source-basis indices. -/
theorem determinantalIdeal_eq_minorIdeal
    {ι : Type z} {κ : Type q} [Fintype ι] [Finite κ]
    [LinearOrder ι] [LinearOrder κ]
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M) (bN : Module.Basis κ R N)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (r : ℕ) :
    f.determinantalIdeal r =
      Matrix.minorIdeal r (LinearMap.toMatrix bM bN f) := by
  rw [determinantalIdeal,
    coefficientIdeal_eq_span_toMatrix (bM.exteriorPower r) (bN.exteriorPower r)]
  apply congrArg Ideal.span
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, t⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(s, t), (exteriorPower_toMatrix_apply bM bN f r s t).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, t⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(s, t), exteriorPower_toMatrix_apply bM bN f r s t⟩

end LinearMap

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.Pi

/-!
# Finite support of exterior powers of a free coefficient module

The finite coordinate inclusion is the existing finite linear-combination
map. Its coordinate restriction is a retraction, so the native exterior-power
map is injective. Every exterior element comes from some finite coordinate
module: write it as a finite sum of decomposable wedges and unite the finite
supports of their vectors. No ordered or finite basis of the ambient module
is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace Finsupp

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {I : Type v}

/-- The original finite coordinate inclusion as a native linear combination. -/
def finsetInclude (s : Finset I) : (s → R) →ₗ[R] (I →₀ R) := by
  classical
  exact Fintype.linearCombination R (fun i : s => Finsupp.single i.val 1)

/-- Restrict the original finitely supported vector to the finite coordinates. -/
def finsetRestrict (s : Finset I) : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (s → R) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun i : s => Finsupp.lapply i.val)

theorem finsetInclude_apply (s : Finset I) (m : s → R) :
    finsetInclude R s m = ∑ i : s, Finsupp.single i.val (m i) := by
  classical
  simp only [finsetInclude, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

@[simp]
theorem finsetRestrict_apply (s : Finset I) (m : I →₀ R) (i : s) :
    finsetRestrict R s m i = m i.val := rfl

/-- The actual coordinate restriction retracts the actual inclusion. -/
theorem finsetRestrict_comp_include (s : Finset I) :
    (finsetRestrict R s).comp (finsetInclude R s) = LinearMap.id := by
  classical
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  funext i
  change finsetRestrict R s (finsetInclude R s m) i = m i
  rw [finsetRestrict_apply, finsetInclude_apply]
  change (Finsupp.lapply i.val : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] R)
    (∑ j : s, Finsupp.single j.val (m j)) = m i
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  · intro j hj hji
    have hval : j.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hji (Subtype.ext h)
    simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hval.symm]
  · simp only [Finset.mem_univ, not_true_eq_false, false_implies]

/-- Restriction followed by inclusion recovers a vector whose support is
contained in the original finite coordinate set. -/
theorem finsetInclude_restrict_of_support_subset (s : Finset I) (m : I →₀ R)
    (hm : m.support ⊆ s) : finsetInclude R s (finsetRestrict R s m) = m := by
  classical
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro a
  rw [finsetInclude_apply]
  change (Finsupp.lapply a : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] R)
    (∑ j : s, Finsupp.single j.val (finsetRestrict R s m j)) = m a
  rw [map_sum]
  by_cases ha : a ∈ s
  · let i : s := ⟨a, ha⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, i, Finsupp.single_eq_same, finsetRestrict_apply]
    · intro j hj hji
      have hval : j.val ≠ a := fun h => hji (Subtype.ext h)
      simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hval.symm]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_univ, not_true_eq_false, false_implies]
  · have hzero : m a = 0 :=
      Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun h => ha (hm h))
    rw [hzero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hval : j.val ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ j.property)
    simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hval.symm]

end Finsupp

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {I : Type v}

/-- The native exterior map of the original finite coordinate inclusion is
injective because the original coordinate restriction is a retraction. -/
theorem map_finsetInclude_injective (s : Finset I) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (map n (Finsupp.finsetInclude R s)) :=
  map_injective (Finsupp.finsetRestrict R s) (Finsupp.finsetRestrict_comp_include R s)

/-- Every exterior element of the arbitrary free coordinate module has an
actual preimage in the exterior power of a finite coordinate module. -/
theorem exists_preimage_finset (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^n (I →₀ R)) :
    ∃ s : Finset I, ∃ zS : ⋀[R]^n (s → R),
      map n (Finsupp.finsetInclude R s) zS = z := by
  classical
  have hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (ιMulti R n (M := I →₀ R))) := by
    rw [ιMulti_span]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hz
  let s : Finset I := c.support.biUnion
    (fun a => Finset.univ.biUnion (fun j : Fin n => (a j).support))
  let zS : ⋀[R]^n (s → R) := c.sum
    (fun a r => r • ιMulti R n (fun j => Finsupp.finsetRestrict R s (a j)))
  refine ⟨s, zS, ?_⟩
  change map n (Finsupp.finsetInclude R s)
    (c.sum (fun a r => r • ιMulti R n (fun j => Finsupp.finsetRestrict R s (a j)))) = z
  calc
    _ = c.sum (fun a r => r •
        map n (Finsupp.finsetInclude R s)
          (ιMulti R n (fun j => Finsupp.finsetRestrict R s (a j)))) := by
      simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul]
    _ = c.sum (fun a r => r • ιMulti R n a) := by
      simp only [Finsupp.sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      apply congrArg (fun q : ⋀[R]^n (I →₀ R) => c a • q)
      rw [map_apply_ιMulti]
      apply congrArg (ιMulti R n)
      funext j
      change Finsupp.finsetInclude R s (Finsupp.finsetRestrict R s (a j)) = a j
      apply Finsupp.finsetInclude_restrict_of_support_subset
      intro i hi
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        ⟨a, ha, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hi⟩⟩
    _ = z := hc

end exteriorPower

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Kernel
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.ContractionWedge

/-!
# Fixed-slot exterior relations in every degree

Alternation moves a fixed relation from any slot to the first slot, with
the genuine transposition sign. Its span is the range of canonical left wedge.
-/

public section
noncomputable section

namespace exteriorPower

open Function

universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

/-- The actual exterior words with the fixed relation in one of their slots. -/
def fixedSlotWords (m : M) (n : ℕ) : Submodule R (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  Submodule.span R {x | ∃ (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n), v i = m ∧ x = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v}

/-- The defining generators of the fixed-slot relation submodule. -/
theorem fixedSlotWords_eq_span (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    fixedSlotWords (R := R) m n = Submodule.span R
      {x | ∃ (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n), v i = m ∧ x = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v} := by
  unfold fixedSlotWords
  rfl

/-- A one-generator module kernel gives exactly the original fixed-slot exterior relations. -/
theorem kernelSlotWords_eq_fixedSlotWords (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker f = Submodule.span R {m}) (n : ℕ) :
    kernelSlotWords f n = fixedSlotWords m n := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [kernelSlotWords_eq_span]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩
    have hm : v i ∈ Submodule.span R {m} := by
      rw [← hker]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
    have hv : v = update v i (r • m) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        rw [update_self]
        exact hr.symm
      · rw [update_of_ne hji]
    rw [hv, AlternatingMap.map_update_smul]
    exact (fixedSlotWords m n).smul_mem r
      (by unfold fixedSlotWords; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨update v i m, i, update_self _ _ _, rfl⟩)
  · have hm : f m = 0 := by
      have h := Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self (R := R) m
      rw [← hker] at h
      exact h
    unfold fixedSlotWords
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩
    rw [kernelSlotWords_eq_span]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, i, by rw [hi, hm], rfl⟩

private theorem word_first_mem_range_wedgeLeft (m : M) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) (h : v 0 = m) :
    exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) v ∈ LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M m n) := by
  refine ⟨exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (fun i => v i.succ), ?_⟩
  rw [exteriorPower.wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti]
  congr 1
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => exact h.symm
  | succ i => rfl

/-- All fixed-slot exterior relations are exactly left wedges by that relation. -/
theorem fixedSlotWords_succ_eq_range_wedgeLeft (m : M) (n : ℕ) :
    fixedSlotWords m (n + 1) = LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M m n) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold fixedSlotWords
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      exact word_first_mem_range_wedgeLeft (R := R) m n v hi
    · have hv : (v ∘ Equiv.swap 0 i) 0 = m := by
        rw [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_left, hi]
      have hm := word_first_mem_range_wedgeLeft (R := R) m n (v ∘ Equiv.swap 0 i) hv
      rw [(exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1)).map_swap v (Ne.symm hi0)] at hm
      exact (LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.wedgeLeft R M m n)).neg_mem_iff.mp hm
  · rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span R n M,
      Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [Function.comp_apply, exteriorPower.wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti]
    unfold fixedSlotWords
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Matrix.vecCons m v, 0, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The empty exterior word contains no fixed relation slot. -/
theorem fixedSlotWords_zero (m : M) : fixedSlotWords (R := R) m 0 = ⊥ := by
  unfold fixedSlotWords
  apply Submodule.span_eq_bot.mpr
  rintro x ⟨v, i, hi, hx⟩
  exact i.elim0

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic

/-!
# The actual exterior-power kernel of a surjective module map

The kernel is earned from the original exterior universal property:
an exterior word is killed when one slot belongs to the original module kernel.
The argument includes degree zero and uses no splitting hypothesis.
-/

public section
noncomputable section

namespace exteriorPower

open Function

universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

/-- The span of actual exterior words containing a slot in the original linear-map kernel. -/
def kernelSlotWords (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) : Submodule R (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  Submodule.span R {x | ∃ (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n), f (v i) = 0 ∧ x = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v}

/-- The defining generators of the actual kernel-slot submodule. -/
theorem kernelSlotWords_eq_span (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) :
    kernelSlotWords f n = Submodule.span R
      {x | ∃ (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n), f (v i) = 0 ∧ x = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v} := by
  unfold kernelSlotWords
  rfl

/-- The original exterior word in the quotient by actual kernel-slot words. -/
def quotientKernelWord (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) :
    M [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^n M) ⧸ kernelSlotWords f n) :=
  (kernelSlotWords f n).mkQ.compAlternatingMap (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n)

theorem quotientKernelWord_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    quotientKernelWord f n v = (kernelSlotWords f n).mkQ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) := by
  unfold quotientKernelWord
  rfl

private theorem quotientKernelWord_update_add (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ)
    [DecidableEq (Fin n)]
    (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n) (x y : M) :
    quotientKernelWord f n (update v i (x + y)) =
      quotientKernelWord f n (update v i x) + quotientKernelWord f n (update v i y) := by
  rw [quotientKernelWord_apply, (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n).map_update_add, map_add,
    quotientKernelWord_apply, quotientKernelWord_apply]

private theorem quotientKernelWord_update_smul (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ)
    [DecidableEq (Fin n)]
    (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n) (r : R) (x : M) :
    quotientKernelWord f n (update v i (r • x)) =
      r • quotientKernelWord f n (update v i x) := by
  rw [quotientKernelWord_apply, (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n).map_update_smul, map_smul,
    quotientKernelWord_apply]

private theorem quotientKernelWord_slot_zero (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n) (hi : f (v i) = 0) : quotientKernelWord f n v = 0 := by
  rw [quotientKernelWord_apply]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩)

private theorem quotientKernelWord_update_eq (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ)
    [DecidableEq (Fin n)]
    (v : Fin n → M) (i : Fin n) (x y : M) (h : f x = f y) :
    quotientKernelWord f n (update v i x) = quotientKernelWord f n (update v i y) := by
  have hz : quotientKernelWord f n (update v i (x - y)) = 0 :=
    quotientKernelWord_slot_zero f n _ i (by simp only [update_self, map_sub, h, sub_self])
  rw [AlternatingMap.map_update_sub] at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- Quotient exterior words depend only on the actual images of their coordinates. -/
theorem quotientKernelWord_invariant (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ)
    (v w : Fin n → M) (h : ∀ i, f (v i) = f (w i)) :
    quotientKernelWord f n v = quotientKernelWord f n w := by
  have all : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin n)) (v w : Fin n → M),
      (∀ i, i ∉ s → v i = w i) → (∀ i, f (v i) = f (w i)) →
      quotientKernelWord f n v = quotientKernelWord f n w := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty =>
      intro v w hv hw
      exact congrArg (quotientKernelWord f n) (funext (fun i => hv i (Finset.notMem_empty i)))
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      intro v w hv hw
      calc
        quotientKernelWord f n v = quotientKernelWord f n (update v i (w i)) := by
          have he := quotientKernelWord_update_eq f n v i (v i) (w i) (hw i)
          simpa only [update_eq_self] using he
        _ = quotientKernelWord f n w := by
          apply ih
          · intro j hj
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst j
              exact update_self _ _ _
            · rw [update_of_ne hji]
              exact hv j (by simp only [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]; exact ⟨hji, hj⟩)
          · intro j
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst j
              rw [update_self]
            · rw [update_of_ne hji]
              exact hw j
  exact all Finset.univ v w (by simp) h

/-- The alternating exterior word descends through the actual surjective module map. -/
def descendedKernelWord (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Surjective f) (n : ℕ) :
    N [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^n M) ⧸ kernelSlotWords f n) where
  toFun v := quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ v)
  map_update_add' v i x y := by
    change quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ update v i (x + y)) =
      quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ update v i x) +
        quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ update v i y)
    rw [comp_update, comp_update, comp_update]
    calc
      quotientKernelWord f n (update (surjInv hf ∘ v) i (surjInv hf (x + y))) =
          quotientKernelWord f n (update (surjInv hf ∘ v) i (surjInv hf x + surjInv hf y)) :=
        quotientKernelWord_update_eq f n _ i _ _ (by
          rw [surjInv_eq hf, map_add, surjInv_eq hf, surjInv_eq hf])
      _ = _ := quotientKernelWord_update_add f n (surjInv hf ∘ v) i (surjInv hf x) (surjInv hf y)
  map_update_smul' v i r x := by
    change quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ update v i (r • x)) =
      r • quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ update v i x)
    rw [comp_update, comp_update]
    calc
      quotientKernelWord f n (update (surjInv hf ∘ v) i (surjInv hf (r • x))) =
          quotientKernelWord f n (update (surjInv hf ∘ v) i (r • surjInv hf x)) :=
        quotientKernelWord_update_eq f n _ i _ _ (by rw [surjInv_eq hf, map_smul, surjInv_eq hf])
      _ = _ := quotientKernelWord_update_smul f n (surjInv hf ∘ v) i r (surjInv hf x)
  map_eq_zero_of_eq' v i j h hij := by
    exact (quotientKernelWord f n).map_eq_zero_of_eq _ (congrArg (surjInv hf) h) hij

/-- The descended word retains the original quotient class on original module tuples. -/
theorem descendedKernelWord_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Surjective f) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin n → M) :
    descendedKernelWord f hf n (f ∘ v) =
      (kernelSlotWords f n).mkQ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) := by
  unfold descendedKernelWord
  change quotientKernelWord f n (surjInv hf ∘ f ∘ v) = _
  rw [← quotientKernelWord_apply]
  apply quotientKernelWord_invariant
  intro i
  exact surjInv_eq hf _

/-- The actual surjective exterior-power map has exactly the original kernel-slot relations. -/
theorem ker_exteriorPower_map (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Surjective f) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (exteriorPower.map n f) = kernelSlotWords f n := by
  let g := exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv (descendedKernelWord f hf n)
  have hg : g.comp (exteriorPower.map n f) = (kernelSlotWords f n).mkQ := by
    dsimp only [g]
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    ext v
    simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
    exact descendedKernelWord_comp f hf n v
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    change exteriorPower.map n f x = 0 at hx
    have hz : (kernelSlotWords f n).mkQ x = 0 := by
      rw [← hg, LinearMap.comp_apply, hx, map_zero]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hz
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro x ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩
    change exteriorPower.map n f (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) = 0
    rw [exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
    exact (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n).map_coord_zero i hi

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.FixedSlot
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.Defs

/-!
# Original exterior kernel relations in actual basis words

The original fixed-slot transposition sign puts a kernel vector first.
The remaining exterior factor expands in the actual module basis.
Thus the original kernel-slot span is generated by a first kernel
vector followed by actual basis vectors. No splitting or relation
generation outcome is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

open Module Function

namespace exteriorPower

universe u v w z
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {I : Type z}

/-- Original exterior words of the actual module basis. -/
def basisWords (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ) : Set (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  Set.range (fun x : Fin n → I => ιMulti R n (b ∘ x))

/-- Actual basis exterior words span the original exterior power, including degree zero. -/
theorem basisWords_span (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span R (basisWords b n) = ⊤ := by
  classical
  have hs : basisWords b n = ιMulti R n '' {v : Fin n → M | Set.range v ⊆ Set.range b} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨b ∘ v, ?_, rfl⟩
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v i, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      have h (i : Fin n) : ∃ j, b j = v i := hv ⟨i, rfl⟩
      choose j hj using h
      exact ⟨j, congrArg (ιMulti R n) (funext hj)⟩
  rw [hs]
  exact ιMulti_span_of_span R n M (Module.Basis.span_eq b)

/-- The original first-kernel/basis-tail exterior relation span. -/
def kernelBasisWords (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule R (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) :=
  Submodule.span R {v | ∃ (y : M) (x : Fin n → I), f y = 0 ∧ v = ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.cons y (b ∘ x))}

private theorem kernelBasisWords_generator (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ)
    (y : M) (x : Fin n → I) (hy : f y = 0) :
    ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.cons y (b ∘ x)) ∈ kernelBasisWords f b n := by
  unfold kernelBasisWords
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, x, hy, rfl⟩

/-- Original kernel slots are exactly first kernel vectors followed by actual basis words. -/
theorem kernelSlotWords_succ_eq_kernelBasisWords (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ) :
    kernelSlotWords f (n + 1) = kernelBasisWords f b n := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [kernelSlotWords_eq_span]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨v, i, hi, rfl⟩
    have hm : ιMulti R (n + 1) v ∈ fixedSlotWords (v i) (n + 1) := by
      rw [fixedSlotWords_eq_span]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, i, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [fixedSlotWords_succ_eq_range_wedgeLeft] at hm
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hm
    have hmap : Submodule.span R (basisWords b n) ≤
        (kernelBasisWords f b n).comap (wedgeLeft R M (v i) n) := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change wedgeLeft R M (v i) n (ιMulti R n (b ∘ x)) ∈ kernelBasisWords f b n
      rw [wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti]
      exact kernelBasisWords_generator f b n (v i) x hi
    have hs : w ∈ Submodule.span R (basisWords b n) := by rw [basisWords_span]; trivial
    rw [← hw]
    exact hmap hs
  · unfold kernelBasisWords
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨y, x, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [kernelSlotWords_eq_span]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Fin.cons y (b ∘ x), 0, by simpa using hy, rfl⟩

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.ContractionWedge
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Determinant.Basic

/-!
# Actual leading exterior determinant coefficients

The coefficient functional uses the original exterior pairing on the actual
dual coordinate tuple. When an outside basis index is absent from the other
wedge factors, determinant expansion isolates that coordinate. No coefficient
or containment model is supplied.
-/

public section
noncomputable section
namespace exteriorPower

open Module
universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {I : Type w} [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R M)

/-- The actual determinant coefficient with an outside coordinate prepended to a basis tuple. -/
def leadingCoefficient {n : ℕ} (j : I) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) :
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) →ₗ[R] R :=
  pairingDual R M (n + 1)
    (ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.cons (b.coord j) (fun i => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s i))))

/-- The original determinant functional has its literal actual-coordinate matrix value. -/
theorem leadingCoefficient_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (j : I) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    leadingCoefficient b j s (ιMulti R (n + 1) a) =
      Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i k =>
        (Fin.cons (b.coord j) (fun l => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s l)) :
          Fin (n + 1) → Module.Dual R M) k (a i))) := by
  unfold leadingCoefficient
  rw [pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti]

/-- The actual exterior determinant isolates an outside coordinate on a tuple with no outside factor. -/
theorem leadingCoefficient_cons {n : ℕ} (j : I) (s : Set.powersetCard I n) (x : M) (a : Fin n → M)
    (ha : ∀ i, b.coord j (a i) = 0) :
    leadingCoefficient b j s (ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.cons x a)) =
      b.coord j x * ιMultiDual R n b s (ιMulti R n a) := by
  classical
  rw [leadingCoefficient_ιMulti, Matrix.det_succ_column_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_zero]
    rw [ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti]
    have hminor : (Matrix.of (fun i k =>
        (Fin.cons (b.coord j) (fun l => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s l)) :
          Fin (n + 1) → Module.Dual R M) k ((Fin.cons x a : Fin (n + 1) → M) i))).submatrix
          (Fin.succAbove 0) Fin.succ =
        Matrix.of (fun i k => b.coord (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s k) (a i)) := by
      ext i k
      simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.zero_succAbove, Fin.cons_succ]
    rw [hminor]
  · intro i _ hi
    have he : i = (i.pred hi).succ := (Fin.succ_pred i hi).symm
    rw [he]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, ha (i.pred hi), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    exact False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ 0))

/-- A leading exterior determinant vanishes on every different actual basis tuple without the outside index. -/
theorem leadingCoefficient_wedge_basis {n : ℕ} (j : I) (s t : Set.powersetCard I n) (x : M)
    (hj : j ∉ t) :
    leadingCoefficient b j s (wedgeLeft R M x n (b.exteriorPower n t)) =
      if s = t then b.coord j x else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [basis_apply, ιMulti_family, wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti]
  change leadingCoefficient b j s (ιMulti R (n + 1)
    (Fin.cons x (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t))) = _
  rw [leadingCoefficient_cons]
  · change b.coord j x * ιMultiDual R n b s (ιMulti_family R n b t) = _
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · rw [ite_eq_left hst, hst, ιMultiDual_apply_diag, mul_one]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hst, ιMultiDual_apply_nondiag R n b s t hst, mul_zero]
  · intro i
    rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Function.comp_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    apply ite_eq_right
    intro he
    apply hj
    rw [← he]
    exact Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem t _ |>.mp ⟨i, rfl⟩

end exteriorPower
