module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.LeadingCoefficient

/-!
# Missing-row support of an actual leading exterior coefficient

A tail factor whose basis index is absent from all determinant coordinates
gives a zero row. The outside index may occur at other tail positions.
The statement applies to arbitrary basis index sets and every exterior degree.
-/

public section
noncomputable section
namespace exteriorPower

universe u v w
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
variable {I : Type w} [LinearOrder I] (b : Module.Basis I R M)

/-- An actual tail basis factor absent from the source and outside coordinates forces a zero determinant row. -/
theorem leadingCoefficient_wedge_basis_zero_of_missing_index {n : ℕ}
    (j : I) (s t : Set.powersetCard I n) (x : M) (r : Fin n)
    (hr : Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r ∉ s)
    (hrj : Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t r ≠ j) :
    leadingCoefficient b j s (wedgeLeft R M x n (b.exteriorPower n t)) = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [basis_apply, ιMulti_family, wedgeLeft_apply_ιMulti]
  change leadingCoefficient b j s (ιMulti R (n + 1)
    (Fin.cons x (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm t))) = 0
  rw [leadingCoefficient_ιMulti]
  apply Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero r.succ
  intro k
  induction k using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hrj]
  | succ k =>
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    apply ite_eq_right
    intro he
    apply hr
    exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s _).mp ⟨k, he.symm⟩

end exteriorPower

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.ContractionWedge
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
# Exactness of exterior multiplication by a genuine nonzero vector

Dual separation earns a normalized contraction internally over any field.
Cartan's identity then proves the entire positive-degree kernel of left
wedge is its previous-degree image. The zero-degree map is injective.
No finite dimension, chosen basis, splitting or source residue certificate
is assumed.
-/

public section
noncomputable section
namespace exteriorPower

universe u v
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]

private theorem wedge_twice_zero (w : M) (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[K]^n M) :
    wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1) (wedgeLeft K M w n x) = 0 := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1) (wedgeLeft K M w n x) : ExteriorAlgebra K M) = 0
  rw [wedgeLeft_apply_coe, wedgeLeft_apply_coe, ← mul_assoc, ExteriorAlgebra.ι_sq_zero, zero_mul]

/-- A normalized actual contraction recovers every vector killed by the next wedge map. -/
theorem wedge_kernel_eq_wedge_contraction (w : M) (φ : Module.Dual K M) (hφ : φ w = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[K]^(n + 1) M) (hx : wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1) x = 0) :
    wedgeLeft K M w n (contractLeft K M φ n x) = x := by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (contractLeft_comp_wedgeLeft_add_wedgeLeft_comp_contractLeft K M φ w n) x
  simpa only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hx, map_zero, zero_add,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hφ, one_smul] using h

/-- The entire positive-degree kernel of actual left wedge is exactly the preceding wedge image. -/
theorem ker_wedgeLeft_eq_range_of_ne_zero (w : M) (hw : w ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1)) = LinearMap.range (wedgeLeft K M w n) := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one K hw
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨contractLeft K M φ n x, wedge_kernel_eq_wedge_contraction w φ hφ n x hx⟩
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact wedge_twice_zero w n y

/-- The genuine left-wedge sequence is exact in every positive degree, including infinite-dimensional modules. -/
theorem wedgeLeft_exact_of_ne_zero (w : M) (hw : w ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (wedgeLeft K M w n) (wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1)) := by
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
  exact ker_wedgeLeft_eq_range_of_ne_zero w hw n

/-- The zero-degree exterior multiplication by a genuine nonzero vector is injective. -/
theorem wedgeLeft_zero_injective_of_ne_zero (w : M) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (wedgeLeft K M w 0) := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one K hw
  have h := contractLeft_comp_wedgeLeft_zero K M φ w
  rw [hφ, one_smul] at h
  apply Function.LeftInverse.injective (f := wedgeLeft K M w 0) (g := contractLeft K M φ 0)
  intro x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

/-- In positive degree, actual next-wedge vanishing is precisely a genuine preceding-wedge representation. -/
theorem wedgeLeft_eq_zero_iff_mem_range (w : M) (hw : w ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[K]^(n + 1) M) :
    wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1) x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : ⋀[K]^n M, wedgeLeft K M w n y = x := by
  change x ∈ LinearMap.ker (wedgeLeft K M w (n + 1)) ↔ _
  rw [ker_wedgeLeft_eq_range_of_ne_zero w hw n]
  rfl

/-- An actual linear map killing a nonzero vector kills every exterior form annihilated by wedge with that vector. -/
theorem map_eq_zero_of_wedgeLeft_eq_zero
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] (f : M →ₗ[K] N) (w : M) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hfw : f w = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[K]^n M) (hx : wedgeLeft K M w n x = 0) :
    map n f x = 0 := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x = 0 := (wedgeLeft_zero_injective_of_ne_zero w hw) (hx.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    rw [hx0, map_zero]
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (wedgeLeft_eq_zero_iff_mem_range w hw n x).mp hx
    rw [← hy]
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (map_comp_wedgeLeft K M f w n) y
    change map (n + 1) f (wedgeLeft K M w n y) = wedgeLeft K N (f w) n (map n f y) at h
    rw [h, hfw]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (wedgeLeft K N 0 n (map n f y) : ExteriorAlgebra K N) = 0
    rw [wedgeLeft_apply_coe, map_zero, zero_mul]

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.Product
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DirectSum.TensorProduct

/-!
# Exterior powers of arbitrary product modules

The actual degree-n exterior power splits into the original mixed tensor
degrees. The proof restricts the earned exterior-algebra product equivalence
using its actual homogeneous pieces. No freeness or flatness assumption is used.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

open scoped TensorProduct DirectSum

namespace exteriorPower

universe u v w
variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) (N : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

local notation "β" => (fun p : ℕ × ℕ =>
  (ExteriorAlgebra.exteriorPower R (Prod.fst p) M) ⊗[R]
    (ExteriorAlgebra.exteriorPower R (Prod.snd p) N))
local notation "Fiber" n => {p : ℕ × ℕ // Prod.fst p + Prod.snd p = n}

/-- The original tensors of complementary exterior degrees, with the total degree recorded. -/
abbrev productPieces (n : ℕ) :=
  ⨁ p : {p : ℕ × ℕ // p.1 + p.2 = n}, (⋀[R]^p.val.1 M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^p.val.2 N)

private def productBigEquiv : ExteriorAlgebra R (M × N) ≃ₗ[R]
    (⨁ p : ℕ × ℕ, (⋀[R]^p.1 M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^p.2 N)) :=
  (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M N).toLinearEquiv.trans
    ((GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv R (fun i : ℕ => ⋀[R]^i M) (fun j : ℕ => ⋀[R]^j N)).trans
      (TensorProduct.directSum R R (fun i : ℕ => ⋀[R]^i M) (fun j : ℕ => ⋀[R]^j N)))

private def productRegroupEquiv :
    (⨁ p : ℕ × ℕ, (⋀[R]^p.1 M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^p.2 N)) ≃ₗ[R]
      (⨁ n : ℕ, productPieces R M N n) :=
  (DirectSum.lequivCongrLeft R (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2)).symm).trans
    (DirectSum.sigmaLcurryEquiv R (δ := fun (n : ℕ) (p : Fiber n) => β p.val))

private theorem productRegroupEquiv_of (i j : ℕ) (z : (⋀[R]^i M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^j N)) :
    productRegroupEquiv R M N (DirectSum.of β (i, j) z) =
      DirectSum.of (productPieces R M N) (i + j)
        (DirectSum.of (fun p : Fiber (i + j) => β p.val) ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ z) := by
  change DirectSum.sigmaFiberAddEquiv (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1 + p.2) (DirectSum.of β (i, j) z) = _
  exact DirectSum.sigmaFiberAddEquiv_of _ _ _

private def productTotalEquiv : ExteriorAlgebra R (M × N) ≃ₗ[R] (⨁ n : ℕ, productPieces R M N n) :=
  (productBigEquiv R M N).trans (productRegroupEquiv R M N)

private theorem productTotalEquiv_mixed (i j : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^i M) (y : ⋀[R]^j N) :
    productTotalEquiv R M N
      (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) x * ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) y) =
      DirectSum.of (productPieces R M N) (i + j)
        (DirectSum.of (fun p : Fiber (i + j) => β p.val) ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) := by
  rw [← ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor_symm_tmul R M N (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    (y : ExteriorAlgebra R N)]
  unfold productTotalEquiv productBigEquiv
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv_tmul, DirectSum.decompose_coe, DirectSum.decompose_coe]
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, TensorProduct.directSum_lof_tmul_lof,
    DirectSum.lof_eq_of, productRegroupEquiv_of]

private theorem productTotalEquiv_symm_mixed (n : ℕ)
    (p : {p : ℕ × ℕ // p.1 + p.2 = n}) (x : ⋀[R]^p.val.1 M) (y : ⋀[R]^p.val.2 N) :
    (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm
      (DirectSum.of (productPieces R M N) n
        (DirectSum.of (fun p : Fiber n => β p.val) p (x ⊗ₜ[R] y))) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) x * ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) y := by
  rcases p with ⟨⟨i, j⟩, h⟩
  subst n
  exact ((productTotalEquiv R M N).eq_symm_apply.mpr (productTotalEquiv_mixed R M N i j x y)).symm

private theorem productTotalEquiv_symm_mem (n : ℕ) (z : productPieces R M N n) :
    (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (productPieces R M N) n z) ∈
      ⋀[R]^n (M × N) := by
  induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add z t hz ht =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz ht
  | of p z =>
    rcases p with ⟨⟨i, j⟩, h⟩
    subst n
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add z t hz ht =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz ht
    | tmul x y =>
      rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, productTotalEquiv_symm_mixed]
      have hx : ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) x ∈ ⋀[R]^i (M × N) := by
        simpa only [exteriorPower.coe_map] using (exteriorPower.map i (LinearMap.inl R M N) x).property
      have hy : ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) y ∈ ⋀[R]^j (M × N) := by
        simpa only [exteriorPower.coe_map] using (exteriorPower.map j (LinearMap.inr R M N) y).property
      exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded hx hy

private def productAssembly (n : ℕ) : productPieces R M N n →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n (M × N)) :=
  (((productTotalEquiv R M N).symm.toLinearMap).comp (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (productPieces R M N) n)).codRestrict
    (⋀[R]^n (M × N)) (productTotalEquiv_symm_mem R M N n)

private theorem productAssembly_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (productAssembly R M N n) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (productAssembly R M N n) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h := (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)
    have h' := congrArg (fun z : ⨁ n : ℕ, productPieces R M N n => z n) h
    simpa only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_same] using h'
  let G : (⨁ n : ℕ, productPieces R M N n) →ₗ[R] (⨁ n : ℕ, ⋀[R]^n (M × N)) :=
    DirectSum.lmap (productAssembly R M N)
  have hG : (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N))).comp G =
      (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm.toLinearMap := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    intro k
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    simp only [G, LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof, DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof]
    rfl
  have hsur : Function.Surjective G := by
    intro z
    let y : ⨁ n : ℕ, productPieces R M N n :=
      productTotalEquiv R M N (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N)) z)
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N))).injective
    change DirectSum.coeLinearMap (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N)) (G y) =
      DirectSum.coeLinearMap (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N)) z
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hG]
    exact (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm_apply_apply _
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
  intro w
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsur (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n (M × N)) n w)
  refine ⟨z n, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun t : ⨁ n : ℕ, ⋀[R]^n (M × N) => t n) hz
  simpa only [G, DirectSum.lmap_apply, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_eq_same] using h

/-- The actual exterior power of a product is the direct sum of its original mixed tensor degrees. -/
@[no_expose]
def productEquiv (n : ℕ) : (⋀[R]^n (M × N)) ≃ₗ[R] productPieces R M N n :=
  (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (productAssembly R M N n) (productAssembly_bijective R M N n)).symm

/-- The inverse assembles the original R-first exterior product of every actual mixed tensor. -/
theorem productEquiv_symm_mixed (n : ℕ)
    (p : {p : ℕ × ℕ // p.1 + p.2 = n}) (x : ⋀[R]^p.val.1 M) (y : ⋀[R]^p.val.2 N) :
    ((productEquiv R M N n).symm (DirectSum.of _ p (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) : ExteriorAlgebra R (M × N)) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) x * ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) y := by
  change (productTotalEquiv R M N).symm
    (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (productPieces R M N) n (DirectSum.of _ p (x ⊗ₜ[R] y))) = _
  rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  exact productTotalEquiv_symm_mixed R M N n p x y

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.RankOneSplitting

/-!
# Exterior powers after adjoining one free summand

The original exterior power of M × R splits into the old exterior power
and the old power one degree lower. The maps are the actual inclusion,
projection, contraction by the last coordinate and wedge by its basis
vector. Both inverse identities are proved in the original exterior
algebra, with their literal order and signs.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace exteriorPower

universe u v

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- The original projection/contraction coordinates on an exterior power
of M × R. -/
def productOneDecompose (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) × (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  (map (n + 1) (LinearMap.fst R M R)).prod
    ((map n (LinearMap.fst R M R)).comp
      (contractLeft R (M × R) (LinearMap.snd R M R) n))

@[simp]
theorem productOneDecompose_apply (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) :
    productOneDecompose R M n z =
      (map (n + 1) (LinearMap.fst R M R) z,
        map n (LinearMap.fst R M R)
          (contractLeft R (M × R) (LinearMap.snd R M R) n z)) := rfl

/-- Assemble the original inclusion and the wedge of the last basis
vector, with that vector on the left. -/
def productOneAssemble (n : ℕ) :
    ((⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) × (⋀[R]^n M)) →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) :=
  (map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R M R)).comp (LinearMap.fst R _ _) +
    (wedgeLeft R (M × R) (0, 1) n).comp
      ((map n (LinearMap.inl R M R)).comp (LinearMap.snd R _ _))

@[simp]
theorem productOneAssemble_apply (n : ℕ)
    (a : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) (b : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    productOneAssemble R M n (a, b) =
      map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R M R) a +
        wedgeLeft R (M × R) (0, 1) n (map n (LinearMap.inl R M R) b) := rfl

/-- The last-coordinate contraction is fixed by the original complement
projection in every degree. -/
theorem productOneComplement_contractLeft (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) :
    map n ((LinearMap.inl R M R).comp (LinearMap.fst R M R))
        (contractLeft R (M × R) (LinearMap.snd R M R) n z) =
      contractLeft R (M × R) (LinearMap.snd R M R) n z := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_map, contractLeft_apply_coe,
    ← ExteriorAlgebra.rankOneComplement_prod]
  exact ExteriorAlgebra.map_rankOneComplement_contractLeft R (M × R)
    (LinearMap.snd R M R) (0, 1) z

/-- Assembly after decomposition is the identity on the actual exterior
power, using the proved rank-one exterior identity. -/
theorem productOneAssemble_decompose (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) :
    productOneAssemble R M n (productOneDecompose R M n z) = z := by
  rw [productOneDecompose_apply, productOneAssemble_apply]
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← map_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (map n (LinearMap.inl R M R)), ← map_comp,
    productOneComplement_contractLeft, ← ExteriorAlgebra.rankOneComplement_prod]
  exact map_rankOneComplement_add_wedge_contract R (M × R)
    (LinearMap.snd R M R) (0, 1) n z

/-- Decomposition after assembly retains both original coordinates. -/
theorem productOneDecompose_assemble (n : ℕ)
    (a : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) (b : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    productOneDecompose R M n (productOneAssemble R M n (a, b)) = (a, b) := by
  rw [productOneAssemble_apply, productOneDecompose_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, coe_map, wedgeLeft_apply_coe]
    rw [map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι]
    simp only [LinearMap.fst_apply, map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.map_comp_map, LinearMap.fst_comp_inl,
      ExteriorAlgebra.map_id]
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, coe_map, contractLeft_apply_coe,
      wedgeLeft_apply_coe]
    rw [CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul]
    have ha := ExteriorAlgebra.contractLeft_map_eq_zero R (M × R)
      (LinearMap.snd R M R) (LinearMap.inl R M R) (by rfl)
      (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    have hb := ExteriorAlgebra.contractLeft_map_eq_zero R (M × R)
      (LinearMap.snd R M R) (LinearMap.inl R M R) (by rfl)
      (b : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    simp only [ha, hb, LinearMap.snd_apply, one_smul, mul_zero, sub_zero,
      map_zero, zero_add]
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.map_comp_map, LinearMap.fst_comp_inl,
      ExteriorAlgebra.map_id]
    rfl

/-- The actual degreewise exterior-power splitting used in Koszul
regular-sequence induction, with explicit inverse maps. -/
def productOneEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^(n + 1) (M × R)) ≃ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) × (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (productOneDecompose R M n) (productOneAssemble R M n)
    (by apply LinearMap.ext; rintro ⟨a, b⟩; exact productOneDecompose_assemble R M n a b)
    (by apply LinearMap.ext; intro z; exact productOneAssemble_decompose R M n z)

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.OfAlternating
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.CliffordAlgebra.Conjugation

/-!
# Canonical exterior-degree projections

The native alternating universal property of the entire exterior algebra
defines the projection to one homogeneous degree. Its restriction is the
identity in that degree and zero in every other degree. The construction is
basis independent and natural in arbitrary linear maps.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v w

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

private def projectionAlternating (n k : ℕ) : M [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  if h : k = n then (ιMulti R n).domDomCongr (finCongr h.symm) else 0

/-- The canonical projection from the exterior algebra to exterior degree `n`. -/
def projection (n : ℕ) : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n M) :=
  private_decl% (ExteriorAlgebra.liftAlternating (projectionAlternating R M n))

@[simp]
theorem projection_ιMulti_self (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    projection R M n (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n v) = ιMulti R n v := by
  change ExteriorAlgebra.liftAlternating (projectionAlternating R M n)
    (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n v) = _
  rw [ExteriorAlgebra.liftAlternating_apply_ιMulti]
  simp only [projectionAlternating, dif_pos rfl]
  rfl

theorem projection_ιMulti_ne (n k : ℕ) (h : k ≠ n) (v : Fin k → M) :
    projection R M n (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k v) = 0 := by
  change ExteriorAlgebra.liftAlternating (projectionAlternating R M n)
    (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k v) = _
  simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.liftAlternating_apply_ιMulti, projectionAlternating,
    dif_neg h, AlternatingMap.zero_apply]

/-- The degree projection is a retraction of its actual homogeneous inclusion. -/
theorem projection_comp_subtype (n : ℕ) :
    (projection R M n).comp (⋀[R]^n M).subtype = LinearMap.id := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply, ιMulti_apply_coe, projection_ιMulti_self, LinearMap.id_apply]

@[simp]
theorem projection_subtype_apply (n : ℕ) (a : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    projection R M n (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = a :=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (projection_comp_subtype R M n) a

/-- Every other homogeneous degree is killed. -/
theorem projection_comp_subtype_ne (n k : ℕ) (h : k ≠ n) :
    (projection R M n).comp (⋀[R]^k M).subtype = 0 := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply, ιMulti_apply_coe, projection_ιMulti_ne R M n k h,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]

theorem projection_eq_zero_of_mem (n k : ℕ) (h : k ≠ n)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M) : projection R M n a = 0 :=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (projection_comp_subtype_ne R M n k h) ⟨a, ha⟩

/-- The native grade involution on an exterior word has its expected sign. -/
theorem involute_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) :
    CliffordAlgebra.involute (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n v) =
      (-1 : R) ^ n • ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R n v := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_zero_apply, map_one, pow_zero, one_smul]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply, map_mul,
        CliffordAlgebra.involute_ι, ih]
      rw [mul_smul_comm, neg_mul, pow_succ, ← smul_smul, neg_one_smul]

/-- The degree projection of the grade involution has sign `(-1)^n`. -/
theorem projection_involute (n : ℕ) (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    projection R M n (CliffordAlgebra.involute a) = (-1 : R) ^ n • projection R M n a := by
  have h : (projection R M n).comp
      (CliffordAlgebra.involute : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M).toLinearMap =
      (-1 : R) ^ n • projection R M n := by
    apply ExteriorAlgebra.lhom_ext
    intro k
    apply AlternatingMap.ext
    intro v
    by_cases hk : k = n
    · subst k
      simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, involute_ιMulti, map_smul,
        projection_ιMulti_self, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    · simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, involute_ιMulti, map_smul,
        projection_ιMulti_ne R M n k hk, smul_zero, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h a

section Naturality

variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

/-- Degree projections commute with the native exterior map in all module universes. -/
theorem projection_naturality (n : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (projection R N n).comp (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap =
      (map n f).comp (projection R M n) := by
  have hmap (k : ℕ) (v : Fin k → M) :
      ExteriorAlgebra.map f (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k v) =
        ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R k (f ∘ v) := by
    simpa only [coe_map, ιMulti_apply_coe] using
      congrArg Subtype.val (map_apply_ιMulti f v)
  apply ExteriorAlgebra.lhom_ext
  intro k
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  by_cases hk : k = n
  · subst k
    simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, hmap, projection_ιMulti_self, map_apply_ιMulti]
  · simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, hmap, projection_ιMulti_ne R N n k hk,
      projection_ιMulti_ne R M n k hk, map_zero]

end Naturality

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective

/-!
# Exterior powers of projective modules

The native exterior-power map preserves the actual split embedding of a
projective module into a free one. Its exterior-power retraction proves
projectivity in every degree, without finite generation or a chosen basis.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Exterior powers preserve actual module projectivity over any commutative ring. -/
instance instProjective [Module.Projective R M] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Projective R (⋀[R]^n M) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hNadd, hNmodule, hNfree, i, s, hsi⟩ := Module.Projective.iff_split.mp
    (inferInstance : Module.Projective R M)
  let _ : AddCommMonoid N := hNadd
  let _ : Module R N := hNmodule
  let _ : Module.Free R N := hNfree
  let _ : AddCommGroup N := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R
  exact Module.Projective.of_split (exteriorPower.map n i) (exteriorPower.map n s)
    (by rw [← exteriorPower.map_comp, hsi, exteriorPower.map_id])

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basis
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Torsion.Free
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Basic

/-!
# Actual projective exterior powers have torsion-free scalar action

Projectivity earns an actual split embedding in a free module internally.
The original exterior map preserves that embedding, and the free exterior
basis has regular scalar action. Pullback therefore proves torsion-freeness
in every exterior degree, without finite rank or a supplied basis/splitting.
-/

public section
noncomputable section
namespace exteriorPower

universe u v
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Every exterior power of an actual projective module has regular scalar action. -/
theorem isTorsionFree_of_projective [Module.Projective R M] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.IsTorsionFree R (⋀[R]^n M) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hNadd, hNmodule, hNfree, i, s, hsi⟩ := Module.Projective.iff_split.mp
    (inferInstance : Module.Projective R M)
  let _ : AddCommMonoid N := hNadd
  let _ : Module R N := hNmodule
  let _ : Module.Free R N := hNfree
  let _ : AddCommGroup N := Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R
  let _ : Module.Free R (⋀[R]^n N) := inferInstance
  let _ : Module.IsTorsionFree R (⋀[R]^n N) := inferInstance
  have hi : Function.Injective (exteriorPower.map n i) := exteriorPower.map_injective s hsi
  exact hi.moduleIsTorsionFree (exteriorPower.map n i) (fun r x => map_smul _ r x)

/-- Every regular scalar of the original ring acts injectively on an actual projective exterior power. -/
theorem isSMulRegular_of_projective [Module.Projective R M] (n : ℕ) (r : R) (hr : IsRegular r) :
    IsSMulRegular (⋀[R]^n M) r := by
  let _ : Module.IsTorsionFree R (⋀[R]^n M) := isTorsionFree_of_projective n
  exact hr.isSMulRegular

end exteriorPower

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.ContractionWedge

/-!
# Actual rank-one splitting on exterior powers

Subtracting a rank-one map from the identity induces an exterior-algebra
map equal to identity minus exterior multiplication followed by contraction.
This identity is proved on the original exterior algebra by its genuine
generator induction. It gives the degreewise splitting used in the Koszul
regular-sequence induction.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace ExteriorAlgebra

universe u v

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- The literal complement of a rank-one linear operator. -/
def rankOneComplement (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (e : M) : M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.id - (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M e).comp ε

@[simp]
theorem rankOneComplement_apply (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (e m : M) :
    rankOneComplement R M ε e m = m - ε m • e := rfl

/-- The original exterior-algebra map of a rank-one perturbation of the
identity has this exact contraction formula, with no basis choice. -/
theorem map_rankOneComplement_add_wedge_contract
    (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (e : M) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    map (rankOneComplement R M ε e) z +
      ι R e * CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z = z := by
  induction z using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp [CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_algebraMap]
  | add z w hz hw =>
      simpa only [map_add, mul_add, add_add_add_comm] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hz hw
  | ι_mul z m hz =>
      have hp : map (rankOneComplement R M ε e) z =
          z - ι R e * CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z := eq_sub_of_add_eq hz
      have hezero : ι R e * (ι R e * CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z) = 0 := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ι_sq_zero, zero_mul]
      have hanti : ι R e * (ι R m * CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z) =
          -(ι R m * (ι R e * CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z)) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc,
          eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (ι_add_mul_swap (R := R) e m), neg_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [map_mul, map_apply_ι, rankOneComplement_apply, map_sub, map_smul, hp,
        CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
        hezero, hanti, smul_zero]
      abel

/-- Contraction vanishes on the actual exterior image of a linear map
whose composite with the functional is zero. -/
theorem contractLeft_map_eq_zero
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (hf : ε.comp f = 0)
    (z : ExteriorAlgebra R N) :
    CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε (map f z) = 0 := by
  induction z using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp [CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_algebraMap]
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, hz, hw, add_zero]
  | ι_mul z m hz =>
      have hm : ε (f m) = 0 := congrArg (fun q : N →ₗ[R] R => q m) hf
      rw [map_mul, map_apply_ι, CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul, hm, hz]
      simp

/-- The rank-one complement fixes the original contracted image. -/
theorem map_rankOneComplement_contractLeft
    (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (e : M) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    map (rankOneComplement R M ε e) (CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z) =
      CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z := by
  have h := map_rankOneComplement_add_wedge_contract R M ε e
    (CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft ε z)
  rw [CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M))] at h
  simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero] using h

/-- The actual complement for the last summand of a product is the
original projection followed by inclusion. -/
theorem rankOneComplement_prod :
    rankOneComplement R (M × R) (LinearMap.snd R M R) (0, 1) =
      (LinearMap.inl R M R).comp (LinearMap.fst R M R) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Prod.ext <;> simp [rankOneComplement_apply]

end ExteriorAlgebra

namespace exteriorPower

universe u v

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- Degreewise rank-one splitting on the original exterior powers. -/
theorem map_rankOneComplement_add_wedge_contract
    (ε : M →ₗ[R] R) (e : M) (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) :
    map (n + 1) (ExteriorAlgebra.rankOneComplement R M ε e) z +
      wedgeLeft R M e n (contractLeft R M ε n z) = z := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Submodule.coe_add, coe_map, wedgeLeft_apply_coe, contractLeft_apply_coe]
  exact ExteriorAlgebra.map_rankOneComplement_add_wedge_contract R M ε e z

end exteriorPower

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Alternating.DomCoprod

/-!
# General exterior unshuffle components

The `(p,q)` unshuffle is the alternating descent of the native exterior
product of alternating maps. Native shuffle cosets avoid multiplying by
`p! q!`; all degrees, including either empty block, work over an arbitrary
commutative ring. The summand formula and naturality use the actual maps.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Function
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v w

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- The native `(p,q)` shuffle sum is an alternating map on the entire word. -/
def unshuffleAlternating (p q : ℕ) :
    M [⋀^Fin (p + q)]→ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)) :=
  ((ιMulti R p).domCoprod (ιMulti R q)).domDomCongr
    (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))

/-- The general unshuffle component, constructed by the alternating universal property. -/
def unshuffle (p q : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^(p + q) M) →ₗ[R] ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)) :=
  alternatingMapLinearEquiv (R := R) (n := p + q) (M := M)
    (N := (⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)) (unshuffleAlternating R M p q)

/-- Each shuffle coset contributes once; no factorial denominator is used. -/
theorem unshuffle_apply_ιMulti (p q : ℕ) (v : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    unshuffle R M p q (ιMulti R (p + q) v) =
      ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q),
        AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q) σ
          (v ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))) := by
  rw [unshuffle, alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
  change ((ιMulti R p).domCoprod (ιMulti R q))
    (v ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))) = _
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply, _root_.sum_apply]

/-- A representative gives the expected signed ordered two-block tensor. -/
theorem unshuffle_summand_representative (p q : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p ⊕ Fin q)) (v : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q) (Quotient.mk'' σ)
        (v ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))) =
      Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
        (ιMulti R p (fun i => v (finSumFinEquiv (σ (Sum.inl i)))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          ιMulti R q (fun j => v (finSumFinEquiv (σ (Sum.inr j))))) := by
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', _root_.smul_apply]
  simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply,
    Function.comp_apply]
  exact (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) _ _).symm

section Naturality

variable {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]

private theorem unshuffle_summand_naturality (p q : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q)) (v : Fin p ⊕ Fin q → M) :
    TensorProduct.map (map p f) (map q f)
        (AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q) σ v) =
      AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q) σ (f ∘ v) := by
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ σ =>
      rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'',
        AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', _root_.smul_apply, _root_.smul_apply]
      simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply,
        MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_apply_ιMulti]
      change (TensorProduct.map (map p f) (map q f))
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) •
          (ιMulti R p (fun i => v (σ (Sum.inl i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
            ιMulti R q (fun i => v (σ (Sum.inr i))))) = _
      rw [map_zsmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_apply_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti]
      rfl

/-- Exterior unshuffle is natural in arbitrary linear maps and independent module universes. -/
theorem unshuffle_naturality (p q : ℕ) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (TensorProduct.map (map p f) (map q f)).comp (unshuffle R M p q) =
      (unshuffle R N p q).comp (map (p + q) f) := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (R := R) (n := p + q) (M := M)
    (N := (⋀[R]^p N) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q N))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    unshuffle_apply_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro σ _
  exact unshuffle_summand_naturality R M p q f σ
    (v ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q)))

end Naturality

end exteriorPower

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.Unshuffle
public import MathlibExt.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialObject.EilenbergZilber.ShuffleCoset

/-!
# General exterior unshuffle in the existing ordered-shuffle index

The native domCoprod cosets are reindexed by the existing actual ordered
shuffles. Each shuffle contributes once, with its native permutation sign,
including either empty block. The formula requires no basis or denominator.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

open AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber

private theorem unshuffle_summand_shuffle (p q : ℕ) (s : Shuffle p q)
    (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q)
        (Quotient.mk'' (Shuffle.cosetRepresentative p q s))
        (w ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))) =
      Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
        (ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'', _root_.smul_apply,
    Shuffle.cosetRepresentative_sign]
  simp only [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, Shuffle.cosetRepresentative_front, Shuffle.cosetRepresentative_back]
  exact (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' (Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm) _ _).symm

/-- Every general exterior unshuffle is the signed sum over the actual ordered shuffles. -/
theorem unshuffle_apply_ιMulti_shuffles (p q : ℕ) (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    unshuffle R M p q (ιMulti R (p + q) w) =
      ∑ s : Shuffle p q, Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
        (ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  rw [unshuffle_apply_ιMulti]
  calc
    (∑ c : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin p) (Fin q),
        AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q) c
          (w ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q)))) =
      ∑ s : Shuffle p q,
        AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand (ιMulti R p) (ιMulti R q)
          ((Shuffle.cosetEquiv p q).symm s)
          (w ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q))) := by
        exact ((Shuffle.cosetEquiv p q).symm.sum_comp _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      rw [Shuffle.cosetEquiv_symm_apply]
      exact unshuffle_summand_shuffle R M p q s w

end exteriorPower

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorPower.UnshuffleCoordinates
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ExteriorAlgebra.CoalgebraDiagonal
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-!
# General unshuffle is the actual exterior coproduct component

The native exterior diagonal expands multilinearly over every subset of
the source indices. The existing ordered shuffle sorts a subset and its
complement into two blocks. Native alternation gives its permutation sign,
and the native exterior-product equivalence gives the two tensor factors.
Degree projection kills subsets of the wrong cardinality. The result is
the full domCoprod unshuffle in every bidegree, over any commutative ring.

No factorial is divided or canceled and no basis is chosen. Both empty
blocks are part of the same construction and proof.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u v

namespace exteriorPower

variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

open AlgebraicTopology.EilenbergZilber

local notation "E" => ExteriorAlgebra R M
local notation "ℰ" => fun n : ℕ => ⋀[R]^n M
local notation "G" => ℰ ᵍ⊗[R] ℰ
local notation "π" => projection R M

/-- One actual multilinear term of the native exterior diagonal. -/
def coproductMixedTerm (N : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin N)) (w : Fin N → M) : E ⊗[R] E :=
  (GradedTensorProduct.of R ℰ ℰ).symm (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M
    (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R N
      (s.piecewise (fun i => (w i, 0)) (fun i => (0, w i)))))

/-- Multilinearity expands the actual diagonal over all subsets, before degree projection. -/
theorem coproduct_ιMulti_mixedTerms (N : ℕ) (w : Fin N → M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.coproduct R M (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R N w) =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin N), coproductMixedTerm R M N s w := by
  let F : (M × M) [⋀^Fin N]→ₗ[R] G :=
    (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M).toLinearMap.compAlternatingMap
      (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R N)
  have hfunctions : ((fun i : Fin N => (w i, 0)) + (fun i : Fin N => (0, w i))) =
      (fun i : Fin N => (w i, w i)) := by
    funext i
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp
  have hF : F (fun i => (w i, w i)) =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin N), F (s.piecewise (fun i => (w i, 0)) (fun i => (0, w i))) := by
    simpa only [hfunctions] using
      F.map_add_univ (fun i => (w i, 0)) (fun i => (0, w i))
  have h := congrArg (GradedTensorProduct.of R ℰ ℰ).symm hF
  rw [ExteriorAlgebra.coproduct_eq_diagonalLinear]
  change (GradedTensorProduct.of R ℰ ℰ).symm (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M
      (ExteriorAlgebra.map ((LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M).prod LinearMap.id)
        (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R N w))) = _
  rw [ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti]
  simp only [F, LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, AlgEquiv.toLinearMap_apply,
    map_sum, coproductMixedTerm] at h
  exact h

private theorem mixedWord_sorted (p q : ℕ) (s : Shuffle p q) (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    (s.leftPositions.val.piecewise (fun i => (w i, 0)) (fun i => (0, w i))) ∘ s.perm =
      Fin.append (fun i : Fin p => (w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i)), 0))
        (fun j : Fin q => (0, w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  funext k
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (finSumFinEquiv : Fin p ⊕ Fin q ≃ Fin (p + q)).surjective k
  cases x with
  | inl i =>
      have hi : s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i) ∈ s.leftPositions.val := by
        change s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i) ∈ s.leftPositions
        rw [Shuffle.mem_leftPositions_iff]
        exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
      simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_left,
        Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hi]
  | inr j =>
      have hj : s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j) ∉ s.leftPositions.val := by
        apply (Shuffle.mem_rightPositions_iff_not_mem_leftPositions s _).mp
        rw [Shuffle.mem_rightPositions_iff]
        exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
      simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_right,
        Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ hj]

/-- The actual subset term is the signed tensor of the two ordered surviving blocks. -/
theorem coproductMixedTerm_shuffle (p q : ℕ) (s : Shuffle p q) (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    coproductMixedTerm R M (p + q) s.leftPositions.val w = Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
      (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
        ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  let v : Fin (p + q) → M × M :=
    s.leftPositions.val.piecewise (fun i => (w i, 0)) (fun i => (0, w i))
  have hp : ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q) v = Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
      ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q)
        (Fin.append (fun i : Fin p => (w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i)), 0))
          (fun j : Fin q => (0, w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j))))) := by
    rw [(ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q)).map_congr_perm v s.perm]
    rw [mixedWord_sorted M p q s w]
  have hf : ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M
      (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q)
        (Fin.append (fun i : Fin p => (w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i)), 0))
          (fun j : Fin q => (0, w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))))) =
      (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i)))) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R]
        ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j))) := by
    have h := ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul_ιMulti R M M p q
      (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))
    exact (congrArg (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M) h).symm.trans
      ((ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M).apply_symm_apply _)
  unfold coproductMixedTerm
  change (GradedTensorProduct.of R ℰ ℰ).symm
    (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor R M M (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q) v)) = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
  rw [hf]
  rfl

/-- Degree projections retain the actual term of the matching cardinality. -/
theorem projectedMixedTerm_shuffle (p q : ℕ) (s : Shuffle p q) (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    TensorProduct.map (π p) (π q) (coproductMixedTerm R M (p + q) s.leftPositions.val w) =
      Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
        (ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  rw [coproductMixedTerm_shuffle]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, projection_ιMulti_self]

/-- A subset of any other left-block cardinality has zero matching component. -/
theorem projectedMixedTerm_ne (N p q : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin N)) (hs : s.card ≠ p)
    (w : Fin N → M) : TensorProduct.map (π p) (π q) (coproductMixedTerm R M N s w) = 0 := by
  have hcard : s.card + sᶜ.card = N := by
    have hsN : s.card ≤ N := by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Finset.card_le_univ s
    rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hsN
  generalize hk : s.card = k at *
  generalize hl : sᶜ.card = l at *
  subst N
  let a : Set.powersetCard (Fin (k + l)) k := ⟨s, hk⟩
  have ha : (Shuffle.ofLeftPositions a).leftPositions.val = s :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (Shuffle.leftPositions_ofLeftPositions a)
  rw [← ha, coproductMixedTerm_shuffle]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    projection_ιMulti_ne R M p k hs, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, smul_zero]

/-- The actual projected diagonal is the full ordered-shuffle sum, with no factorial multiplier. -/
theorem projectedCoproduct_ιMulti_shuffles (p q : ℕ) (w : Fin (p + q) → M) :
    TensorProduct.map (π p) (π q)
        (ExteriorAlgebra.coproduct R M (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (p + q) w)) =
      ∑ s : Shuffle p q, Equiv.Perm.sign s.perm •
        (ιMulti R p (fun i => w (s.perm (Fin.castAdd q i))) ⊗ₜ[R]
          ιMulti R q (fun j => w (s.perm (Fin.natAdd p j)))) := by
  classical
  rw [coproduct_ιMulti_mixedTerms, map_sum]
  let F : Finset (Fin (p + q)) → ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)) := fun a =>
    TensorProduct.map (π p) (π q) (coproductMixedTerm R M (p + q) a w)
  have hz : (∑ a : {a : Finset (Fin (p + q)) // a.card ≠ p}, F a.val) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a _
    exact projectedMixedTerm_ne R M (p + q) p q a.val a.property w
  have hsplit := (Equiv.sumCompl (fun a : Finset (Fin (p + q)) => a.card = p)).sum_comp F
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type] at hsplit
  simp only [Equiv.sumCompl] at hsplit
  replace hsplit : (∑ a : Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p, F a.val) +
      (∑ a : {a : Finset (Fin (p + q)) // a.card ≠ p}, F a.val) =
      ∑ a : Finset (Fin (p + q)), F a := by
    have hi : (inferInstance : Fintype (Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p)) =
        (Subtype.fintype (fun a : Finset (Fin (p + q)) => a.card = p)) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    change Set.powersetCard.instFintypeElemFinset (Fin (p + q)) p =
      Subtype.fintype (fun a : Finset (Fin (p + q)) => a.card = p) at hi
    rw [hi]
    exact hsplit
  rw [hz, add_zero] at hsplit
  change (∑ a : Finset (Fin (p + q)), F a) = _
  rw [← hsplit]
  calc
    (∑ a : Set.powersetCard (Fin (p + q)) p, F a.val) =
      ∑ s : Shuffle p q, F s.leftPositions.val :=
        (Shuffle.equivLeftPositions.sum_comp (fun a => F a.val)).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      exact projectedMixedTerm_shuffle R M p q s w

/-- The general native domCoprod unshuffle is exactly the actual exterior coproduct component. -/
theorem projectedCoproduct_eq_unshuffle (p q : ℕ) :
    (TensorProduct.map (π p) (π q)).comp
        ((ExteriorAlgebra.coproduct R M).comp (⋀[R]^(p + q) M).subtype) = unshuffle R M p q := by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (R := R) (n := p + q) (M := M)
    (N := ((⋀[R]^p M) ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^q M)))
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro w
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply, ιMulti_apply_coe]
  rw [projectedCoproduct_ιMulti_shuffles, unshuffle_apply_ιMulti_shuffles]

end exteriorPower

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Prod

/-!
# Coefficient naturality of the two-block general linear group map

The canonical blockDiagonalHom commutes with the original entrywise ring
map on both blocks. The two finite index universes and the two coefficient
universes are independent. Only semiring structures and a unital ring
homomorphism are used.
-/

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe uN uM uR uS

variable {n : Type uN} {m : Type uM}
variable [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m]
variable {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]

/-- Mapping both diagonal blocks gives the entrywise image of their block matrix. -/
public theorem blockDiagonalHom_mapRingHom_apply (f : R →+* S)
    (g : GL n R) (h : GL m R) :
    blockDiagonalHom n m S (mapRingHom f g, mapRingHom f h) =
      mapRingHom (n := n ⊕ m) f (blockDiagonalHom n m R (g, h)) := by
  symm
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, coe_blockDiagonalHom, Matrix.fromBlocks_map]
  have h0nm : (0 : Matrix n m R).map f = 0 := by
    ext i j
    exact f.map_zero
  have h0mn : (0 : Matrix m n R).map f = 0 := by
    ext i j
    exact f.map_zero
  rw [h0nm, h0mn]

/-- The original two-block homomorphism is natural under a coefficient ring map. -/
public theorem blockDiagonalHom_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) :
    (blockDiagonalHom n m S).comp
        ((mapRingHom (n := n) f).prodMap (mapRingHom (n := m) f)) =
      (mapRingHom (n := n ⊕ m) f).comp (blockDiagonalHom n m R) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  rintro ⟨g, h⟩
  exact blockDiagonalHom_mapRingHom_apply f g h

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockUnipotent

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Determinant
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization

/-!
# Block-diagonal matrices

Block-diagonal matrices in `GL (α ⊕ β)` via the embedding `GL α × GL β → GL (α ⊕ β)`,
with determinant multiplicativity and elementary-subgroup embeddings.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup
namespace BlockElementary

open Matrix

variable {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Full block-diagonal embedding `GL α × GL β → GL (α ⊕ β)`. -/
def blockDiagonal (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) : GL (α ⊕ β) R :=
  _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalHom α β R (g, h)

/-- The existing Ring API is the canonical bundled block homomorphism. -/
theorem blockDiagonal_eq_blockDiagonalHom (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) :
    blockDiagonal g h =
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalHom α β R (g, h) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma coe_blockDiagonal (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) :
    (↑(blockDiagonal g h) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (0 : Matrix β α R)
        (↑h : Matrix β β R) := by
  rw [blockDiagonal_eq_blockDiagonalHom]
  exact _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_blockDiagonalHom g h

/-- The inverse retains the original two inverse blocks and zero cross terms. -/
theorem coe_blockDiagonal_inv (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) :
    (↑((blockDiagonal g h)⁻¹) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (0 : Matrix β α R)
        (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix β β R) := by
  rw [blockDiagonal_eq_blockDiagonalHom, ← map_inv]
  exact _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_blockDiagonalHom (g⁻¹) (h⁻¹)

variable {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
variable {γ δ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ]

@[simp]
theorem det_blockDiagonal (g : GL γ S) (h : GL δ S) :
    _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (blockDiagonal g h) =
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g *
        _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det h := by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, coe_blockDiagonal,
    Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  rfl

theorem blockDiagonalOne_mem_elementarySubgroup
    {g : GL α R}
    (hg : g ∈ _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup α R) :
    _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne α β R g ∈
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R := by
  have hle :
      Subgroup.closure
          (_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySet α R) ≤
        (_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R).comap
          (_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne α β R) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    change _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne α β R
        (_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a) ∈
        _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R
    rw [_root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
    exact _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup
      _ _ _ _
  exact (Subgroup.mem_comap).mp (hle hg)

end BlockElementary
end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix
