module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization

/-!
# Finite block stabilization for `GL`

`blockStabilization n m R : GL (Fin n) R →* GL (Fin (n + m)) R` via
`diag(-, 1_m)` and reindexing along `finSumFinEquiv`, with `0` and
successor formulas and coefficient-map naturality for arbitrary semiring
homomorphisms.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄ uR vR

private theorem reindexMulEquiv_trans_apply
    {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} {γ : Type u₃}
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R]
    (e₁ : α ≃ β) (e₂ : β ≃ γ) (g : GL α R) :
    reindexMulEquiv e₂ (reindexMulEquiv e₁ g) =
      reindexMulEquiv (e₁.trans e₂) g := by
  apply Units.ext
  change
    Matrix.reindex e₂ e₂
        (Matrix.reindex e₁ e₁ (↑g : Matrix α α R)) =
      Matrix.reindex (e₁.trans e₂) (e₁.trans e₂)
        (↑g : Matrix α α R)
  have h := congrArg
    (fun q : Matrix α α R ≃ Matrix γ γ R =>
      q (↑g : Matrix α α R))
    (Matrix.reindex_trans e₁ e₁ e₂ e₂)
  simpa only [Equiv.trans_apply] using h

@[simp]
private theorem reindexMulEquiv_refl_apply
    {α : Type u₁} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α]
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] (g : GL α R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.refl α) g = g := by
  apply Units.ext
  change
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.refl α) (Equiv.refl α)
        (↑g : Matrix α α R) =
      (↑g : Matrix α α R)
  exact Matrix.reindex_refl_refl _

private theorem reindexMulEquiv_blockDiagonalOne_assoc
    {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} {γ : Type u₃}
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] (g : GL α R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ)
        (blockDiagonalOne (α ⊕ β) γ R
          (blockDiagonalOne α β R g)) =
      blockDiagonalOne α (β ⊕ γ) R g := by
  apply Units.ext
  change
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ)
        (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ)
        (Matrix.fromBlocks
          (Matrix.fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α R) 0 0 1)
          0 0 1) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α R) 0 0 1
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | (i | i) <;>
    rcases j with j | (j | j) <;>
    simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.one_apply]

private theorem finSumFinEquiv_assoc (n m : ℕ) :
    (Equiv.sumCongr
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))
        (Equiv.refl (Fin 1))).trans
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n + m) (n := 1)) =
      ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin n) (Fin m) (Fin 1)).trans
        (Equiv.sumCongr
          (Equiv.refl (Fin n))
          (finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)))).trans
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m + 1)) := by
  ext x
  rcases x with (i | j) | k <;>
    simp [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply]

/-- Add an identity block of size `m` and reindex to `Fin (n + m)`. -/
def blockStabilization (n m : ℕ) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] :
    GL (Fin n) R →* GL (Fin (n + m)) R :=
  (reindexMulEquiv
    (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
    (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R)

@[simp]
theorem blockStabilization_zero
    (n : ℕ) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R]
    (g : GL (Fin n) R) :
    blockStabilization n 0 R g = g := by
  apply Units.ext
  change
    Matrix.reindex
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0))
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0))
        (Matrix.fromBlocks
          (↑g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1) =
      (↑g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
  ext i j
  have hi :
      (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0)).symm i =
        Sum.inl i := by
    simpa using
      (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd
        (m := n) (n := 0) i)
  have hj :
      (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0)).symm j =
        Sum.inl j := by
    simpa using
      (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd
        (m := n) (n := 0) j)
  change
    Matrix.fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1
        ((finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0)).symm i)
        ((finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 0)).symm j) =
      (↑g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) i j
  simp only [hi, hj, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]

theorem blockStabilization_succ
    (n m : ℕ) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R]
    (g : GL (Fin n) R) :
    blockStabilization n (m + 1) R g =
      stabilization R (blockStabilization n m R g) := by
  let e_nm : Fin n ⊕ Fin m ≃ Fin (n + m) := finSumFinEquiv
  let e_m1 : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin (m + 1) := finSumFinEquiv
  let e_n_m1 : Fin n ⊕ Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + (m + 1)) := finSumFinEquiv
  let e_nm_1 : Fin (n + m) ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin ((n + m) + 1) := finSumFinEquiv
  let a : (Fin n ⊕ Fin m) ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin n ⊕ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) :=
    Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin n) (Fin m) (Fin 1)
  let b : Fin n ⊕ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin (m + 1) :=
    Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) e_m1
  let d : (Fin n ⊕ Fin m) ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin (n + m) ⊕ Fin 1 :=
    Equiv.sumCongr e_nm (Equiv.refl (Fin 1))
  let B : GL ((Fin n ⊕ Fin m) ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    blockDiagonalOne (Fin n ⊕ Fin m) (Fin 1) R
      (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R g)
  have hcoh : d.trans e_nm_1 = (a.trans b).trans e_n_m1 := by
    dsimp [d, e_nm_1, a, b, e_n_m1, e_nm, e_m1]
    exact finSumFinEquiv_assoc n m
  calc
    blockStabilization n (m + 1) R g =
        reindexMulEquiv e_n_m1
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1)) R g) := rfl
    _ = reindexMulEquiv e_n_m1
          (reindexMulEquiv b
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) R g)) := by
      apply congrArg (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e_n_m1)
      symm
      simpa only [reindexMulEquiv_refl_apply] using
        (blockDiagonalOne_reindex
          R (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) e_m1 g)
    _ = reindexMulEquiv e_n_m1
          (reindexMulEquiv b (reindexMulEquiv a B)) := by
      apply congrArg (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e_n_m1)
      apply congrArg (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) b)
      simpa only [a, B] using
        (reindexMulEquiv_blockDiagonalOne_assoc
          (R := R) (α := Fin n) (β := Fin m) (γ := Fin 1) g).symm
    _ = reindexMulEquiv e_n_m1
          (reindexMulEquiv (a.trans b) B) := by
      apply congrArg (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e_n_m1)
      exact reindexMulEquiv_trans_apply (R := R) a b B
    _ = reindexMulEquiv ((a.trans b).trans e_n_m1) B :=
      reindexMulEquiv_trans_apply (R := R) (a.trans b) e_n_m1 B
    _ = reindexMulEquiv (d.trans e_nm_1) B := by
      rw [hcoh]
    _ = reindexMulEquiv e_nm_1 (reindexMulEquiv d B) :=
      (reindexMulEquiv_trans_apply (R := R) d e_nm_1 B).symm
    _ = reindexMulEquiv e_nm_1
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin (n + m)) (Fin 1) R
            (reindexMulEquiv e_nm
              (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R g))) := by
      apply congrArg (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e_nm_1)
      simpa only [d, B] using
        (blockDiagonalOne_reindex
          R e_nm (Equiv.refl (Fin 1))
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R g))
    _ = stabilization R (blockStabilization n m R g) := rfl

theorem blockStabilization_mapRingHom {n m : ℕ} {R : Type uR} {S : Type vR}
    [Semiring R] [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    (blockStabilization n m S).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + m)) f).comp (blockStabilization n m R) := by
  calc
    (blockStabilization n m S).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f)
        = ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) S)).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f) := rfl
    _ = (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
          ((blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) S).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
          ((mapRingHom (n := Fin n ⊕ Fin m) f).comp (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R)) := by
          rw [blockDiagonalOne_mapRingHom]
    _ = ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
          (mapRingHom (n := Fin n ⊕ Fin m) f)).comp (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R) := by
          rw [← MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = ((mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + m)) f).comp
          (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom).comp
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R) := by
          rw [reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom]
    _ = (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + m)) f).comp
          ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := m))).toMonoidHom.comp
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin m) R)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + m)) f).comp (blockStabilization n m R) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem blockStabilization_mapRingHom_apply {n m : ℕ} {R : Type uR} {S : Type vR}
    [Semiring R] [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) (g : GL (Fin n) R) :
    blockStabilization n m S (mapRingHom f g) =
      mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + m)) f (blockStabilization n m R g) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (blockStabilization_mapRingHom (n := n) (m := m) (f := f)) g

/-- Iterated stabilization preserves equality: `blockStabilization n m R`
  is injective; it is the finite-block analogue of successor
  `stabilization` injectivity. -/
theorem blockStabilization_injective (n m : ℕ) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] :
    Function.Injective (blockStabilization n m R) := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro g₁ g₂ h
    simpa [blockStabilization_zero] using h
  | succ m ih =>
    intro g₁ g₂ h
    rw [blockStabilization_succ, blockStabilization_succ] at h
    exact ih (stabilization_injective h)

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatMonomialUniqueness
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Prod

/-!
# Bruhat fibers for covers of the monomial special linear group

Given a group homomorphism `p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)`, the Bruhat fiber
is the pullback of `bruhatMiddle` and `p`.  This file provides its upper
elementary actions, actions by a group mapping into `ker p`, distinguished
point and chosen lifts, and functorial maps of compatible projection data.

The construction is independent of any particular central extension.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

open Matrix

universe u v w x y z u₁ u₂ u₃

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-- The pullback of `bruhatMiddle` along a group homomorphism to the monomial
special linear group. -/
abbrev BruhatFiber (F : Type u) [Field F] (n : ℕ) {W : Type v} [Group W]
    (p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)) : Type (max u v) :=
  Function.Pullback (bruhatMiddle (F := F) (ι := Fin n)) p

namespace BruhatFiber

variable {F : Type u} [Field F] {n : ℕ}
variable {W : Type v} [Group W] {p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)}

/-- First projection of a Bruhat fiber. -/
abbrev fst (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F :=
  x.val.1

/-- Second projection of a Bruhat fiber. -/
abbrev snd (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : W :=
  x.val.2

/-- The defining pullback square. -/
theorem prop_eq (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    bruhatMiddle (fst x) = p (snd x) :=
  x.2

@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : BruhatFiber F n p} (h1 : x.val.1 = y.val.1)
    (h2 : x.val.2 = y.val.2) : x = y := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

@[simp]
theorem mk_fst (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) (a : W)
    (h : bruhatMiddle s = p a) :
    fst (⟨(s, a), h⟩ : BruhatFiber F n p) = s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem mk_snd (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) (a : W)
    (h : bruhatMiddle s = p a) :
    snd (⟨(s, a), h⟩ : BruhatFiber F n p) = a :=
  rfl

theorem coe_fst (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : (x.val : _).1 = fst x :=
  rfl

theorem coe_snd (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : (x.val : _).2 = snd x :=
  rfl

section BruhatMiddleInvariance

/-- Left multiplication by an upper-elementary element does not change the
Bruhat middle factor. -/
theorem bruhatMiddle_upper_left_mul
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    bruhatMiddle (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g) = bruhatMiddle g := by
  let d := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g
  have hSL : g =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right :=
    d.factorizationSL
  have hStep :
      UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g =
        UpperElementary.toSLHom a *
          (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) :=
    congrArg (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * ·) hSL
  have hMul : UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (a * d.left) *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right := by
    calc
      UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g =
          UpperElementary.toSLHom a *
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
              monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
              UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) := hStep
      _ = (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left) *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom (a * d.left) *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right := by rw [← map_mul]
  have hMid : bruhatMiddle (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g) = d.middle :=
    bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim _ (a * d.left) d.middle d.right hMul
  have hOrig : bruhatMiddle g = d.middle := rfl
  rw [hMid, hOrig]

/-- Right multiplication by an upper-elementary element does not change the
Bruhat middle factor. -/
theorem bruhatMiddle_upper_right_mul
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    bruhatMiddle (g * UpperElementary.toSLHom a) = bruhatMiddle g := by
  let d := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g
  have hSL : g =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right :=
    d.factorizationSL
  have hStep :
      g * UpperElementary.toSLHom a =
        (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) *
          UpperElementary.toSLHom a :=
    congrArg (· * UpperElementary.toSLHom a) hSL
  have hMul : g * UpperElementary.toSLHom a =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom (d.right * a) := by
    calc
      g * UpperElementary.toSLHom a =
          (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) * UpperElementary.toSLHom a := hStep
      _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right * UpperElementary.toSLHom a) := by
              simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin n) d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom (d.right * a) := by rw [← map_mul]
  have hMid : bruhatMiddle (g * UpperElementary.toSLHom a) = d.middle :=
    bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim _ d.left d.middle (d.right * a) hMul
  have hOrig : bruhatMiddle g = d.middle := rfl
  rw [hMid, hOrig]

/-- Two-sided upper-elementary invariance. -/
theorem bruhatMiddle_upper_mul
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F)
    (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    bruhatMiddle (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * g *
      UpperElementary.toSLHom b) = bruhatMiddle g := by
  rw [bruhatMiddle_upper_right_mul, bruhatMiddle_upper_left_mul]

theorem bruhatMiddle_one (F : Type u) [Field F] (n : ℕ) :
    bruhatMiddle (1 : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) = 1 := by
  have hSL : (1 : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin n) (1 : MonomialSL F (Fin n)) *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) := by
    simp
  exact bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim _ 1 1 1 hSL

end BruhatMiddleInvariance

section UpperActions

/-- Left upper-elementary action on a Bruhat fiber. -/
abbrev leftUpper (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : BruhatFiber F n p :=
  ⟨(UpperElementary.toSLHom a * x.val.1, x.val.2), by
    rw [bruhatMiddle_upper_left_mul]
    exact x.2⟩

/-- Right upper-elementary action on a Bruhat fiber. -/
abbrev rightUpper (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : BruhatFiber F n p :=
  ⟨(x.val.1 * UpperElementary.toSLHom a, x.val.2), by
    rw [bruhatMiddle_upper_right_mul]
    exact x.2⟩

theorem leftUpper_fst (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    fst (leftUpper a x) = UpperElementary.toSLHom a * fst x := rfl

theorem leftUpper_snd (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : snd (leftUpper a x) = snd x := rfl

theorem rightUpper_fst (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    fst (rightUpper a x) = fst x * UpperElementary.toSLHom a := rfl

theorem rightUpper_snd (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : snd (rightUpper a x) = snd x := rfl

theorem leftUpper_one (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    leftUpper (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) x = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

theorem rightUpper_one (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    rightUpper (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) x = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

theorem leftUpper_mul (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    leftUpper (a * b) x = leftUpper a (leftUpper b x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [mul_assoc, map_mul]

theorem rightUpper_mul (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    rightUpper (a * b) x = rightUpper b (rightUpper a x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [mul_assoc, map_mul]

theorem leftUpper_inv (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : leftUpper a⁻¹ (leftUpper a x) = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [map_inv]

theorem rightUpper_inv (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : rightUpper a⁻¹ (rightUpper a x) = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [map_inv, mul_assoc]

/-- Left upper action as a permutation. -/
abbrev leftUpperPerm (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun := leftUpper a
  invFun := leftUpper a⁻¹
  left_inv := leftUpper_inv a
  right_inv x := by simpa using leftUpper_inv (p := p) a⁻¹ x

/-- Right upper action as a permutation. -/
abbrev rightUpperPerm (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun := rightUpper a
  invFun := rightUpper a⁻¹
  left_inv := rightUpper_inv a
  right_inv x := by
    apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [map_inv, mul_assoc]

theorem leftUpperPerm_apply (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : leftUpperPerm a x = leftUpper a x := rfl

theorem rightUpperPerm_apply (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : rightUpperPerm a x = rightUpper a x := rfl

theorem leftUpperPerm_one :
    leftUpperPerm (p := p) (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) = 1 := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [leftUpperPerm, leftUpper_one]

theorem rightUpperPerm_one :
    rightUpperPerm (p := p) (1 : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) = 1 := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [rightUpperPerm, rightUpper_one]

theorem leftUpperPerm_mul (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    leftUpperPerm (p := p) (a * b) = leftUpperPerm a * leftUpperPerm b := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [leftUpperPerm, leftUpper_mul, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

theorem rightUpperPerm_mul (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    rightUpperPerm (p := p) (a * b) = rightUpperPerm b * rightUpperPerm a := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [rightUpperPerm, rightUpper_mul, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

theorem leftUpperPerm_inv (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    leftUpperPerm (p := p) a⁻¹ = (leftUpperPerm a)⁻¹ := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [leftUpperPerm, Equiv.Perm.inv_def]

theorem rightUpperPerm_inv (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    rightUpperPerm (p := p) a⁻¹ = (rightUpperPerm a)⁻¹ := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [rightUpperPerm, Equiv.Perm.inv_def]

/-- Homomorphism for the left upper action. -/
abbrev leftUpperHom : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F →*
    Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun := leftUpperPerm
  map_one' := leftUpperPerm_one
  map_mul' := leftUpperPerm_mul

/-- Homomorphism from the opposite upper group for the right action. -/
abbrev rightUpperHomOp : MulOpposite (upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) →*
    Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun a := rightUpperPerm a.unop
  map_one' := rightUpperPerm_one
  map_mul' a b := by
    change rightUpperPerm (b.unop * a.unop) =
      rightUpperPerm a.unop * rightUpperPerm b.unop
    rw [rightUpperPerm_mul]

theorem leftUpperHom_apply (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : leftUpperHom (p := p) a x = leftUpper a x := rfl

theorem rightUpperHomOp_apply
    (a : MulOpposite (upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F))
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : rightUpperHomOp (p := p) a x = rightUpper a.unop x := rfl

theorem rightUpperHomOp_unop_apply (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    rightUpperHomOp (p := p) (MulOpposite.op a) x = rightUpper a x := rfl

theorem left_right_commute (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    leftUpper a (rightUpper b x) = rightUpper b (leftUpper a x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [mul_assoc]

theorem leftUpperPerm_rightUpperPerm_comm
    (a b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    leftUpperPerm (p := p) a * rightUpperPerm b =
      rightUpperPerm b * leftUpperPerm a := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [leftUpperPerm, rightUpperPerm, left_right_commute, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

end UpperActions

section KernelAction

variable {C : Type w} [Group C] (ι : C →* W)
variable (hι : ∀ c, p (ι c) = 1)

/-- Action on the second coordinate by a homomorphism whose image is killed
by the fiber projection. -/
abbrev central (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : BruhatFiber F n p :=
  ⟨(x.val.1, ι c * x.val.2), by
    calc
      bruhatMiddle x.val.1 = p x.val.2 := x.2
      _ = 1 * p x.val.2 := (one_mul _).symm
      _ = p (ι c) * p x.val.2 := by rw [hι c]
      _ = p (ι c * x.val.2) := (map_mul p _ _).symm⟩

theorem central_fst (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    fst (central ι hι c x) = fst x := rfl

theorem central_snd (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    snd (central ι hι c x) = ι c * snd x := rfl

theorem central_one (x : BruhatFiber F n p) : central ι hι 1 x = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

theorem central_mul (c d : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    central ι hι (c * d) x = central ι hι c (central ι hι d x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp [mul_assoc]

theorem central_inv (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    central ι hι c⁻¹ (central ι hι c x) = x := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

/-- Kernel-coordinate action as a permutation. -/
abbrev centralPerm (c : C) : Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun := central ι hι c
  invFun := central ι hι c⁻¹
  left_inv := central_inv ι hι c
  right_inv x := by simpa using central_inv ι hι c⁻¹ x

theorem centralPerm_apply (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    centralPerm ι hι c x = central ι hι c x := rfl

theorem centralPerm_one : centralPerm ι hι (1 : C) = 1 := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [centralPerm, central_one]

theorem centralPerm_mul (c d : C) :
    centralPerm ι hι (c * d) = centralPerm ι hι c * centralPerm ι hι d := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [centralPerm, central_mul, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

theorem centralPerm_inv (c : C) :
    centralPerm ι hι c⁻¹ = (centralPerm ι hι c)⁻¹ := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [centralPerm, Equiv.Perm.inv_def]

/-- Homomorphism for the kernel-coordinate action. -/
abbrev centralHom : C →* Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) where
  toFun := centralPerm ι hι
  map_one' := centralPerm_one ι hι
  map_mul' := centralPerm_mul ι hι

theorem centralHom_apply (c : C) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    centralHom ι hι c x = central ι hι c x := rfl

/-- The distinguished point with both coordinates equal to one. -/
abbrev basepoint (F : Type u) [Field F] (n : ℕ) {W : Type v} [Group W]
    (p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)) : BruhatFiber F n p :=
  ⟨(1, 1), by rw [bruhatMiddle_one, map_one]⟩

theorem basepoint_fst : fst (basepoint F n p) = 1 := rfl

theorem basepoint_snd : snd (basepoint F n p) = 1 := rfl

/-- The kernel-coordinate action is faithful when the coordinate homomorphism
is injective. -/
theorem centralHom_injective (hιinj : Function.Injective ι) :
    Function.Injective (centralHom ι hι) := by
  intro c d h
  have hAct := congrArg (fun e : Equiv.Perm (BruhatFiber F n p) =>
    e (basepoint F n p)) h
  have hSnd := congrArg (fun q => snd q) hAct
  apply hιinj
  simpa [centralHom_apply, central_snd, basepoint_snd] using hSnd

theorem central_left_commute (c : C)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    central ι hι c (leftUpper a x) = leftUpper a (central ι hι c x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

theorem central_right_commute (c : C)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    central ι hι c (rightUpper a x) = rightUpper a (central ι hι c x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> simp

theorem centralPerm_leftUpperPerm_comm (c : C)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    centralPerm ι hι c * leftUpperPerm (p := p) a =
      leftUpperPerm a * centralPerm ι hι c := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro q
  simp [centralPerm, leftUpperPerm, central_left_commute, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

theorem centralPerm_rightUpperPerm_comm (c : C)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F) :
    centralPerm ι hι c * rightUpperPerm (p := p) a =
      rightUpperPerm a * centralPerm ι hι c := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro q
  simp [centralPerm, rightUpperPerm, central_right_commute, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

end KernelAction

section Maps

/-- Compatible homomorphisms between two sets of Bruhat projection data. -/
structure MapData (F : Type u) [Field F] (K : Type v) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    {W : Type w} [Group W] {W' : Type x} [Group W']
    (p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n))
    (q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)) where
  mapSL : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F →* SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) K
  mapMiddle : MonomialSL F (Fin n) →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)
  mapFiber : W →* W'
  commSL : ∀ s, bruhatMiddle (mapSL s) = mapMiddle (bruhatMiddle s)
  commFiber : ∀ a, q (mapFiber a) = mapMiddle (p a)

namespace MapData

/-- Identity compatible projection data. -/
def id (F : Type u) [Field F] (n : ℕ) {W : Type w} [Group W]
    (p : W →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)) : MapData F F n p p where
  mapSL := MonoidHom.id _
  mapMiddle := MonoidHom.id _
  mapFiber := MonoidHom.id _
  commSL _ := rfl
  commFiber _ := rfl

/-- Composition of compatible projection data. -/
def comp {K : Type v} [Field K] {L : Type x} [Field L] {n : ℕ}
    {W₁ : Type w} [Group W₁] {W₂ : Type y} [Group W₂]
    {W₃ : Type z} [Group W₃]
    {p₁ : W₁ →* MonomialSL F (Fin n)}
    {p₂ : W₂ →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)}
    {p₃ : W₃ →* MonomialSL L (Fin n)}
    (ψ : MapData K L n p₂ p₃) (φ : MapData F K n p₁ p₂) :
    MapData F L n p₁ p₃ where
  mapSL := ψ.mapSL.comp φ.mapSL
  mapMiddle := ψ.mapMiddle.comp φ.mapMiddle
  mapFiber := ψ.mapFiber.comp φ.mapFiber
  commSL s := by
    rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, ψ.commSL, MonoidHom.comp_apply, φ.commSL]
  commFiber a := by
    rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply, ψ.commFiber, MonoidHom.comp_apply, φ.commFiber]

end MapData

/-- Map between Bruhat fibers induced by compatible projection data. -/
def map {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)}
    (φ : MapData F K n p q) (a : BruhatFiber F n p) : BruhatFiber K n q :=
  Function.mapPullback
    (f₁ := bruhatMiddle (F := F) (ι := Fin n)) (g₁ := p)
    (f₂ := bruhatMiddle (F := K) (ι := Fin n)) (g₂ := q)
    φ.mapSL φ.mapMiddle φ.mapFiber
    (funext φ.commSL) (funext φ.commFiber) a

theorem map_fst {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    (a : BruhatFiber F n p) : fst (map φ a) = φ.mapSL (fst a) := rfl

theorem map_snd {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    (a : BruhatFiber F n p) : snd (map φ a) = φ.mapFiber (snd a) := rfl

theorem map_wellDefined {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    (a : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    bruhatMiddle (φ.mapSL a.val.1) = q (φ.mapFiber a.val.2) :=
  (map φ a).2

@[simp] theorem map_id (a : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    map (MapData.id F n p) a = a := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> rfl

theorem map_comp {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {L : Type u₂} [Field L]
    {W₂ : Type u₃} [Group W₂] {W₃ : Type z} [Group W₃]
    {p₂ : W₂ →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)}
    {p₃ : W₃ →* MonomialSL L (Fin n)}
    (φ : MapData F K n p p₂) (ψ : MapData K L n p₂ p₃)
    (a : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    map (MapData.comp ψ φ) a = map ψ (map φ a) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext <;> rfl

/-- Naturality of the left upper action under compatible projection data. -/
theorem map_leftUpper {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) K)
    (h : φ.mapSL (UpperElementary.toSLHom a) = UpperElementary.toSLHom b)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    map φ (leftUpper a x) = leftUpper b (map φ x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext
  · change φ.mapSL (UpperElementary.toSLHom a * x.val.1) =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom b * φ.mapSL x.val.1
    rw [map_mul, h]
  · rfl

/-- Naturality of the right upper action under compatible projection data. -/
theorem map_rightUpper {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    (a : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) F)
    (b : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) K)
    (h : φ.mapSL (UpperElementary.toSLHom a) = UpperElementary.toSLHom b)
    (x : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    map φ (rightUpper a x) = rightUpper b (map φ x) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext
  · change φ.mapSL (x.val.1 * UpperElementary.toSLHom a) =
      φ.mapSL x.val.1 * UpperElementary.toSLHom b
    rw [map_mul, h]
  · rfl

/-- Naturality of a kernel-coordinate action under compatible projection
data. -/
theorem map_central {K : Type u₁} [Field K] {W' : Type u₂} [Group W']
    {q : W' →* MonomialSL K (Fin n)} (φ : MapData F K n p q)
    {C : Type x} [Group C] {C' : Type y} [Group C']
    (ι : C →* W) (hι : ∀ c, p (ι c) = 1)
    (ι' : C' →* W') (hι' : ∀ c, q (ι' c) = 1)
    (mapC : C →* C') (hC : ∀ c, φ.mapFiber (ι c) = ι' (mapC c))
    (c : C) (a : BruhatFiber F n p) :
    map φ (central ι hι c a) = central ι' hι' (mapC c) (map φ a) := by
  apply BruhatFiber.ext
  · rfl
  · change φ.mapFiber (ι c * a.val.2) = ι' (mapC c) * φ.mapFiber a.val.2
    rw [map_mul, hC]

end Maps

section ChosenLift

/-- A chosen lift through a surjective fiber projection. -/
noncomputable def chooseLift (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (m : MonomialSL F (Fin n)) : W :=
  Classical.choose (hp m)

theorem chooseLift_spec (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (m : MonomialSL F (Fin n)) : p (chooseLift hp m) = m :=
  Classical.choose_spec (hp m)

/-- A chosen point of the Bruhat fiber above a special linear matrix. -/
noncomputable def mk (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) : BruhatFiber F n p :=
  ⟨(s, chooseLift hp (bruhatMiddle s)), by rw [chooseLift_spec]⟩

theorem mk_point_fst (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) : fst (mk hp s) = s := rfl

theorem mk_point_snd_proj (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) :
    p (snd (mk hp s)) = bruhatMiddle s :=
  chooseLift_spec hp (bruhatMiddle s)

theorem mk_point_prop (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (s : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) :
    bruhatMiddle (fst (mk hp s)) = p (snd (mk hp s)) :=
  (mk hp s).2

end ChosenLift

end BruhatFiber

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSpecialLinear
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.SpecialLinearStabilization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.MonomialSLStabilization
import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatMonomialUniqueness
import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementaryStabilizationCompatibility
import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.MonomialMatrixStabilizationCompatibility

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] {n : ℕ}

@[simp] theorem bruhatMiddle_stabilization
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) F) :
    bruhatMiddle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F g) =
      monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (bruhatMiddle g) := by
  have hFact := bruhat_factorizationSL (F := F) (ι := Fin n) g
  have hStab : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F g =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatLeft g)) *
        monomialSLHom F (Fin (n + 1)) (monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (bruhatMiddle g)) *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatRight g)) := by
    calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F g
        = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatLeft g) *
              monomialSLHom F (Fin n) (bruhatMiddle g) *
              UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatRight g)) := by
          rw [← hFact]
      _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatLeft g) *
              monomialSLHom F (Fin n) (bruhatMiddle g)) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatRight g)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.map_mul]
      _ = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F (UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatLeft g)) *
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F (monomialSLHom F (Fin n) (bruhatMiddle g))) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F (UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatRight g)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.map_mul]
      _ = (UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatLeft g)) *
            monomialSLHom F (Fin (n + 1)) (monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (bruhatMiddle g))) *
          UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatRight g)) := by
          rw [← UpperElementary.toSLHom_stabilization (R := F) (n := n) (u := bruhatLeft g),
            ← monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (n := n) (m := bruhatMiddle g),
            ← UpperElementary.toSLHom_stabilization (R := F) (n := n) (u := bruhatRight g)]
      _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatLeft g)) *
          monomialSLHom F (Fin (n + 1)) (monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (bruhatMiddle g)) *
          UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatRight g)) := by
          rw [mul_assoc]
  exact bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization F g)
    (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatLeft g))
    (monomialSLSuccHom (R := F) (bruhatMiddle g))
    (UpperElementary.stabilization F n (bruhatRight g))
    hStab

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSpecialLinear
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.HeterogeneousBruhat
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.GeneralLinearEquiv
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Monomial
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.SemidirectProduct

@[expose] public section

open Matrix
open Equiv
open PermutationBilinearCocycle

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section UpperTriangularRing

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

omit [Fintype ι] in
/-- Elementary transvection `E_{i,j}(a)` with `i < j` is upper triangular. -/
theorem elementary_isUpperTriangular {i j : ι} (hij : i < j) (a : R) :
    IsUpperTriangular (1 + Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) := by
  intro r s hrs
  have h1 : (1 : Matrix ι ι R) r s = 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
    split
    next h =>
      exact absurd h (Ne.symm (ne_of_lt hrs))
    rfl
  have h2 : (Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) r s = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.single_apply]
    split
    next h =>
      rcases h with ⟨hr, hs⟩
      have : r < s := hr ▸ hs ▸ hij
      exact absurd this (not_lt_of_gt hrs)
    rfl
  simp [Matrix.add_apply, h1, h2]

omit [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem elementary_diag {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) (k : ι) :
    (1 + Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) k k = 1 := by
  have hSingle : (Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) k k = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.single_apply]
    split
    next h =>
      rcases h with ⟨hi, hj⟩
      exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
    rfl
  simp [Matrix.add_apply, hSingle]

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
/-- Product of upper-triangular matrices has diagonal product. -/
theorem isUpperTriangular_mul_diag {M N : Matrix ι ι R}
    (hM : IsUpperTriangular M) (hN : IsUpperTriangular N) (i : ι) :
    (M * N) i i = M i i * N i i := by
  classical
  have hMul : (M * N) i i = ∑ k : ι, M i k * N k i := by
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [hMul]
  have hZero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ i → M i k * N k i = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    rcases lt_trichotomy k i with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have hM0 : M i k = 0 := hM hlt
      simp [hM0]
    · exact absurd heq hk
    · have hN0 : N k i = 0 := hN hgt
      simp [hN0]
  calc ∑ k : ι, M i k * N k i
      = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι), M i k * N k i := rfl
    _ = M i i * N i i + ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι).erase i, M i k * N k i := by
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    _ = M i i * N i i + 0 := by
        have hSumZero :
            ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι).erase i, M i k * N k i = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro k hk
          have hkNe : k ≠ i := by
            intro heq
            have : k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι).erase i := hk
            simp [heq] at this
          exact hZero k hkNe
        rw [hSumZero, add_zero]
    _ = M i i * N i i := by simp

end UpperTriangularRing

section UpperUnitriangularCommRing

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Set of upper unitriangular matrices in `GL ι R`. -/
def upperUnitriangularSet (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : Set (GL ι R) :=
  { g | IsUpperTriangular (g : Matrix ι ι R) ∧ ∀ i, (g : Matrix ι ι R) i i = 1 }

/-- Bundled upper unitriangular subgroup. -/
def upperUnitriangularSubgroup (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : Subgroup (GL ι R) where
  carrier := upperUnitriangularSet ι R
  mul_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb
    constructor
    · exact ha.1.mul hb.1
    · intro i
      have hMul := isUpperTriangular_mul_diag ha.1 hb.1 i
      have hVal :
          ((a * b : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) =
            (a : Matrix ι ι R) * (b : Matrix ι ι R) := by simp
      calc ((a * b : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i i
          = ((a : Matrix ι ι R) * (b : Matrix ι ι R)) i i := by rw [hVal]
        _ = (a : Matrix ι ι R) i i * (b : Matrix ι ι R) i i := hMul
        _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [ha.2 i, hb.2 i]
        _ = 1 := by simp
  one_mem' := by
    constructor
    · exact blockTriangular_one
    · intro i
      simp
  inv_mem' := by
    intro g hg
    have hTri : BlockTriangular (g : Matrix ι ι R) id := hg.1
    have hDiag := hg.2
    have hInvTri : BlockTriangular ((g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) id := by
      let hInv : Invertible (g : Matrix ι ι R) :=
        { invOf := (g⁻¹ : GL ι R).val
          invOf_mul_self := by
            calc (↑(g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R)
                = ((g⁻¹ * g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by simp
              _ = ((1 : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
              _ = 1 := by simp
          mul_invOf_self := by
            calc (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)
                = ((g * g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by simp
              _ = ((1 : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
              _ = 1 := by simp }
      have hTriInv : BlockTriangular (↑g : Matrix ι ι R)⁻¹ id :=
        blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular (b := id) hTri
      have h1 : ⅟(↑g : Matrix ι ι R) = (↑g : Matrix ι ι R)⁻¹ :=
        invOf_eq_nonsing_inv _
      have h2 : ⅟(↑g : Matrix ι ι R) = (↑(g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl
      have hEq : (↑g : Matrix ι ι R)⁻¹ = (↑(g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) :=
        h1.symm.trans h2
      rw [hEq] at hTriInv
      exact hTriInv
    constructor
    · exact hInvTri
    · intro i
      have hMulOne : ((g : Matrix ι ι R) * (g⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) i i = 1 := by
        have h1 : (g : Matrix ι ι R) * (g⁻¹ : GL ι R).val = 1 := by
          calc (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)
              = ((g * g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by simp
            _ = ((1 : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
            _ = 1 := by simp
        rw [h1]
        simp
      have hMulDiag := isUpperTriangular_mul_diag hTri hInvTri i
      rw [hMulDiag] at hMulOne
      have hGi : (g : Matrix ι ι R) i i = 1 := hDiag i
      rw [hGi, one_mul] at hMulOne
      exact hMulOne

theorem upperElementarySet_subset_upperUnitriangularSet_commRing :
    upperElementarySet ι R ⊆ upperUnitriangularSet ι R := by
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hg
  constructor
  · have h :
        (elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a : GL ι R).val =
          (1 + Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl
    rw [h]
    exact elementary_isUpperTriangular hij a
  · intro k
    have h :
        (elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a : GL ι R).val =
          (1 + Matrix.single i j a : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl
    rw [h]
    exact elementary_diag (ne_of_lt hij) a k

theorem upperElementarySubgroup_le_upperUnitriangularSubgroup_commRing :
    upperElementarySubgroup ι R ≤ upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R := by
  rw [upperElementarySubgroup]
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  exact upperElementarySet_subset_upperUnitriangularSet_commRing

theorem upperElementary_isUpperTriangular_commRing
    (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    IsUpperTriangular ((g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) :=
  (upperElementarySubgroup_le_upperUnitriangularSubgroup_commRing (R := R) g.2).1

theorem upperElementary_diag_one_commRing (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) (i : ι) :
    ((g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i i = 1 :=
  (upperElementarySubgroup_le_upperUnitriangularSubgroup_commRing (R := R) g.2).2 i

theorem upperElementary_entry_zero_of_lt_commRing (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    {r s : ι} (h : s < r) :
    ((g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) r s = 0 :=
  upperElementary_isUpperTriangular_commRing g h

end UpperUnitriangularCommRing

section MonomialLemmas

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
/-- Entry of a monomial matrix: `M i j = if σ j = i then w i else 0`. -/
theorem monomialMatrixHom_entry (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι) :
    (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) i j =
      if σ j = i then (w i : F) else 0 := by
  have hCoe :
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) =
        Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (w k : F)) * (σ⁻¹).permMatrix F := by
    simp
  have hDiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (w k : F)) *
      (σ⁻¹).permMatrix F : Matrix ι ι F) i j =
      if (σ⁻¹ : Equiv.Perm ι) i = j then (w i : F) else 0 := by
    rw [diag_mul_perm_eq]
  rw [hCoe, hDiag]
  have hEquiv : (σ⁻¹ : Equiv.Perm ι) i = j ↔ σ j = i := by
    constructor
    · intro hh
      have : σ (σ⁻¹ i) = i := Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i
      calc σ j = σ (σ⁻¹ i) := by rw [hh]
        _ = i := this
    · intro hh
      rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq]
      exact hh.symm
  by_cases h : σ j = i
  · have h1 : (σ⁻¹ : Equiv.Perm ι) i = j := hEquiv.mpr h
    rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left h]
  · have h1 : ¬ (σ⁻¹ : Equiv.Perm ι) i = j := by
      intro heq
      exact h (hEquiv.mp heq)
    rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem monomialMatrixHom_weight_ne_zero (w : ι → Fˣ) (_σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i : ι) :
    (w i : F) ≠ 0 := (w i).ne_zero

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
/-- Left multiplication by arbitrary `T` on a monomial
` (T * M) i j = T i (σ j) * w (σ j)`. -/
theorem upper_mul_monomial_apply (T : Matrix ι ι F) (w : ι → Fˣ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι) :
    (T * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F)) i j =
      T i (σ j) * (w (σ j) : F) := by
  classical
  have hEntry : ∀ k : ι,
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) k j =
        if σ j = k then (w k : F) else 0 :=
    fun k => monomialMatrixHom_entry w σ k j
  calc (T * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F)) i j
      = ∑ k : ι, T i k * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) k j := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = ∑ k : ι, T i k * if σ j = k then (w k : F) else 0 := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro k
          rw [hEntry k]
    _ = ∑ k : ι, if σ j = k then T i k * (w k : F) else 0 := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro k
          by_cases hk : σ j = k
          · simp [hk]
          · simp [hk]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
          if σ j = k then T i k * (w k : F) else 0 := rfl
    _ = T i (σ j) * (w (σ j) : F) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (σ j)
            (fun k => T i k * (w k : F))]
          simp

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
/-- Right multiplication by arbitrary `T` on a monomial
` (M * T) i j = w i * T (σ⁻¹ i) j`. -/
theorem monomial_mul_upper_apply (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (T : Matrix ι ι F) (i j : ι) :
    ((monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) * T) i j =
      (w i : F) * T (σ⁻¹ i) j := by
  classical
  have hEntry : ∀ k : ι,
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) i k =
        if σ k = i then (w i : F) else 0 :=
    fun k => monomialMatrixHom_entry w σ i k
  calc ((monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) * T) i j
      = ∑ k : ι, (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) i k * T k j := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = ∑ k : ι, (if σ k = i then (w i : F) else 0) * T k j := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro k
          rw [hEntry k]
    _ = ∑ k : ι, if σ k = i then (w i : F) * T k j else 0 := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro k
          by_cases hk : σ k = i
          · simp [hk]
          · simp [hk]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
          if σ k = i then (w i : F) * T k j else 0 := rfl
    _ = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
          if k = σ⁻¹ i then (w i : F) * T k j else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          have hSym : (σ k = i ↔ k = σ⁻¹ i) := by
            constructor
            · intro hk
              have : σ⁻¹ i = k := by
                rw [Equiv.Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq]
                exact hk.symm
              exact this.symm
            · intro hk
              rw [hk]
              simp
          by_cases hk : σ k = i
          · have hk' : k = σ⁻¹ i := hSym.mp hk
            rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_left hk']
          · have hk' : ¬ k = σ⁻¹ i := by
              intro heq
              exact hk (hSym.mpr heq)
            rw [ite_eq_right hk, ite_eq_right hk']
    _ = (w i : F) * T (σ⁻¹ i) j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (σ⁻¹ i)
            (fun k => (w i : F) * T k j)]
          simp

end MonomialLemmas

section BruhatCellUniqueness

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
/-- Core rearrangement lemma: equality `L * M * R = L' * M' * R'`
gives `T * M = M' * T'` with `T = L'⁻¹ L` and `T' = R' R⁻¹` unitriangular. -/
theorem bruhatCell_rearrange (L R L' R' : GL ι F)
    (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (w' : ι → Fˣ) (σ' : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (h : L * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * R =
      L' * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * R') :
    (L'⁻¹ * L : GL ι F).val * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) =
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
        (R' * R⁻¹ : GL ι F).val := by
  have hGL : (L'⁻¹ * L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ =
      monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' * R⁻¹ : GL ι F) := by
    calc (L'⁻¹ * L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩
        = L'⁻¹ * (L * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * R) * R⁻¹ := by
          simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = L'⁻¹ * (L' * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * R') * R⁻¹ := by rw [h]
      _ = monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' * R⁻¹ : GL ι F) := by
          simp [mul_assoc]
  calc ((L'⁻¹ * L : GL ι F).val : Matrix ι ι F) *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F)
      = (((L'⁻¹ * L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : GL ι F).val :
          Matrix ι ι F) := by simp
    _ = ((monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' * R⁻¹ : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val :
          Matrix ι ι F) := by rw [hGL]
    _ = (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
        (R' * R⁻¹ : GL ι F).val := by simp

section BruhatPermWeight

/-- Square Bruhat-cell uniqueness of inverse permutations. -/
theorem bruhatCell_perm_inv_unique
    (L R L' R' : upperElementarySubgroup ι F)
    (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (w' : ι → Fˣ) (σ' : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (h : (L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * (R : GL ι F) =
      (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' : GL ι F)) :
    σ⁻¹ = σ'⁻¹ := by
  classical
  let T : GL ι F := (L' : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L : GL ι F)
  let T' : GL ι F := (R' : GL ι F) * (R : GL ι F)⁻¹
  have hTmem : T ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ L'.2) L.2
  have hT'mem : T' ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ R'.2 (Subgroup.inv_mem _ R.2)
  have hT_tri : IsUpperTriangular (T : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    upperElementary_isUpperTriangular_commRing ⟨T, hTmem⟩
  have hT'_tri : IsUpperTriangular (T' : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    upperElementary_isUpperTriangular_commRing ⟨T', hT'mem⟩
  have hT_diag : ∀ i, (T : Matrix ι ι F) i i = 1 :=
    fun i => upperElementary_diag_one_commRing ⟨T, hTmem⟩ i
  have hMat : (T : Matrix ι ι F) * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) =
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) * (T' : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    bruhatCell_rearrange (L : GL ι F) (R : GL ι F) (L' : GL ι F) (R' : GL ι F)
      w σ w' σ' h
  have hLe1 : ∀ i : ι, σ'⁻¹ i ≤ σ⁻¹ i := by
    intro i
    have hEq := congrFun (congrFun hMat i) (σ⁻¹ i)
    rw [upper_mul_monomial_apply (T : Matrix ι ι F) w σ i (σ⁻¹ i),
      monomial_mul_upper_apply w' σ' (T' : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ⁻¹ i)] at hEq
    have hLeft : (T : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ (σ⁻¹ i)) * (w (σ (σ⁻¹ i)) : F) =
        (w i : F) := by
      have : σ (σ⁻¹ i) = i := Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i
      rw [this, hT_diag i, one_mul]
    rw [hLeft] at hEq
    by_contra hNot
    have hLt : (σ⁻¹ i) < (σ'⁻¹ i) := lt_of_not_ge hNot
    have hZero : (T' : Matrix ι ι F) (σ'⁻¹ i) (σ⁻¹ i) = 0 := hT'_tri hLt
    rw [hZero, mul_zero] at hEq
    have hwNe : (w i : F) ≠ 0 := (w i).ne_zero
    exact hwNe hEq
  have hOther :
      ((L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) =
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
          ((R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹ : GL ι F).val := by
    have hSym : (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' : GL ι F) =
        (L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * (R : GL ι F) := h.symm
    have hGL : ((L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F) : GL ι F) *
        monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ =
        monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ *
          ((R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹ : GL ι F) := by
      calc ((L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F) : GL ι F) *
            monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩
          = (L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * R') * R'⁻¹ := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
        _ = (L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * R) * R'⁻¹ := by
            rw [hSym]
        _ = monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * ((R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹) := by
            simp [mul_assoc]
    calc (((L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val : Matrix ι ι F) *
          (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F)
        = (((L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ :
            GL ι F).val : Matrix ι ι F) := by simp
      _ = ((monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ *
            ((R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹ : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val :
            Matrix ι ι F) := by rw [hGL]
      _ = (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
          ((R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹ : GL ι F).val := by simp
  have hLe2 : ∀ i : ι, σ⁻¹ i ≤ σ'⁻¹ i := by
    intro i
    let T2 : GL ι F := (L : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L' : GL ι F)
    let S2 : GL ι F := (R : GL ι F) * (R' : GL ι F)⁻¹
    have hT2mem : T2 ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ L.2) L'.2
    have hS2mem : S2 ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ R.2 (Subgroup.inv_mem _ R'.2)
    have hS2_tri : IsUpperTriangular (S2 : Matrix ι ι F) :=
      upperElementary_isUpperTriangular_commRing ⟨S2, hS2mem⟩
    have hT2_diag : ∀ k, (T2 : Matrix ι ι F) k k = 1 :=
      fun k => upperElementary_diag_one_commRing ⟨T2, hT2mem⟩ k
    have hEq := congrFun (congrFun hOther i) (σ'⁻¹ i)
    rw [upper_mul_monomial_apply (T2 : Matrix ι ι F) w' σ' i (σ'⁻¹ i),
      monomial_mul_upper_apply w σ (S2 : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ'⁻¹ i)] at hEq
    have hLeft : (T2 : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ' (σ'⁻¹ i)) * (w' (σ' (σ'⁻¹ i)) : F) =
        (w' i : F) := by
      have : σ' (σ'⁻¹ i) = i := Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ' i
      rw [this, hT2_diag i, one_mul]
    rw [hLeft] at hEq
    by_contra hNot
    have hLt : (σ'⁻¹ i) < (σ⁻¹ i) := lt_of_not_ge hNot
    have hZero : (S2 : Matrix ι ι F) (σ⁻¹ i) (σ'⁻¹ i) = 0 := hS2_tri hLt
    rw [hZero, mul_zero] at hEq
    have hwNe : (w' i : F) ≠ 0 := (w' i).ne_zero
    exact hwNe hEq
  have hEqInv : σ'⁻¹ = σ⁻¹ := by
    ext i
    exact le_antisymm (hLe1 i) (hLe2 i)
  exact hEqInv.symm

/-- Weight uniqueness given permutation equality. -/
theorem bruhatCell_weight_unique
    (L R L' R' : upperElementarySubgroup ι F)
    (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (w' : ι → Fˣ) (σ' : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (h : (L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * (R : GL ι F) =
      (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' : GL ι F))
    (hPermInv : σ⁻¹ = σ'⁻¹) :
    w = w' := by
  classical
  let T : GL ι F := (L' : GL ι F)⁻¹ * (L : GL ι F)
  let T' : GL ι F := (R' : GL ι F) * (R : GL ι F)⁻¹
  have hTmem : T ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ L'.2) L.2
  have hT'mem : T' ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι F := by
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ R'.2 (Subgroup.inv_mem _ R.2)
  have hT_diag : ∀ i, (T : Matrix ι ι F) i i = 1 :=
    fun i => upperElementary_diag_one_commRing ⟨T, hTmem⟩ i
  have hT'_diag : ∀ i, (T' : Matrix ι ι F) i i = 1 :=
    fun i => upperElementary_diag_one_commRing ⟨T', hT'mem⟩ i
  have hMat : (T : Matrix ι ι F) * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) =
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) * (T' : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    bruhatCell_rearrange (L : GL ι F) (R : GL ι F) (L' : GL ι F) (R' : GL ι F)
      w σ w' σ' h
  funext i
  have hEq := congrFun (congrFun hMat i) (σ⁻¹ i)
  rw [upper_mul_monomial_apply (T : Matrix ι ι F) w σ i (σ⁻¹ i),
    monomial_mul_upper_apply w' σ' (T' : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ⁻¹ i)] at hEq
  have hLeft : (T : Matrix ι ι F) i (σ (σ⁻¹ i)) * (w (σ (σ⁻¹ i)) : F) =
      (w i : F) := by
    have : σ (σ⁻¹ i) = i := Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i
    rw [this, hT_diag i, one_mul]
  rw [hLeft] at hEq
  have hPermEq : σ'⁻¹ i = σ⁻¹ i := by
    exact congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm ι => p i) hPermInv.symm
  rw [← hPermEq] at hEq
  have hT'_diag_i : (T' : Matrix ι ι F) (σ'⁻¹ i) (σ'⁻¹ i) = 1 :=
    hT'_diag (σ'⁻¹ i)
  rw [hT'_diag_i, mul_one] at hEq
  exact Units.ext hEq

/-- Square Bruhat-cell uniqueness: monomial factors are equal. -/
theorem bruhatCell_monomial_unique
    (L R L' R' : upperElementarySubgroup ι F)
    (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (w' : ι → Fˣ) (σ' : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (h : (L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * (R : GL ι F) =
      (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' : GL ι F)) :
    monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ = monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ := by
  have hPermInv := bruhatCell_perm_inv_unique L R L' R' w σ w' σ' h
  have hPerm : σ = σ' := by
    calc σ = σ⁻¹⁻¹ := by simp
      _ = σ'⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [hPermInv]
      _ = σ' := by simp
  have hW := bruhatCell_weight_unique L R L' R' w σ w' σ' h hPermInv
  rw [hW, hPerm]

theorem bruhatCell_unique_full
    (L R L' R' : upperElementarySubgroup ι F)
    (w : ι → Fˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (w' : ι → Fˣ) (σ' : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (h : (L : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ * (R : GL ι F) =
      (L' : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ * (R' : GL ι F)) :
    w = w' ∧ σ = σ' ∧
      monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w, σ⟩ = monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨w', σ'⟩ := by
  have hPermInv := bruhatCell_perm_inv_unique L R L' R' w σ w' σ' h
  have hPerm : σ = σ' := by
    calc σ = σ⁻¹⁻¹ := by simp
      _ = σ'⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [hPermInv]
      _ = σ' := by simp
  have hW := bruhatCell_weight_unique L R L' R' w σ w' σ' h hPermInv
  exact ⟨hW, hPerm, bruhatCell_monomial_unique L R L' R' w σ w' σ' h⟩

end BruhatPermWeight

end BruhatCellUniqueness

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section HeterogeneousUniqueness

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

open Matrix.GeneralLinearEquiv

theorem heterogeneousBruhatDecomposition_middle_unique
    (e : GeneralLinearEquiv ι ι F)
    (d₁ d₂ : HeterogeneousBruhatDecomposition e) :
    d₁.weights = d₂.weights ∧ d₁.perm = d₂.perm := by
  classical
  have hVal1 := d₁.val_eq
  have hVal2 := d₂.val_eq
  have hEqMat : (d₁.left : GL ι F).val * (monomialEquiv d₁.weights d₁.perm).val *
      (d₁.right : GL ι F).val =
      (d₂.left : GL ι F).val * (monomialEquiv d₂.weights d₂.perm).val *
        (d₂.right : GL ι F).val := by rw [← hVal1, ← hVal2]
  have hMono1 :
      (monomialEquiv d₁.weights d₁.perm).val =
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₁.weights, d₁.perm⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    monomialEquiv_eq_monomialMatrixHom d₁.weights d₁.perm
  have hMono2 :
      (monomialEquiv d₂.weights d₂.perm).val =
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₂.weights, d₂.perm⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) :=
    monomialEquiv_eq_monomialMatrixHom d₂.weights d₂.perm
  have hGL : (d₁.left : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₁.weights, d₁.perm⟩ *
      (d₁.right : GL ι F) =
      (d₂.left : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₂.weights, d₂.perm⟩ *
        (d₂.right : GL ι F) := by
    apply Units.ext
    calc ((d₁.left : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₁.weights, d₁.perm⟩ *
        (d₁.right : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val
        = (d₁.left : GL ι F).val * (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₁.weights, d₁.perm⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
          (d₁.right : GL ι F).val := by simp
      _ = (d₁.left : GL ι F).val * (monomialEquiv d₁.weights d₁.perm).val *
          (d₁.right : GL ι F).val := by rw [← hMono1]
      _ = (d₂.left : GL ι F).val * (monomialEquiv d₂.weights d₂.perm).val *
          (d₂.right : GL ι F).val := hEqMat
      _ = (d₂.left : GL ι F).val *
          (monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₂.weights, d₂.perm⟩ : Matrix ι ι F) *
          (d₂.right : GL ι F).val := by rw [hMono2]
      _ = ((d₂.left : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι ⟨d₂.weights, d₂.perm⟩ *
          (d₂.right : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val := by simp
  have hFull := bruhatCell_unique_full d₁.left d₁.right d₂.left d₂.right
    d₁.weights d₁.perm d₂.weights d₂.perm hGL
  exact ⟨hFull.1, hFull.2.1⟩

end HeterogeneousUniqueness

section SLUniqueness

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

open Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup

theorem specialLinearBruhatDecomposition_middle_unique
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (d₁ d₂ : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    d₁.middle = d₂.middle := by
  classical
  have hGL1 := d₁.factorizationGL
  have hGL2 := d₂.factorizationGL
  have hEq : (d₁.left : GL ι F) *
      monomialMatrixHom F ι (d₁.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) *
        (d₁.right : GL ι F) =
      (d₂.left : GL ι F) *
        monomialMatrixHom F ι (d₂.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) *
          (d₂.right : GL ι F) := by rw [← hGL1, ← hGL2]
  have hPermInv := bruhatCell_perm_inv_unique d₁.left d₁.right d₂.left d₂.right
    d₁.middle.1.left d₁.middle.1.right d₂.middle.1.left d₂.middle.1.right hEq
  have hW := bruhatCell_weight_unique d₁.left d₁.right d₂.left d₂.right
    d₁.middle.1.left d₁.middle.1.right d₂.middle.1.left d₂.middle.1.right hEq hPermInv
  have hBase : (d₁.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) = (d₂.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) := by
    have hPerm : (d₁.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right =
        (d₂.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right := by
      calc (d₁.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right
          = (d₁.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right⁻¹⁻¹ := by simp
        _ = (d₂.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right⁻¹⁻¹ := by rw [hPermInv]
        _ = (d₂.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι).right := by simp
    exact SemidirectProduct.ext hW hPerm
  exact Subtype.ext hBase

theorem bruhatMiddle_eq_of_decomposition
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    bruhatMiddle g = d.middle := by
  let hCanon := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g
  have hUniq := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition_middle_unique g hCanon d
  calc bruhatMiddle g = hCanon.middle := rfl
    _ = d.middle := hUniq

theorem bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (left : upperElementarySubgroup ι F) (middle : MonomialSL F ι)
    (right : upperElementarySubgroup ι F)
    (hSL : g = UpperElementary.toSLHom left * monomialSLHom F ι middle *
      UpperElementary.toSLHom right) :
    bruhatMiddle g = middle := by
  have hGL : (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) =
      (left : GL ι F) * monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) *
        (right : GL ι F) := by
    have hToGL : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (UpperElementary.toSLHom left * monomialSLHom F ι middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom right) := by rw [← hSL]
    simp only [map_mul, UpperElementary.toGL_toSLHom, monomialSLHom_toGL] at hToGL
    exact hToGL
  let d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g :=
    { left := left
      middle := middle
      right := right
      factorizationGL := hGL
      factorizationSL := hSL }
  exact bruhatMiddle_eq_of_decomposition g d

theorem bruhatMiddle_monomialSLHom (x : MonomialSL F ι) :
    bruhatMiddle (monomialSLHom F ι x) = x := by
  have hSL : monomialSLHom F ι x =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (1 : upperElementarySubgroup ι F) *
        monomialSLHom F ι x *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom (1 : upperElementarySubgroup ι F) := by simp
  exact bruhatMiddle_factorization_elim
    (monomialSLHom F ι x) 1 x 1 hSL

end SLUniqueness

section RetractionNaturality

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]
variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
variable {L : Type*} [Field L]

theorem bruhatMiddle_map (f : F →+* K) (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    bruhatMiddle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) =
      monomialSLMap F K ι f (bruhatMiddle g) := by
  classical
  let d := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g
  have hMid : d.middle = bruhatMiddle g := rfl
  let dMap := d.map f
  have hMapMid : dMap.middle = monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle := rfl
  have hEq := bruhatMiddle_eq_of_decomposition (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) dMap
  calc bruhatMiddle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g)
      = dMap.middle := hEq
    _ = monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle := hMapMid
    _ = monomialSLMap F K ι f (bruhatMiddle g) := by rw [hMid]

theorem bruhatMiddle_map_id (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    bruhatMiddle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (RingHom.id F) g) =
      bruhatMiddle g := by
  rw [bruhatMiddle_map]
  have hId := monomialSLMap_id F ι
  have h : monomialSLMap F F ι (RingHom.id F) (bruhatMiddle g) = bruhatMiddle g := by
    calc monomialSLMap F F ι (RingHom.id F) (bruhatMiddle g)
        = (MonoidHom.id (MonomialSL F ι)) (bruhatMiddle g) := by rw [hId]
      _ = bruhatMiddle g := rfl
  rw [h]

theorem bruhatMiddle_map_comp (f : F →+* K) (g : K →+* L)
    (x : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    bruhatMiddle (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (g.comp f) x) =
      monomialSLMap K L ι g
        (monomialSLMap F K ι f (bruhatMiddle x)) := by
  rw [bruhatMiddle_map]
  have hComp := monomialSLMap_comp F K L ι f g
  calc monomialSLMap F L ι (g.comp f) (bruhatMiddle x)
      = ((monomialSLMap K L ι g).comp (monomialSLMap F K ι f)) (bruhatMiddle x) := by
          rw [hComp]
    _ = monomialSLMap K L ι g (monomialSLMap F K ι f (bruhatMiddle x)) := rfl

end RetractionNaturality
