/-!
# Simple-root Weyl and torus stabilization via successor embedding

Field-independent successor API for simple-root Weyl and torus elements.
This packet is matrix/root-data infrastructure, not K-theory.

For `{n : ℕ}`, `{i j : Fin n}`, `hij : i ≠ j`, and `u : Rˣ` over an
arbitrary `CommRing R`:

* `Fin.castSucc` preserves `CovBy` / adjacency;
* `permSuccHom (swap i j) = swap (castSucc i) (castSucc j)`;
* `tupleSuccHom` sends `weylWeightUnit` / `torusWeightUnit` to the
  `castSucc`-embedded weight;
* the induced identities for `weylMonomialBaseUnit` /
  `torusMonomialBaseUnit` under `monomialSuccHom` and for
  `weylMonomialSLUnit` / `torusMonomialSLUnit` under `monomialSLSuccHom`;
* the matrix endpoints
  `stabilization (weylSLUnit i j hij u) = weylSLUnit (castSucc i) (castSucc j) _ u`
  and the torus analogue, via
  `weylSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom` / `torusSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom` and
  `monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom`.

Tuple and permutation identities are proved pointwise with
`Fin.lastCases`, `tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc/last`, and
`permSuccHom_apply_castSucc/last`; the parameter `u` is preserved
exactly.
-/

@[expose] public section

open PermutationBilinearTitsStabilization

namespace Fin

/-- `Fin.castSucc` preserves `CovBy` / adjacency.

For `Fin n` the order is `i < j ↔ i.val < j.val`; `i ⋖ j` means
`j.val = i.val + 1`. The map `castSucc : Fin n → Fin (n+1)` has
`(castSucc i).val = i.val` and is strictly monotone, so it preserves
covers. This is the small order lemma needed for simple-root
stabilization. -/
theorem castSucc_covBy {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ⋖ j) :
    (Fin.castSucc i : Fin (n + 1)) ⋖ Fin.castSucc j := by
  have h_lt : Fin.castSucc (n := n) i < Fin.castSucc (n := n) j := by
    rw [Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff]
    exact hij.lt
  constructor
  · exact h_lt
  · intro k hk1 hk2
    have hk1_val : i.val < k.val := by
      have h1 : (Fin.castSucc (n := n) i).val < k.val := by
        have hk1' : Fin.castSucc (n := n) i < k := hk1
        rw [Fin.lt_def] at hk1'
        exact hk1'
      simpa using h1
    have hk2_val : k.val < j.val := by
      have h2 : k.val < (Fin.castSucc (n := n) j).val := by
        have hk2' : k < Fin.castSucc (n := n) j := hk2
        rw [Fin.lt_def] at hk2'
        exact hk2'
      simpa using h2
    have hk_val_lt_n : k.val < n := by
      have hj_lt : j.val < n := j.isLt
      omega
    let k' : Fin n := ⟨k.val, hk_val_lt_n⟩
    have hi_lt_k' : i < k' := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      exact hk1_val
    have hk'_lt_j : k' < j := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      exact hk2_val
    exact hij.2 hi_lt_k' hk'_lt_j

end Fin

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section PermSucc

/-- Successor of a transposition is the transposition of successors. -/
theorem permSuccHom_swap {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} :
    permSuccHom (n := n) (Equiv.swap i j) =
      Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro k
  refine Fin.lastCases (motive := fun k =>
      (permSuccHom (n := n) (Equiv.swap i j) : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) k =
        Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) k) ?_ (fun k' => ?_) k
  · simp only [permSuccHom_apply_last]
    have h1 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc i :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))
    have h2 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc j :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j))
    simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 h2]
  · by_cases hk_i : k' = i
    · subst hk_i
      simp only [permSuccHom_apply_castSucc, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
    · by_cases hk_j : k' = j
      · subst hk_j
        simp only [permSuccHom_apply_castSucc, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
      · have h_swap_left : Equiv.swap i j k' = k' :=
          Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hk_i hk_j
        have h_ne_ci : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc i := by
          intro h
          exact hk_i (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        have h_ne_cj : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc j := by
          intro h
          exact hk_j (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        have h_swap_right :
            Equiv.swap (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) (Fin.castSucc k') =
              Fin.castSucc k' :=
          Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h_ne_ci h_ne_cj
        simp only [permSuccHom_apply_castSucc, h_swap_left, h_swap_right]

end PermSucc

section WeightSucc

variable {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- `tupleSuccHom` sends the Weyl weight at `(i,j)` to the weight at
` (castSucc i, castSucc j)`. Proved pointwise with `Fin.lastCases`. -/
theorem tupleSuccHom_weylWeightUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    tupleSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      weylWeightUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
        (fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)) u := by
  apply funext
  intro k
  refine Fin.lastCases (motive := fun k =>
      tupleSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u) k =
        weylWeightUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) _ u k) ?_
      (fun k' => ?_) k
  · simp only [tupleSuccHom_apply_last, weylWeightUnit]
    have h1 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc i :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))
    have h2 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc j :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j))
    simp [h1, h2]
  · by_cases hk_i : k' = i
    · simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, weylWeightUnit]
    · by_cases hk_j : k' = j
      · have h_ne_ci : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc i := by
          intro h
          exact hk_i (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, weylWeightUnit]
      · have h_ne_ci : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc i := by
          intro h
          exact hk_i (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        have h_ne_cj : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc j := by
          intro h
          exact hk_j (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, weylWeightUnit]

/-- `tupleSuccHom` sends the torus weight at `(i,j)` to the weight at
` (castSucc i, castSucc j)`. -/
theorem tupleSuccHom_torusWeightUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    tupleSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (torusWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      torusWeightUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
        (fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)) u := by
  apply funext
  intro k
  refine Fin.lastCases (motive := fun k =>
      tupleSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (torusWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u) k =
        torusWeightUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) _ u k) ?_
      (fun k' => ?_) k
  · simp only [tupleSuccHom_apply_last, torusWeightUnit]
    have h1 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc i :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))
    have h2 : Fin.last (n := n) ≠ Fin.castSucc j :=
      Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j))
    simp [h1, h2]
  · by_cases hk_i : k' = i
    · simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, torusWeightUnit]
    · by_cases hk_j : k' = j
      · have h_ne_ci : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc i := by
          intro h
          exact hk_i (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, torusWeightUnit]
      · have h_ne_ci : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc i := by
          intro h
          exact hk_i (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        have h_ne_cj : Fin.castSucc k' ≠ Fin.castSucc j := by
          intro h
          exact hk_j (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
        simp [tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc, torusWeightUnit]

end WeightSucc

section MonomialBaseSucc

variable {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorem monomialSuccHom_weylMonomialBaseUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (weylMonomialBaseUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      weylMonomialBaseUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)

  · simp only [monomialSuccHom_left]
    exact tupleSuccHom_weylWeightUnit hij u
  · simp only [monomialSuccHom_right, weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylPerm]

theorem monomialSuccHom_torusMonomialBaseUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) (torusMonomialBaseUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =

section MonomialSLSucc

variable {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorem monomialSLSuccHom_weylMonomialSLUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) (n := n) (weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
        (fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)) u := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [coe_monomialSLSuccHom]
  exact monomialSuccHom_weylMonomialBaseUnit hij u

theorem monomialSLSuccHom_torusMonomialSLUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) (n := n) (torusMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      torusMonomialSLUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)

section Stabilization

variable {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Matrix endpoint: `SL` stabilization sends the simple-root Weyl element
at `(i,j)` to the Weyl element at `(castSucc i, castSucc j)`, preserving
`u` exactly. Uses `weylSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom` and
`monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom`; no matrix entry computation. -/
theorem stabilization_weylSLUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      weylSLUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
        (fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)) u := by
  have hij' : Fin.castSucc (n := n) i ≠ Fin.castSucc (n := n) j :=
    fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
  calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (weylSLUnit i j hij u)
      = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R
          (monomialSLHom R (Fin n) (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij u)) := by
        rw [← weylSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom]
    _ = monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
          (monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij u)) := by
        rw [← monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom]
    _ = monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
          (weylMonomialSLUnit (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) hij' u) := by
        rw [monomialSLSuccHom_weylMonomialSLUnit hij u]
    _ = weylSLUnit (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) hij' u := by
        rw [weylSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom]

/-- Matrix endpoint: `SL` stabilization sends the simple-root torus element
at `(i,j)` to the torus element at `(castSucc i, castSucc j)`. -/
theorem stabilization_torusSLUnit (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (torusSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u) =
      torusSLUnit (R := R) (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
        (fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)) u := by
  have hij' : Fin.castSucc (n := n) i ≠ Fin.castSucc (n := n) j :=
    fun h => hij (Fin.castSucc_injective n h)
  calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (torusSLUnit i j hij u)
      = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R
          (monomialSLHom R (Fin n) (torusMonomialSLUnit i j hij u)) := by
        rw [← torusSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom]
    _ = monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
          (monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) (torusMonomialSLUnit i j hij u)) := by
        rw [← monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom]
    _ = monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
          (torusMonomialSLUnit (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) hij' u) := by
        rw [monomialSLSuccHom_torusMonomialSLUnit hij u]
    _ = torusSLUnit (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) hij' u := by
        rw [torusSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom]

end Stabilization

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section SwapOrder

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

theorem swap_eq_ite (i j : ι) (x : ι) :
    Equiv.swap i j x =
      if x = i then j else if x = j then i else x := by
  by_cases hx_i : x = i
  · simp [hx_i, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  · by_cases hx_j : x = j
    · have hj_ne_i : j ≠ i := by
        intro heq
        exact hx_i (heq ▸ hx_j)
      rw [hx_j]
      simp [hj_ne_i, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
    · simp [hx_i, hx_j, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]

end SwapOrder

section AdjacentSwapOrder

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι]

theorem adjacentSwap_preserves_lt {i j : ι} (hij : i ⋖ j)
    {p q : ι} (hqp : q < p) (hne : ¬(q = i ∧ p = j)) :
    Equiv.swap i j q < Equiv.swap i j p := by
  classical
  by_cases hqi : q = i
  · by_cases hpj : p = j
    · exfalso
      exact hne ⟨hqi, hpj⟩
    · have hp_ne_j : p ≠ j := hpj
      by_cases hp_i : p = i
      · have h_eq : q = p := hqi.trans hp_i.symm
        exact absurd h_eq (ne_of_lt hqp)
      · have hq_swap : Equiv.swap i j q = j := by
          rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_left hqi]
        have hp_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j p = p := by
          rw [swap_eq_ite i j p, ite_eq_right hp_i, ite_eq_right hp_ne_j]
        rw [hq_swap, hp_swap_eq]
        have hj_lt_p : j < p := by
          have h_le : j ≤ p := by
            by_contra h_not_le
            have hp_lt_j : p < j := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
            have hi_lt_p : i < p := hqi ▸ hqp
            exfalso
            exact hij.2 (c := p) hi_lt_p hp_lt_j
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_le with heq | hlt
          · exact absurd heq.symm hp_ne_j
          · exact hlt
        exact hj_lt_p
  · by_cases hqj : q = j
    · have hq_swap : Equiv.swap i j q = i := by
        rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_left hqj]
      have hj_lt_p : j < p := hqj ▸ hqp
      rw [hq_swap]
      by_cases hp_i : p = i
      · subst hp_i
        exact absurd hj_lt_p (not_lt_of_gt hij.1)
      · by_cases hp_j : p = j
        · have h_eq : q = p := hqj.trans hp_j.symm
          exact absurd h_eq (ne_of_lt hqp)
        · have hp_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j p = p := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j p, ite_eq_right hp_i, ite_eq_right hp_j]
          rw [hp_swap_eq]
          exact lt_trans hij.1 hj_lt_p
    · by_cases hp_i : p = i
      · have hp_swap : Equiv.swap i j p = j := by
          rw [swap_eq_ite i j p, ite_eq_left hp_i]
        have hq_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j q = q := by
          rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_right hqj]
        rw [hp_swap, hq_swap_eq]
        have hq_lt_i : q < i := hp_i ▸ hqp
        exact lt_trans hq_lt_i hij.1
      · by_cases hp_j : p = j
        · have hp_swap : Equiv.swap i j p = i := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j p, ite_eq_right hp_i, ite_eq_left hp_j]
          have hq_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j q = q := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_right hqj]
          rw [hp_swap, hq_swap_eq]
          have hq_lt_j : q < j := hp_j ▸ hqp
          have hq_lt_i : q < i := by
            by_contra h_not_lt
            have hi_le_q : i ≤ q := not_lt.mp h_not_lt
            rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hi_le_q with heq | hlt
            · exact absurd heq.symm hqi
            · exfalso
              exact hij.2 (c := q) hlt hq_lt_j
          exact hq_lt_i
        · have hp_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j p = p := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j p, ite_eq_right hp_i, ite_eq_right hp_j]
          have hq_swap_eq : Equiv.swap i j q = q := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_right hqj]
          rw [hp_swap_eq, hq_swap_eq]
          exact hqp

end AdjacentSwapOrder

section EntryFormula

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

open PermutationBilinearCocycle

private theorem weylGLUnit_entry_aux (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ)
    (p q : ι) :
    (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) p q =
      if Equiv.swap i j q = p then
        (weylWeightUnit i j hij u p : R) else 0 := by
  have h_eq := weylGLUnit_eq_monomialMatrixHom (R := R) i j hij u
  have h_entry := monomialMatrixHom_val_entry
    (R := R) (x := weylMonomialBaseUnit i j hij u) p q
  have h_val :
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (monomialMatrixHom R ι (weylMonomialBaseUnit i j hij u) :
        Matrix ι ι R) := by
    rw [h_eq]
  rw [← h_val] at h_entry
  simpa [weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylWeightUnit, weylPerm] using h_entry

private theorem weylGLUnit_inv_entry_aux (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (u : Rˣ) (p q : ι) :
    (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) p q =
      if Equiv.swap i j q = p then
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) p : R) else 0 := by
  have h_inv : (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ =
      weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) :=
    weylGLUnit_inv i j hij u
  have h :
      ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) : GL ι R).val) p q =
      if Equiv.swap i j q = p then
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) p : R) else 0 :=
    weylGLUnit_entry_aux i j hij (-u) p q
  have h2 :
      (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) =
      ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) : GL ι R).val) := by
    rw [h_inv]
  rw [h2]
  exact h

/-- Exact entry formula for conjugation by `weylGLUnit`.
For `W = weylGLUnit i j u` and `σ = swap i j`,
`(W * M * W⁻¹) p q = w p * M (σ p) (σ q) * (w q)⁻¹`
where `w = weylWeightUnit i j u`. Verified sign convention:
`W⁻¹ = weylGLUnit (-u)` with weight `-u` at `i` and `u⁻¹` at `j`. -/
theorem weylGLUnit_conj_entry (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ)
    (M : Matrix ι ι R) (p q : ι) :
    (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M *
        ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) p q) =
      (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
        M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) *
        ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val := by
  classical
  have hW : ∀ a b,
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) a b =
      if b = Equiv.swap i j a then
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u a : R) else 0 := by
    intro a b
    have h := weylGLUnit_entry_aux (R := R) i j hij u a b
    have h_iff : Equiv.swap i j b = a ↔ b = Equiv.swap i j a := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        calc b = Equiv.swap i j (Equiv.swap i j b) :=
              (Equiv.swap_apply_self i j b).symm
          _ = Equiv.swap i j a := by rw [h]
      · intro h
        rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_self]
    by_cases hb : Equiv.swap i j b = a
    · have hb2 : b = Equiv.swap i j a := h_iff.mp hb
      rw [h]
      rw [ite_eq_left hb, ite_eq_left hb2]
    · have hb2 : ¬ b = Equiv.swap i j a := fun h2 => hb (h_iff.mpr h2)
      rw [h]
      rw [ite_eq_right hb, ite_eq_right hb2]
  have hWinv : ∀ a b,
      (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) a b =
      if b = Equiv.swap i j a then
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) a : R) else 0 := by
    intro a b
    have h := weylGLUnit_inv_entry_aux (R := R) i j hij u a b
    have h_iff : Equiv.swap i j b = a ↔ b = Equiv.swap i j a := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        calc b = Equiv.swap i j (Equiv.swap i j b) :=
              (Equiv.swap_apply_self i j b).symm
          _ = Equiv.swap i j a := by rw [h]
      · intro h
        rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_self]
    by_cases hb : Equiv.swap i j b = a
    · have hb2 : b = Equiv.swap i j a := h_iff.mp hb
      rw [h]
      rw [ite_eq_left hb, ite_eq_left hb2]
    · have hb2 : ¬ b = Equiv.swap i j a := fun h2 => hb (h_iff.mpr h2)
      rw [h]
      rw [ite_eq_right hb, ite_eq_right hb2]
  have hWeightInv : ∀ q,
      (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) : R) =
        ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val := by
    intro q
    have hUnit : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) =
        ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q)⁻¹ : Rˣ) := by
      by_cases hqi : q = i
      · have h1 : Equiv.swap i j q = j := by
          rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_left hqi]
        have h2 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q = u := by
          simp [weylWeightUnit, hqi]
        have h3 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) =
            -(-u)⁻¹ := by
          rw [h1]
          simp [weylWeightUnit, hij.symm]
        rw [h2, h3]
        have h_inv : ((-u)⁻¹ : Rˣ) = -u⁻¹ := by
          apply Units.ext; simp
        rw [h_inv]
        simp
      · by_cases hqj : q = j
        · have h1 : Equiv.swap i j q = i := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_left hqj]
          have h2 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q = -u⁻¹ := by
            simp only [weylWeightUnit, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_left hqj]
          have h3 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) =
              -u := by
            rw [h1]
            simp [weylWeightUnit]
          rw [h2, h3]
          have h_inv : ((-u⁻¹)⁻¹ : Rˣ) = -u := by
            calc (-u⁻¹ : Rˣ)⁻¹ = (-(u⁻¹) : Rˣ)⁻¹ := by
                  have : (-u⁻¹ : Rˣ) = -(u⁻¹) := by
                    apply Units.ext; simp
                  rw [this]
              _ = -(u⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
                  have : ((-(u⁻¹) : Rˣ)⁻¹ : Rˣ) = -((u⁻¹)⁻¹ : Rˣ) := by
                    apply Units.ext; simp
                  exact this
              _ = -u := by simp [inv_inv]
          have : (-u⁻¹ : Rˣ)⁻¹ = -u := h_inv
          simp [this]
        · have h1 : Equiv.swap i j q = q := by
            rw [swap_eq_ite i j q, ite_eq_right hqi, ite_eq_right hqj]
          have h2 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q = 1 := by
            simp [weylWeightUnit, hqi, hqj]
          have h3 : weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) = 1 := by
            rw [h1]
            simp [weylWeightUnit, hqi, hqj]
          rw [h2, h3]
          simp
    calc (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) : R)
        = ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) : Rˣ) : R) := rfl
      _ = ((((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q)⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) := by
        rw [hUnit]
      _ = (((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u q)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val) := rfl
  have hWM : ∀ p b,
      ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) * M) p b =
      (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
        M (Equiv.swap i j p) b := by
    intro p b
    calc ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) * M) p b =
        ∑ k : ι, (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : Matrix ι ι R) p k * M k b := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
      _ = ∑ k : ι, (if k = Equiv.swap i j p then
            (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) else 0) * M k b := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
        rw [hW p k]
      _ = ∑ k : ι, if k = Equiv.swap i j p then
            (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) * M k b else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
        by_cases hk : k = Equiv.swap i j p <;> simp [hk]
      _ = (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
            M (Equiv.swap i j p) b := by
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (Equiv.swap i j p)
          (fun k => (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) * M k b)]
        simp
  have hFinal : ∀ p q,
      (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M *
        ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) p q) =
      (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
        M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) *
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) (Equiv.swap i j q) : R) := by
    intro p q
    have hMul :
        (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M *
          ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) p q) =
        ∑ b, ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M) p b) *
            ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) b q)) :=
      Matrix.mul_apply
    calc (((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M *
        ((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) p q)
        = ∑ b, ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R).val * M) p b) *
            ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) b q)) :=
        hMul
      _ = ∑ b, (((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
            M (Equiv.swap i j p) b) *
            ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) b q)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
        rw [hWM p b]
      _ = ∑ b, ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
            M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
            ((((weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : GL ι R).val) b q)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
        rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = ∑ b, ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
            M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
            (if q = Equiv.swap i j b then
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) b : R) else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
        rw [hWinv b q]
      _ = ∑ b, (if q = Equiv.swap i j b then
            (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
              M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) b : R) else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
        by_cases hb : q = Equiv.swap i j b
        · simp only [hb, ite_true, mul_assoc]
        · simp only [hb, ite_false, mul_zero]
      _ = ∑ b, (if b = Equiv.swap i j q then
            (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
              M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) b : R) else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
        have h_iff : (q = Equiv.swap i j b) ↔ (b = Equiv.swap i j q) := by
          constructor
          · intro h
            calc b = Equiv.swap i j (Equiv.swap i j b) :=
                  (Equiv.swap_apply_self i j b).symm
              _ = Equiv.swap i j q := by rw [← h]
          · intro h
            calc q = Equiv.swap i j (Equiv.swap i j q) :=
                  (Equiv.swap_apply_self i j q).symm
              _ = Equiv.swap i j b := by rw [h]
        by_cases hb : q = Equiv.swap i j b
        · have hb2 : b = Equiv.swap i j q := h_iff.mp hb
          rw [ite_eq_left hb, ite_eq_left hb2]
        · have hb2 : ¬ b = Equiv.swap i j q :=
            fun h2 => hb (h_iff.mpr h2)
          rw [ite_eq_right hb, ite_eq_right hb2]
      _ = (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
            M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) *
            (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u)
              (Equiv.swap i j q) : R) := by
        have h :
            (∑ b : ι, if b = Equiv.swap i j q then
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
                M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
                (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) b : R)
              else 0) =
            if Equiv.swap i j q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι) then
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
                M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) *
                (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u)
                  (Equiv.swap i j q) : R)
              else 0 :=
          Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.univ : Finset ι) (Equiv.swap i j q)
            (fun b =>
              (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
                M (Equiv.swap i j p) b *
                (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) b : R))
        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] at h
        exact h
  simpa [hWeightInv q] using hFinal p q

end EntryFormula

section WeylTransportGL

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

private theorem weyl_conj_IsUpperTriangular
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (M : Matrix ι ι R)
    (hM_tri : IsUpperTriangular M)
    (hM_ij : M i j = 0) :
    IsUpperTriangular
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * M *
        (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : Matrix ι ι R) := by
  intro p q hqp
  rw [weylGLUnit_conj_entry i j hij u M p q]
  by_cases hne : q = i ∧ p = j
  · have hM0 : M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) = 0 := by
      have hpj : p = j := hne.2
      have hqi : q = i := hne.1
      have h1 : Equiv.swap i j p = i := by
        rw [hpj, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
      have h2 : Equiv.swap i j q = j := by
        rw [hqi, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
      calc M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) = M i j := by
            rw [h1, h2]
        _ = 0 := hM_ij
    rw [hM0, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · have hlt : Equiv.swap i j q < Equiv.swap i j p :=
      adjacentSwap_preserves_lt hij_cov hqp hne
    have h0 : M (Equiv.swap i j p) (Equiv.swap i j q) = 0 := by
      have : Equiv.swap i j q < Equiv.swap i j p := hlt
      exact hM_tri this
    simp [h0]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
private theorem weyl_conj_diag_one
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ)
    (M : Matrix ι ι R) (hM_diag : ∀ k, M k k = 1) (p : ι) :
    (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * M *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ : Matrix ι ι R) p p = 1 := by
  rw [weylGLUnit_conj_entry i j hij u M p p, hM_diag (Equiv.swap i j p)]
  have hUnit : (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
      ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val = 1 := by
    have h : ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : Rˣ) *
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ) = 1 := by
      simp
    have h2 : (((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : Rˣ) *
        (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) = 1 := by
      rw [h]; rfl
    calc (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
        ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val
        = (((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : Rˣ) *
          (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by rfl
      _ = 1 := h2
  calc (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
      1 * ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val
      = (weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p : R) *
        ((weylWeightUnit (R := R) i j hij u p)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val := by
          simp [mul_one]
    _ = 1 := hUnit

theorem weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperUnitriangular_of_covBy_zero
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {t : GL ι R} (ht : t ∈ upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : (t : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * t *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ ∈
      upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R := by
  have hM_tri : IsUpperTriangular (t : Matrix ι ι R) := ht.1
  have hM_diag : ∀ k, (t : Matrix ι ι R) k k = 1 := ht.2
  constructor
  · exact weyl_conj_IsUpperTriangular hij_cov u hij
      (t : Matrix ι ι R) hM_tri ht_ij
  · intro k
    exact weyl_conj_diag_one hij u (t : Matrix ι ι R) hM_diag k

theorem weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_covBy_zero
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {t : GL ι R} (ht : t ∈ upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : (t : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * t *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ ∈
      upperElementarySubgroup ι R := by
  have hU := weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperUnitriangular_of_covBy_zero
    hij_cov u hij ht ht_ij
  exact upperUnitriangularSubgroup_le_upperElementarySubgroup hU

theorem weylGL_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_covBy_zero
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    {t : GL ι R} (ht : t ∈ upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : (t : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    weylGL (R := R) i j hij * t * (weylGL (R := R) i j hij)⁻¹ ∈
      upperElementarySubgroup ι R := by
  have h : weylGL (R := R) i j hij = weylGLUnit i j hij 1 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_covBy_zero
    hij_cov 1 hij ht ht_ij

theorem weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_elementary_zero
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * (t : GL ι R) *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ ∈
      upperElementarySubgroup ι R := by
  have htU : (t : GL ι R) ∈ upperUnitriangularSubgroup ι R :=
    upperElementarySubgroup_le_upperUnitriangularSubgroup_commRing t.2
  exact weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_covBy_zero
    hij_cov u hij htU ht_ij

theorem weylGLUnit_mul_upperElementary_exists_left
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R) * (t : GL ι R) =
        (t' : GL ι R) * weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u := by
  let W : GL ι R := weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u
  have hMem : W * (t : GL ι R) * W⁻¹ ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι R :=
    weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_elementary_zero
      hij_cov u hij t ht_ij
  refine ⟨⟨W * (t : GL ι R) * W⁻¹, hMem⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [W, mul_assoc]

theorem weylGLUnit_mul_upperElementary_exists_right
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      (t : GL ι R) * weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u =
        (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u : GL ι R) * (t' : GL ι R) := by
  let W : GL ι R := weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u
  have hInv : W⁻¹ = weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) :=
    weylGLUnit_inv i j hij u
  have hInv2 : (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u))⁻¹ = W := by
    have h := weylGLUnit_inv i j hij (-u)
    simpa [W, neg_neg] using h
  have hMem : W⁻¹ * (t : GL ι R) * W ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι R := by
    have hEq2 : W⁻¹ * (t : GL ι R) * W =
        weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) * (t : GL ι R) *
          (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hInv, hInv2]
    rw [hEq2]
    exact weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_elementary_zero
      hij_cov (-u) hij t ht_ij
  refine ⟨⟨W⁻¹ * (t : GL ι R) * W, hMem⟩, ?_⟩
  have hEq : (t : GL ι R) * W = W * (W⁻¹ * (t : GL ι R) * W) := by
    calc (t : GL ι R) * W = 1 * ((t : GL ι R) * W) := by simp
      _ = (W * W⁻¹) * ((t : GL ι R) * W) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
      _ = W * (W⁻¹ * ((t : GL ι R) * W)) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = W * (W⁻¹ * (t : GL ι R) * W) := by rw [mul_assoc]
  exact hEq

theorem weylGL_mul_upperElementary_exists_left
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      (weylGL (R := R) i j hij : GL ι R) * (t : GL ι R) =
        (t' : GL ι R) * weylGL (R := R) i j hij := by
  have h : weylGL (R := R) i j hij = weylGLUnit i j hij 1 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact weylGLUnit_mul_upperElementary_exists_left
    hij_cov 1 hij t ht_ij

theorem weylGL_mul_upperElementary_exists_right
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      (t : GL ι R) * weylGL (R := R) i j hij =
        (weylGL (R := R) i j hij : GL ι R) * (t' : GL ι R) := by
  have h : weylGL (R := R) i j hij = weylGLUnit i j hij 1 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact weylGLUnit_mul_upperElementary_exists_right
    hij_cov 1 hij t ht_ij

end WeylTransportGL

section WeylTransportSL

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
private theorem toGL_weylSLUnit_eq_weylGLUnit'
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Rˣ) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u) : GL ι R) =
      weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [weylSLUnit, weylGLUnit,
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_GL_coe_matrix,
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mul,
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe, coe_elementary]

theorem weylSLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_toSLHom
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t *
        (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ =
        UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := by
  have hGLMem : weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * (t : GL ι R) *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ ∈
      upperElementarySubgroup ι R :=
    weylGLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_of_elementary_zero
      hij_cov u hij t ht_ij
  let t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R :=
    ⟨weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * (t : GL ι R) *
      (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹, hGLMem⟩
  refine ⟨t', ?_⟩
  apply Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_injective
  calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (weylSLUnit i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t *
          (weylSLUnit i j hij u)⁻¹)
      = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (weylSLUnit i j hij u) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (UpperElementary.toSLHom t) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (weylSLUnit i j hij u)⁻¹ := by
          simp [map_mul, map_inv]
    _ = weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * (t : GL ι R) *
          (weylGLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ := by
        simp [toGL_weylSLUnit_eq_weylGLUnit',
          UpperElementary.toGL_toSLHom, map_inv]
    _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (UpperElementary.toSLHom t') := by
        simp [UpperElementary.toGL_toSLHom, t']

theorem weylSLUnit_mul_toSLHom_exists_left
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t =
        UpperElementary.toSLHom t' * weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u := by
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ :=
    weylSLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_toSLHom hij_cov u hij t ht_ij
  refine ⟨t', ?_⟩
  have hInv : (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u)⁻¹ *
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u = 1 := inv_mul_cancel _
  calc weylSLUnit i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t
      = UpperElementary.toSLHom t' * weylSLUnit i j hij u := by
        have hConj : weylSLUnit i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t *
            (weylSLUnit i j hij u)⁻¹ = UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := ht'
        calc weylSLUnit i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t
            = weylSLUnit i j hij u * (UpperElementary.toSLHom t *
                ((weylSLUnit i j hij u)⁻¹ * weylSLUnit i j hij u)) := by
              rw [hInv, mul_one]
          _ = weylSLUnit i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t *
                (weylSLUnit i j hij u)⁻¹ * weylSLUnit i j hij u := by
              rw [(mul_assoc _ _ _).symm, (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm]
          _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom t' * weylSLUnit i j hij u := by
              rw [hConj]

theorem weylSLUnit_mul_toSLHom_exists_right
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (u : Rˣ) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      UpperElementary.toSLHom t * weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u =
        weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u * UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := by
  let W : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R :=
    weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij u
  have hWinv : W⁻¹ = weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (-u) :=
    weylSLUnit_inv i j hij u
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ :=
    weylSLUnit_conj_mem_upperElementary_toSLHom hij_cov (-u) hij t ht_ij
  have hConj : W⁻¹ * UpperElementary.toSLHom t * W =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := by
    simpa [W, weylSLUnit_inv] using ht'
  refine ⟨t', ?_⟩
  have hW_inv : W * W⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel _
  calc UpperElementary.toSLHom t * W
      = (W * W⁻¹) * (UpperElementary.toSLHom t * W) := by
        rw [hW_inv, one_mul]
    _ = W * (W⁻¹ * UpperElementary.toSLHom t * W) := by
        simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = W * UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := by rw [hConj]

theorem weylSL_mul_toSLHom_exists_left
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      weylSL (R := R) i j hij * UpperElementary.toSLHom t =
        UpperElementary.toSLHom t' * weylSL (R := R) i j hij := by
  have h : weylSL (R := R) i j hij = weylSLUnit i j hij 1 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact weylSLUnit_mul_toSLHom_exists_left hij_cov 1 hij t ht_ij

theorem weylSL_mul_toSLHom_exists_right
    {i j : ι} (hij_cov : i ⋖ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : upperElementarySubgroup ι R)
    (ht_ij : ((t : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) i j = 0) :
    ∃ t' : upperElementarySubgroup ι R,
      UpperElementary.toSLHom t * weylSL (R := R) i j hij =
        weylSL (R := R) i j hij * UpperElementary.toSLHom t' := by
  have h : weylSL (R := R) i j hij = weylSLUnit i j hij 1 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact weylSLUnit_mul_toSLHom_exists_right hij_cov 1 hij t ht_ij

end WeylTransportSL

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.HeterogeneousBruhat
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.GeneralLinearEquiv
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Monomial
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Determinant
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Defs

@[expose] public section

open PermutationBilinearCocycle

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section UpperToSL

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
variable {S : Type*} [CommRing S]

namespace UpperElementary

/-- Inclusion `U_ι(R) →* SL_ι(R)` via `det = 1` from elementary subgroup. -/
def toSLHom : upperElementarySubgroup ι R →* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R where
  toFun g :=
    ⟨(g : GL ι R).val,
      by
        have hMem : (g : GL ι R) ∈ elementarySubgroup ι R :=
          upperElementarySubgroup_le_elementarySubgroup g.2
        have hDet : det (g : GL ι R) = 1 :=
          det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup hMem
        have hVal : (det (g : GL ι R)).val = 1 := by
          rw [hDet]
          rfl
        exact hVal⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_toSLHom (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    (↑(toSLHom (R := R) g) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (↑(g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem toGL_toSLHom (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (toSLHom g) : GL ι R) =
      (g : GL ι R) := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

theorem toSLHom_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S)
    (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (toSLHom g) =
      toSLHom (mapRingHom (ι := ι) f g) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

end UpperElementary

end UpperToSL

section SLBruhat

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]
variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

open Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup

/-- Bundled Bruhat decomposition for `g : SL_ι(F)` with upper-elementary
left/right and middle `MonomialSL`. Both GL and SL factorizations are recorded. -/
structure SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) where
  left : upperElementarySubgroup ι F
  middle : MonomialSL F ι
  right : upperElementarySubgroup ι F
  factorizationGL :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) =
      (left : GL ι F) *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
        (right : GL ι F)
  factorizationSL :
    g = UpperElementary.toSLHom left *
      monomialSLHom F ι middle *
      UpperElementary.toSLHom right

namespace SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition

variable {g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F}

theorem val_eq (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    (g : Matrix ι ι F) =
      (d.left : GL ι F).val *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)).val *
        (d.right : GL ι F).val := by
  have hGL := d.factorizationGL
  have h1 : ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) : Matrix ι ι F) =
      (g : Matrix ι ι F) := rfl
  calc (g : Matrix ι ι F) =
      ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) : Matrix ι ι F) := h1.symm
    _ = ((d.left : GL ι F) *
          (monomialMatrixHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
          (d.right : GL ι F) : GL ι F).val := by rw [hGL]
    _ = _ := by simp

theorem middle_det_one (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    monomialDetHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) = 1 :=
  d.middle.2

theorem middle_GL_det_one (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    det (monomialMatrixHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) = 1 :=
  d.middle.2

end SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition

/-- Canonical (choice-based) SL Bruhat decomposition from heterogeneous one. -/
noncomputable def specialLinearBruhatDecomposition
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g := by
  classical
  let eGL : GL ι F := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g
  let eEquiv : GeneralLinearEquiv ι ι F := GeneralLinearEquiv.ofGL eGL
  let d := GeneralLinearEquiv.heterogeneousBruhatDecomposition eEquiv
  let base : MonomialBase Fˣ ι := ⟨d.weights, d.perm⟩
  let monomialGL : GL ι F := monomialMatrixHom F ι base
  have hMonoVal :
      (GeneralLinearEquiv.monomialEquiv d.weights d.perm).val =
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι base : Matrix ι ι F) := by
    have h := GeneralLinearEquiv.monomialEquiv_eq_monomialMatrixHom
      (R := F) d.weights d.perm
    exact h
  have hValEq : eGL.val =
      (d.left : GL ι F).val * monomialGL.val * (d.right : GL ι F).val := by
    have hDecompVal := d.val_eq
    calc eGL.val = eEquiv.val := rfl
      _ = (d.left : GL ι F).val *
            (GeneralLinearEquiv.monomialEquiv d.weights d.perm).val *
            (d.right : GL ι F).val := hDecompVal
      _ = (d.left : GL ι F).val * monomialGL.val *
            (d.right : GL ι F).val := by rw [hMonoVal]
  have hGLEq : eGL =
      (d.left : GL ι F) * monomialGL * (d.right : GL ι F) := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [coe_mul, hValEq]
  have hDet_eGL : det eGL = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    calc (det eGL).val = (eGL : Matrix ι ι F).det := rfl
      _ = (g : Matrix ι ι F).det := rfl
      _ = 1 := g.2
  have hDetLeft : det (d.left : GL ι F) = 1 := by
    have hMem : (d.left : GL ι F) ∈ elementarySubgroup ι F :=
      upperElementarySubgroup_le_elementarySubgroup d.left.2
    exact det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup hMem
  have hDetRight : det (d.right : GL ι F) = 1 := by
    have hMem : (d.right : GL ι F) ∈ elementarySubgroup ι F :=
      upperElementarySubgroup_le_elementarySubgroup d.right.2
    exact det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup hMem
  have hDetMono : det monomialGL = 1 := by
    have hProd :
        det ((d.left : GL ι F) * monomialGL * (d.right : GL ι F)) =
          det (d.left : GL ι F) * det monomialGL *
            det (d.right : GL ι F) := by
      simp [map_mul]
    calc det monomialGL = 1 * det monomialGL * 1 := by simp
      _ = det (d.left : GL ι F) * det monomialGL *
            det (d.right : GL ι F) := by
        rw [hDetLeft, hDetRight]
      _ = det ((d.left : GL ι F) * monomialGL *
            (d.right : GL ι F)) := hProd.symm
      _ = det eGL := by rw [← hGLEq]
      _ = 1 := hDet_eGL
  have hBaseDet : monomialDetHom F ι base = 1 := hDetMono
  let middle : MonomialSL F ι := ⟨base, hBaseDet⟩
  have hGLEqMiddle : eGL =
      (d.left : GL ι F) *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
        (d.right : GL ι F) := hGLEq
  have hToGLLeft :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left) : GL ι F) =
        (d.left : GL ι F) :=
    UpperElementary.toGL_toSLHom d.left
  have hToGLRight :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) : GL ι F) =
        (d.right : GL ι F) :=
    UpperElementary.toGL_toSLHom d.right
  have hToGLMiddle :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (monomialSLHom F ι middle) : GL ι F) =
        monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) := by
    rw [monomialSLHom_toGL]
  have hToGLProd :
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F ι middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) =
        (d.left : GL ι F) *
          (monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
          (d.right : GL ι F) := by
    simp [map_mul, hToGLLeft, hToGLMiddle, hToGLRight]
  have hSLEq : g =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
        monomialSLHom F ι middle *
        UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right := by
    apply Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_injective
    calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g = eGL := rfl
      _ = (d.left : GL ι F) *
            (monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
            (d.right : GL ι F) := hGLEqMiddle
      _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
            (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
              monomialSLHom F ι middle *
              UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) := hToGLProd.symm
  exact
    { left := d.left
      middle := middle
      right := d.right
      factorizationGL := hGLEqMiddle
      factorizationSL := hSLEq }

theorem exists_specialLinearBruhatDecomposition
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    ∃ (left : upperElementarySubgroup ι F) (middle : MonomialSL F ι)
      (right : upperElementarySubgroup ι F),
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) =
          (left : GL ι F) *
            (monomialMatrixHom F ι (middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
            (right : GL ι F) ∧
        g = UpperElementary.toSLHom left *
          monomialSLHom F ι middle *
          UpperElementary.toSLHom right := by
  let d := specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g
  exact ⟨d.left, d.middle, d.right, d.factorizationGL, d.factorizationSL⟩

noncomputable def bruhatLeft
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) : upperElementarySubgroup ι F :=
  (specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g).left

noncomputable def bruhatMiddle
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) : MonomialSL F ι :=
  (specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g).middle

noncomputable def bruhatRight
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) : upperElementarySubgroup ι F :=
  (specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g).right

theorem bruhat_factorizationGL
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) =
      (bruhatLeft g : GL ι F) *
        (monomialMatrixHom F ι (bruhatMiddle g : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
        (bruhatRight g : GL ι F) :=
  (specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g).factorizationGL

theorem bruhat_factorizationSL
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    g = UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatLeft g) *
      monomialSLHom F ι (bruhatMiddle g) *
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (bruhatRight g) :=
  (specialLinearBruhatDecomposition g).factorizationSL

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem toGL_map (f : F →+* K)
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g) := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem map_monomialSLHom (f : F →+* K)
    (x : MonomialSL F ι) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (monomialSLHom F ι x) =
      monomialSLHom K ι (monomialSLMap F K ι f x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply (R := F) (S := K)
    (f := f) (x := (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι))
  have hMat : ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
      (monomialMatrixHom F ι (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      ((monomialMatrixHom K ι
        (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f)
          (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) :=
    congrArg (fun g : GL ι K => (g : Matrix ι ι K)) h
  calc ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (monomialSLHom F ι x) :
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      ((monomialMatrixHom F ι (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι) : GL ι F).val.map f) := rfl
    _ = ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
          (monomialMatrixHom F ι (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) : GL ι K) :
          Matrix ι ι K) := rfl
    _ = ((monomialMatrixHom K ι
          (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f)
            (x : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) := hMat
    _ = ((monomialSLHom K ι (monomialSLMap F K ι f x) :
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) := rfl

/-- Map a given SL Bruhat decomposition along `f : F →+* K`. This is
functorial on the decomposition, but the canonical choice
`specialLinearBruhatDecomposition` is not itself natural. -/
noncomputable def SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition.map
    (f : F →+* K) {g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F}
    (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) where
  left := UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.left
  middle := monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle
  right := UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.right
  factorizationGL := by
    have hOrig := d.factorizationGL
    have hToGLMap : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g) := toGL_map f g
    calc (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g) : GL ι K) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g) := hToGLMap
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
            ((d.left : GL ι F) *
              (monomialMatrixHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι)) *
              (d.right : GL ι F)) := by rw [hOrig]
      _ = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f (d.left : GL ι F)) *
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
              (monomialMatrixHom F ι (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι))) *
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f
              (d.right : GL ι F)) := by simp [map_mul]
      _ = (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.left : GL ι K) *
            (monomialMatrixHom K ι
              (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f)
                (d.middle : MonomialBase Fˣ ι))) *
            (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.right : GL ι K) := by
          simp only [UpperElementary.coe_mapRingHom,
            monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply]
      _ = (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.left : GL ι K) *
            (monomialMatrixHom K ι
              ((monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle : MonomialSL K ι) :
                MonomialBase Kˣ ι)) *
            (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.right : GL ι K) := rfl
  factorizationSL := by
    have hOrigSL := d.factorizationSL
    calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f g =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f
          (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left *
            monomialSLHom F ι d.middle *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) :=
          congrArg (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f) hOrigSL
      _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.left) *
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (monomialSLHom F ι d.middle) *
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (UpperElementary.toSLHom d.right) := by
          simp [map_mul]
      _ = UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.left) *
            monomialSLHom K ι (monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle) *
            UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.right) := by
          rw [UpperElementary.toSLHom_mapRingHom, map_monomialSLHom,
            UpperElementary.toSLHom_mapRingHom]

@[simp]
theorem SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition.map_left
    (f : F →+* K) {g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F}
    (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    (d.map f).left = UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.left := rfl

@[simp]
theorem SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition.map_middle
    (f : F →+* K) {g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F}
    (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    (d.map f).middle = monomialSLMap F K ι f d.middle := rfl

@[simp]
theorem SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition.map_right
    (f : F →+* K) {g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F}
    (d : SpecialLinearBruhatDecomposition g) :
    (d.map f).right = UpperElementary.mapRingHom f d.right := rfl

end SLBruhat

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup
